**Company Description**
Sterling is a long-established outsourcing partner specializing in customer service, credit management, debt recovery, and finance & accounting solutions for organizations of all sizes. With over 20 years of experience and access to more than 2,000 expert advisors, Sterling supports clients across multiple sectors, including telecom, recruitment, accountancy, consulting, and utilities. The company serves over 1,000 clients and operates in 33 countries, offering multilingual, culturally aware services with a focus on efficiency and minimal bureaucracy. The Sales Executive role is a full-time, on-site position based in Mumbai. The Sales Executive will prospect and qualify new leads, conduct sales presentations and product demonstrations, and manage the full sales cycle from initial contact to closing. * Prior experience selling to international or multilingual clients is an advantage; familiarity with credit management, customer service, or finance processes is beneficial.

title: Account Executive – Enterprise Sales
description:
About the role

DoubleTick.io, a Meta award-winning conversational CX stack, is looking for an Account Executive – Enterprise Sales to drive new business acquisition and revenue growth across enterprise accounts.

This role is ideal for someone who combines strong B2B sales expertise with a deep understanding of enterprise sales cycles and can build relationships with senior decision-makers, identify business opportunities, and translate customer requirements into high-value solutions. The ideal candidate will own the sales journey from prospecting and discovery to solution presentation, negotiation, and deal closure.

Key Responsibilities

* Own the complete enterprise sales cycle, from prospecting and lead qualification to negotiation and closure.
* Identify, target, and acquire enterprise customers across relevant industries, including BFSI, Real Estate, Travel, EdTech, Healthcare, Auto, Retail, and FMCG.
* Build and manage a strong pipeline of enterprise opportunities to consistently achieve and exceed revenue targets.
* Engage with senior stakeholders, including CXOs, VPs, Heads of Sales, Marketing, Customer Experience, and IT.
* Understand customer business challenges and recommend relevant DoubleTick solutions across conversational AI, WhatsApp Business, customer engagement, automation, and analytics.
* Conduct discovery calls and needs assessments to understand business requirements, pain points, and buying priorities.
* Deliver compelling product demonstrations and presentations tailored to enterprise customer use cases.
* Develop account strategies and sales plans to penetrate target organizations and expand business opportunities.
* Manage complex, consultative sales cycles involving multiple stakeholders and decision-makers.
* Prepare commercial proposals, negotiate pricing and contract terms, and drive deals to successful closure.
* Build and maintain strong relationships with key accounts to support customer satisfaction, retention, and future expansion opportunities.
* Collaborate with Customer Success, Product, and Solutions Engineering teams to ensure smooth handover and successful customer implementation.
* Maintain accurate pipeline updates, sales forecasts, and activity records in the CRM.
* Track key sales metrics, including pipeline value, conversion rates, deal size, sales cycle, and quota attainment.
* Monitor market trends, competitor offerings, and customer requirements to identify new business opportunities.
* Work closely with leadership to refine sales strategies, improve processes, and accelerate revenue growth.

**Ideal candidate**

* 2–8 years of experience in B2B Sales, Enterprise Sales, Account Management, or Business Development.
* Proven track record of acquiring new enterprise customers and achieving revenue targets.
* Experience managing complex, consultative sales cycles with multiple stakeholders.
* Experience selling SaaS, CRM, MarTech, CPaaS, conversational AI, enterprise software, or other technology solutions is highly preferred.
* Strong understanding of enterprise prospecting, pipeline development, lead qualification, and deal management.
* Demonstrated ability to engage and influence senior decision-makers, including CXOs and business heads.
* Experience conducting product demonstrations, solution presentations, commercial negotiations, and contract closures.
* Strong business acumen with the ability to connect technology solutions to customer business outcomes and ROI.
* Hands-on experience with CRM platforms such as Salesforce, HubSpot, Zoho, or similar tools.
* Strong communication, presentation, negotiation, and stakeholder-management skills.
* Self-driven, target-oriented, and comfortable working in a fast-paced, high-growth environment.
* Ability to work cross-functionally with technical and customer-facing teams to drive successful enterprise deals.

**DoubleTick.io, headquartered in Mumbai, is a Meta award-winning AI conversational CX stack, designed to unlock conversation-led sales, marketing, and customer engagement use cases at scale for enterprises. Backed by Info Edge Ventures and BeeNext, the platform serves 10,000+ businesses across India and the UAE, including large clients across industries such as BFSI, Real Estate, Travel, EdTech, Healthcare, Auto, Retail, and FMCG. Leading brands such as MakeMyTrip, Piramal Finance, CoinDCX, AU Bank, and Lodha Developers trust DoubleTick to power their customer conversations.**

**The user-friendly enterprise communication suite features a full-stack conversational platform offering centralization, automation, and analytics across channels such as WhatsApp Chat, WhatsApp Voice, WhatsApp Groups, PSTN Calls, and 10+ other channels. With its AI Agent Builder and Bot Studio, enterprises can create and deploy complex AI agents and bots across chat and voice in minutes.**

**Why work with us?**

* Fast-tracked career growth into senior leadership positions.
* Opportunity to own high-value enterprise deals and create measurable business impact.
* Opportunity to work closely with the founders and learn what it takes to grow a company at every stage.
* Opportunity to work in a culture where you can challenge leadership, share ideas, and contribute to strategic decisions.
* Direct exposure to working with some of the largest enterprises in the world.
* Opportunity to shape enterprise sales strategy and drive growth for an innovative AI-powered conversational platform.

Maintain timely and consistent communication with every active lead.

Build relationships that generate repeat customers and referrals.

title: Sales Compensation Analyst (Compensation & Payroll Operations)
description:
**About The Role**
**Grade Level (for internal use):**
10
  
  
**The Role**
The
**Sales Compensation Analyst (Compensation & Payroll Operations)**
is a critical technical and operational position within the global Sales Compensation team.
  
  
**The Team**
You will join the global Sales Compensation team — a high-impact, technically sophisticated group at the operational heart of S&P Global's commercial engine. Spanning time zones and geographies, we combine enterprise system precision with financial rigor to ensure 1,500+ salespeople worldwide are paid accurately and on time, every single cycle. We are a team that values methodical problem-solving, cross-functional collaboration, and an unwavering commitment to scalable, auditable, and compliant operations.
  
  
**Responsibilities And Impact**

* Drive end-to-end commission calculation cycles for 1,500+ global payees across all commercial business units — delivering 100% mathematically precise, on-time payroll files to regional Finance and Payroll teams across the US, EMEA, and APAC.
* Administer and configure the enterprise Xactly platform (Incent, Connect & Analytics) — owning crediting rule setup, tiered accelerator matrices, split-crediting algorithms, batch ETL pipeline monitoring, and participant security profiles that directly reflect published annual compensation plans.
* Execute the full payee lifecycle — from configuring new hire profiles and quota ramp models, to implementing mid-period role transitions, LOA credit adjustments, and producing audit-ready departure settlement calculations.
* Build and optimize advanced SQL queries and Python/Alteryx automation scripts to perform high-volume ledger-to-payout reconciliations, pre-payroll sanity checks, distribution curve analyses, and root-cause remediation of calculation anomalies before file delivery.
* Lead annual platform readiness activities — authoring UAT test scripts, executing calculation logic change validation, managing plan roll-forwards, and maintaining comprehensive SOPs and runbooks that keep operational cycles repeatable and defensible.
* Serve as the frontline operational liaison to the Central Governance & Compliance team — delivering automated calculation logs, approval artifacts, and clear mathematical payout explanations to global sales leaders, managers, and representatives across multiple time zones.

**Key Responsibilities**
**Xactly System Administration & Configuration Management**

* Serve as the core hands-on administrator for Xactly Incent, Xactly Connect, and Xactly Analytics, overseeing rule configurations, crediting logic, participant hierarchies, and payout rate tables.
* Configure and maintain crediting rules, plan logic, tiered accelerator matrices, and split-crediting algorithms inside Xactly to reflect published annual compensation plans.
* Manage batch ETL integrations and data sync pipelines between upstream CRM/data warehouse platforms and Xactly Connect, proactively monitoring API sync jobs and resolving ingestion failures.
* Lead platform readiness for annual plan roll-forwards, plan parameter cutovers, and system testing; author test scripts and perform User Acceptance Testing for calculation logic changes.
* Administer participant security profiles, statement release workflows, and audit tracking within Xactly to ensure strict data privacy and system integrity.

**End-to-End Commission Calculation & Payroll Execution**

* Own and execute the monthly and quarterly commission calculation process across all global commercial business units, ensuring 100% timeliness and mathematical precision.
* Lead high-pressure calculation cycles against strict monthly payroll cutoffs, coordinating data freezes, calculation runs, manual adjustment validations, and final payroll sign-offs.
* Generate, reconcile, and format gross-to-net payroll transmission files, ensuring seamless handoffs to regional Payroll and Finance teams in the US, EMEA, and APAC.
* Perform automated pre-payroll sanity checks, distribution curve analyses, and historical variance spot-checks to catch calculation spikes, zero-payout outliers, and crediting bugs before file delivery.
* Execute calculation reruns, retroactive plan corrections, and adjustment batches within established cutover windows.

**Payee Lifecycle Operational Execution**

* New Hires & Onboarding: Configure new payee profiles in Xactly, assign plan rules, set up draw and guarantee schedules, and apply effective-dated quota ramp models based on start dates.
* Mid-Period Role Changes & Promotions: Implement plan transitions, target prorations, and crediting split adjustments for internal transfers and commercial promotions.
* Leaves of Absence (LOA): Adjust quota relief parameters, freeze crediting timelines, and prorate plan targets according to regional statutory and corporate policy guidelines.
* Departures & Offboarding: Calculate final commission settlements, review trailing pipeline revenues, verify recovery and clawback schedules, and deliver audit-ready exit calculations.
* HRIS-to-Engine Roster Reconciliation: Run scheduled automated reconciliations between Workday/HRIS and Xactly to identify roster deltas, missing employee IDs, and effective-date mismatches before payroll lock.

**Advanced Data Reconciliations, Automation & Quality Assurance**

* Build, maintain, and optimize complex SQL queries to extract, join, and audit high-volume transaction datasets across enterprise databases and calculation engines.
* Develop automated data reconciliation scripts using Python (Pandas), Alteryx, or advanced script-based tools to perform automated ledgers-to-payout reconciliations.
* Identify, isolate, and remediate root causes of data anomalies, including duplicate deal bookings, mismatched currency conversions, orphan transactions, and misaligned territory mapping.
* Maintain comprehensive calculation runbooks, process maps, and Standard Operating Procedures (SOPs) to ensure repeatable, documented operational cycles.

**Cross-Functional Collaboration & Governance Liaison**

* Partner with regional Payroll teams to investigate post-payroll discrepancies, off-cycle payment adjustments, and tax or deduction inquiries.
* Collaborate with the global Modeling and Strategic Programs analysts to transition new incentive rules and SPIFF structures into scalable Xactly calculation logic.
* Act as the frontline operational execution partner to the dedicated Central Governance & Compliance team, providing automated calculation logs, approval artifacts, and audit evidence for internal and external reviews.
* Provide clear, step-by-step mathematical explanations to sales managers and representatives regarding payout mechanics, adjustment deductions, and statement reporting.

**Basic Qualifications**

* Experience: 5+ years of technical sales compensation operations, financial systems administration, or payroll calculation experience in a complex, multi-national corporate environment.
* Xactly Platform: Minimum 2 years of hands-on administration and configuration experience with Xactly Incent and Xactly Connect, including crediting rule configuration, plan logic setup, and payout rate table management.
* SQL Proficiency: Demonstrated experience writing complex multi-table JOIN queries, subqueries, indexing, and aggregation scripts to validate high-volume financial transaction datasets.
* Data Automation: Proven experience building automated data validation or reconciliation pipelines using Python (Pandas), Alteryx, or VBA/Power Query in a financial operations context.

**Additional Preferred Qualifications**

* Xactly Certification: Xactly Certified Administrator credential; or equivalent platform certification in Varicent, Anaplan, or SAP Commissions.
* HRIS & CRM: Demonstrated experience using Workday for HRIS roster management and Salesforce for CRM data structures and effective-dating logic in a compensation operations context.
* Advanced Excel: Proven use of dynamic arrays, Power Pivot, nested logic formulas, and complex lookup models for financial reconciliation and compensation modeling.
* Global Payroll Operations: Experience generating, reconciling, and formatting gross-to-net payroll transmission files across multiple regional Finance and Payroll teams.
* Power BI Reporting: Experience reviewing and interpreting Power BI dashboards in a compensation analytics or financial operations environment.
* Audit & Compliance Support: Experience producing calculation logs, change control artifacts, and audit evidence packages for internal or external compliance reviews.
* Stakeholder Communication: Demonstrated ability to communicate complex payout mechanics and calculation adjustments clearly in written and spoken English to international stakeholders across multiple time zones.

We are looking for a result-driven Restaurant Onboarding Manager with experience in restaurant acquisition, strong connections within the Food & Beverage (F&B) industry, and the ability to independently onboard restaurants onto our digital advertising platform.

As part of our hiring process, shortlisted candidates will undergo a Background Verification (BGV). By applying, you consent to sharing personal information required for this process. Any offer made will be subject to successful completion of the BGV.
  
  
**How do we work?**
Whatever your role, our values describe what we ask of each other.
  
  
**Be a bridger**
Look beyond your own role. Ask questions, share context and help others get unstuck. That may mean bringing the right people together or picking up a problem that doesn’t necessarily fit neatly into your job description.
  
  
**Care loudly**
We want your perspective, not just your agreement. Speak up when something isn’t working or someone needs support. Give honest feedback with respect for the person receiving it. Don’t let an uncomfortable conversation become an unspoken problem.
  
  
**Own the outcome**
Take responsibility for the result, not just your part in the process. Use AI to move the work forward, not to outsource your judgment. Make the call, check whether it worked and change course when it didn’t. If something goes wrong, own it and help fix it.
  
  
That’s DevRev!

* Verify, collect, and dispatch OMR sheets to the central processing team within the prescribed timeline.
* Coordinate with internal teams until the Olympiad process is successfully completed.

3. Lead Generation & Business Development

* Generate B2B leads through calls, meetings, school visits, and other outreach activities.
* Identify opportunities to expand school partnerships and increase student participation.
* Maintain regular follow-ups with prospective and existing school partners.
* Support admission lead generation by maximizing Olympiad participation.

* Track school onboarding, student registrations, and Olympiad participation.
* Maintain OMR collection and dispatch records.
* Submit daily activity reports, school feedback, and performance updates.
* Coordinate with internal teams to resolve operational challenges.

* School visits, webinars, and school onboarding.
* Student registrations and Olympiad participation.
* Monthly target of 2,000+ student prelims.

* Working Days: Monday to Saturday.
* Weekly Off: Sunday.

Qualifications & Preferred Experience

* Experience in B2B sales, K-12 education sales, school sales, business development, or field sales.

* Spot underperforming partners early and act — whether through enablement support or reallocation of focus.

title: New Business Manager
description:
**ABOUT THOUGHT OVER DESIGN**

**Thought Over Design is a Brand Strategy & Design Studio based in Mumbai, India. We’re a lean team of creative people on a mission to build brands with purpose.**

**WHAT THE ROLE ENTAILS**

We’re looking for someone ambitious and self-driven to support the New Business Director in new conversations, client assessment, and proposal development. This is a growth-track role. You'll start by supporting the Director across communication, proposals, and paperwork, and as you find your footing, take on more of the process independently.

Much like a fund, TOD operates with the intent to select projects we believe we can create impact and value with. The New Business Manager will work closely with the Director in ensuring we're choosing to work with a like-minded fraternity of clients and partners.

**WHAT YOU BRING**

* **Lead Funnel:**
  Support the New Business Director in managing TOD's lead funnel across different channels - from inquiry, evaluation, monitoring, to closure. You'll help ensure every lead gets a timely response, and track each one consistently on our CRM from inquiry to closure.
* **Qualifying Leads:**
  Given the volume of leads we receive, they need to be responded to and qualified quickly. You'll work with the New Business Director to consciously and effectively qualify leads promptly, and help make this process more efficient over time.
* **Understanding the client:**
  Taking the effort to get to know each client and their objectives, and help customize our approach and working team to their unique requirements.
* **Proposal Development:**
  Support estimates and scopes of work - timelines, rates, and terms and build them strategically so they genuinely address the client's needs.
* **Contracts & Agreements:**
  Help translate a closed scope of work into our contract formats, ensuring everything discussed is captured clearly: payment terms, detailed SOW annexures, and NDAs, with all paperwork in place before a project begins.
* **Outbound Client Acquisition:**
  As you grow into the role, identify and pursue new business opportunities through outreach and networking that fit TOD's ethos and the kind of founders and brands we want to work with.
* **Quarterly Reporting:**
  Prepare quarterly reports summarising leads, learnings, observations, insights, and highlights for each quarter, and work closely with the New Business Director to stay in sync with the studio ethos and process.

**WHAT WE ARE LOOKING FOR**

* Experience: 2 - 3 years in a client-facing role with some degree of sales experience or involvement, including presenting the agency’s portfolio, walking clients through proposals, and actively supporting on pitches. Prior experience at a creative studio will carry preference.
* What matters most: Strong client communication skills, an ability to build relationships quickly, and the drive and grit to work in a sales-driven environment.
* Education: Bachelor's degree - a related field is a plus, but we'll be focusing more on how relevant your work experience is to this role.
* Proficiency with tools: Google Suite, Monday CRM, Make Automation, Fireflies, Slack, AI (Claude Design)
* Other: Mumbai-based candidates only, or open to moving to Mumbai full-time.

**WHAT WE OFFER**

You'll be closely involved in speaking with and building relationships with some of the coolest up-and-coming brands in the country, as well as established businesses looking to level up their brand - working alongside the Director initially, and taking on conversations independently as you grow into the role. This means a front-row seat to what's happening in India with consumer brands across multiple sectors and industries.

Result oriented deep critical thinking skills

**Beauty, Personal Care, Food & Beverages, FMCG, Lifestyle and Consumer Electronics**

.

**Enterprise SaaS Business Development Manager**

**3–5 years of experience in B2B SaaS, enterprise sales, D2C partnerships, e-commerce technology or MarTech**

.

You will be responsible for introducing One Click Co. to brands, demonstrating its value, securing paid pilots and converting enterprise opportunities into long-term SaaS contracts.

**Key Responsibilities****1. Enterprise Sales & Business Development**

* Identify, approach and acquire D2C, FMCG and consumer brands for One Click Co.'s enterprise solutions.

**2. D2C Brand Relationships & Partnerships**

* Leverage existing relationships with D2C brands to generate qualified meetings and business opportunities.

* Understand each brand's creative production challenges, catalogue size, marketplace requirements and operational workflows.

* Design and coordinate paid proof-of-concept engagements and convert successful pilots into annual contracts.

**4. Account Growth & Revenue Expansion**

* Build long-term relationships with acquired enterprise customers.
* Identify opportunities for account expansion, additional credit consumption and new business-unit adoption.
* Coordinate onboarding, renewals and upselling opportunities.
* Track customer feedback and identify opportunities to improve retention and product adoption.

**5. Sales Strategy & Reporting**

* Maintain accurate sales pipelines, forecasts and activity reports using CRM tools.
* Track lead conversion, sales cycles, pipeline value and closed revenue.
* Monitor competitor offerings, enterprise buying trends and customer requirements.
* Work directly with the founders to refine enterprise pricing, positioning and go-to-market strategies.

  in B2B SaaS sales, enterprise business development, MarTech, AdTech, e-commerce technology or D2C partnerships.

title: Territory Business Manager
description:
Dr. Reddy’s Laboratories Ltd. is a leading multinational pharmaceutical company based across global locations. Each of our 24,000 plus employees comes to work every day for one collective purpose: to accelerate access to affordable and innovative medicines because
**Good Health Can’t Wait**
.

We started in 1984 with a modest investment, 20 employees and a bold vision. Today, we have research and development centres, manufacturing facilities or a commercial presence in 66 countries.

For nearly four decades, we have stood for access, affordability and innovation based on the bedrock of deep science, progressive people practices and robust corporate governance. As the pharmaceutical industry evolves and undergoes disruption, we see an opportunity – to strengthen our core further (the next steps) and to build the future (the new bets).

‘The Next and the New’ is how we aim to continue to be the partner of choice – purpose-driven, future-ready and sustainable. Our aim is to reach over 1.5 Bn+ patients across the world by 2030 by growing our core businesses and building for the future with sustainability at the core of our purpose and strategy. Sustainability for us means operating in a manner that respects people, planet and purpose – helping us conserve precious resources, serve our patients, create value for stakeholders, give back to society, fulfil our potential and maintain our integrity and transparency

Dr Reddy’s maintains a work environment, free from discrimination and is an equal opportunity employer. We are committed to employ & nurture all qualified diverse workforce without regard to race, colour religion, nationality, sex, age, disability status, genetics, sexual orientation, gender expression, citizenship or any other characteristic or classification protected by applicable law(s) of the country we operate in. We treasure every talent, and recognize merit and diversity in our organization.

**Job Description**

**Job Summary**
  
We are seeking an experienced and dynamic individual for the position of “Territory Business Manger” to drive sales of pharmaceutical products in your assigned territory. You will gather market intelligence, conduct prescription audits, and implement sales strategies to achieve sales targets. Additionally, you will manage queries from doctors, maintain customer relationships, and ensure accurate territory data management.
  
  
  
  
**Roles & Responsibilities**
  
• You will be responsible for understanding market trends and competition status by gathering information from stockists and chemists and relaying this data to the Sales Business Manager (SBM) or Regional Sales Manager (RSM).
  
  
• You will be responsible for conducting Retail Chemist Prescription Audit (RCPA) on doctors in the assigned area to identify potential high-prescribers and providing the final list of doctors likely to prescribe large quantities to the SBM/RSM for sales forecasting purposes.
  
  
• You will be responsible for attending relevant training programs and staying updated on product literature.
  
  
• You will be responsible for obtaining sales targets and promotion budget details from SBM/RSM.
  
  
• You will be responsible for utilizing the allocated budget to plan launch activities for different doctors, camps, or Continuing Medical Education (CME) sessions in the assigned area.
  
  
• You will be responsible for conducting regular sales pitches and presentations with doctors to promote products.
  
  
• You will be responsible for submitting reimbursement bills to SBM/RSM.
  
  
• You will be responsible for implementing marketing plans provided by the Product Manager.
  
  
• You will be responsible for gathering Point of Business (POB) details from chemists and coordinating with stockists to ensure product delivery.
  
  
• You will be responsible for monitoring and tracking sales of new products with chemists to achieve sales targets.
  
  
• You will be responsible for collecting queries from doctors regarding both new and existing products.
  
  
• You will be responsible for entering queries into the system for review by the Infogini team.
  
  
• You will be responsible for utilizing email responses from Infogini to address doctors' queries and increase prescriptions per doctor.
  
  
• You will be responsible for maintaining regular interactions with doctors to understand their prescription trends.
  
  
• You will be responsible for communicating prescription trend data to SBM/RSM.
  
  
• You will be responsible for keeping track of specific customer needs and providing feedback to Area Sales Manager (ASM), SBM/RSM, or Head Office (HO).
  
  
• You will be responsible for preparing lists of doctors for all CME events and submitting them to SBM/RSM to foster strong relationships and loyalty among doctors.
  
  
• You will be responsible for maintaining and updating data on doctor lists, route maps, retailers, and other supply chain contacts in the internal database.
  
  
• You will be responsible for ensuring accurate management of sales activities to optimize sales volume and effectiveness.

**Qualifications**

**Educational qualification-**
Graduate with science background.
  
  
**Minimum work experience-**
3-5 years of experience in pharmaceutical sales.
  
  
  
  
**Skills & attributes
  
  
Technical Skills**
  
• Deep understanding of pharmaceutical products and marketing.
  
  
• Understanding of key trends in Pharmaceutical Sales.
  
  
• Experience in implementing and analysing sales and marketing strategies.
  
  
• Basic knowledge of Computers.
  
  
**Behavioural Skills**
  
• Excellent communication and interpersonal skills.
  
  
• Good at building and leveraging relationship.
  
  
• Strong analytical and problem-solving abilities.
  
  
• Strong decision-making skills.

**Additional Information**

**About the Department
  
  
Global Generics India**
  
Global Generics India business journey began in 1986. In the last three decades, we have grown as a trusted name in the healthcare industry and rank as one of the top 10 Pharma Companies in the Indian Pharma Market (IPM) as per IQVIA MAT (November 2022). Our commitment to Lead Ahead has helped us move ranks from 16th position to 10th position (IPM) in the last four years. We are a fast-growing organisation with double-digit growth and significant market share in domestic markets. Currently, we rank among the top 5 in oncology, anti-allergy and gastrointestinal diseases and the top 10 in a few other therapy areas. Our focus is on leveraging our digital capabilities, collaborations, innovations and inorganic opportunities to become the top 5 companies in the Indian Pharma Market.
  
  
  
  
**Benefits Offered**
  
At Dr. Reddy’s we actively help to catalyse your career growth and professional development through personalised learning programs.
  
  
The benefits you will enjoy at Dr. Reddy’s are on par with the best industry standards. They include, among other things and other essential equipment, joining & relocation support, family support (Maternity & Paternity benefits), learning and development opportunities, medical coverage for yourself and your family, life coverage for yourself.
  
  
  
  
**Our Work Culture**
  
Ask any employee at Dr. Reddy’s why they come to work every day and they’ll say, because Good Health Can’t Wait. This is our credo as well as the guiding principle behind all our actions. We see healthcare solutions not only as scientific formulations, but as a means to help patients lead healthier lives, and we’re always attuned to the new and the next to empower people to stay fit. And to do this, we foster a culture of empathy and dynamism. People are at the core of our journey over the last few decades. They have been supported by an enabling environment that buoys individual ability while fostering teamwork and shared success. We believe that when people with diverse skills are bound together by a common purpose and value system, they can make magic.
  
  
For more details, please visit our career website at
**https://careers.drreddys.com/#!/**

title: R29829 Business Development Manager - Mumbai
description:
**Job Purpose**

The Business Development Manager will drive High revenue growth, market share, and brand visibility within the assigned territory. This role owns the end-to-end B2B commercial cycle—combining primary sales and strict collection management with localized marketing activations to generate secondary demand for channel partners.

**Key Responsibilities**

**1. Sales & Commercial Management (Primary Function)**

* Achieve monthly, quarterly, and annual sales targets through structured B2B distribution networks.
* Ensure 100% timely collection of outstanding payments to maintain a healthy credit cycle.
* Manage high-value accounts, clinical chains, and individual retail audiologists.
* Monitor territory commercial health, analyzing sales data to identify growth white spaces.

**2. Channel Partner Management & Expansion**

* Build, nurture, and maintain strong, long-term relationships with existing B2B channel partners.
* Onboard new channel partners, audiometry clinics, and ENT hospital setups to expand market footprint.
* Implement structured partner engagement programs to ensure high brand-share-of-wallet.

**3. Marketing & Secondary Demand Generation**

* Design and execute ground-level B2B2C marketing activations to drive footfall for channel partners.
* Plan and organize localized community touchpoints, including residential society screening camps.
* Network with premium social clubs (e.g., Rotary Club, Lions Club) to set up corporate/social awareness programs.
* Track the ROI of field marketing investments and measure camp-to-clinic lead conversion rates.

**4. Territory & Competitive Intelligence**

* Map the complete geographic territory to track competitor pricing, schemes, and product positioning.
* Supply regular market intelligence reports to national marketing and product development teams.
* Utilize CRM systems to track pipelines, manage client interactions, and forecast sales accurately.
* Identify and develop new business opportunity across assigned territories

**Preferred candidate profile**

* Direct experience in the hearing aid industry, or transferable B2B network management experience from high-turnover industries like Paint, Tyres, or Telecom

* Experience: 8-10 Years in B2B channel sales, dealer management

* Location: Navi Mumbai

**About us:**

Headquartered in Denmark, GN Hearing is among the leading manufacturers of hearing aids in the world. The company offers a full range of instruments and accessories under several brands. The company has subsidiaries in more than 25 countries and distributors in 80 more. Driven by technological innovations and commercial excellence, GN Hearing has been the growing faster than the industry for the last many years.

In India, the hearing aid industry at wholesale prices is approximately INR 750 crores annually. Private retail consumption accounts for over 85% of the hearing aid market in revenue terms with the balance coming from government tenders. The market is growing @10~12% p.a. and likely to grow at these rates for the next decade due to very favorable demographics viz.

* 90% of hearing aid users are in the 50+ age group.
* They are living longer due to healthier lifestyles.
* Leading a more active retired life and would like to enjoy life with friends and family.
* Have the money to fund hearing aids.

In the hearing-impaired population, the hearing aid penetration level is only 2%. In developed countries the penetration is in the 20~40% levels.

In India, GN is headquartered in Navi Mumbai. In 2023, GN posted revenues of INR 131 cr (USD 16 mln). GN has been the fastest growing company since 2012 growing revenues @ 18% CAGR. GN is now the 2nd largest company in the lucrative retail market with a 20% market share, up from 5% market share in 2011. GN is the most profitable company in the industry with the highest % EBITA margin. Leadership in technology, a clear India strategy and strong execution have been the drivers of this performance.

Given the strong momentum, GN has an opportunity to drive growth higher than the current already high rate. GN has put in place aggressive plans for the 2023~2025 strategy period. The strategy involves executing on multiple key sales initiatives in parallel with speed and accuracy. GN operates through a direct dealer network of about 700 customers. The larger key customers account for a disproportionate share of the industry potential and consequently GNs business.

Hearing aids are dispensed as a medical device and the dealer (dispenser) makes the brand choice. Among other things, fast, accurate and at times customized service solutions to these larger customers are important to succeed with them. The customized solutions tend to put a strain on operations increasing complexity. The relatively small size of the business is deceptive when compared to the complexity of the challenges involved.

Working technical knowledge of ITMS components: GPS/AVLS, AIS-140 VLTDs, PIS displays, CCTV/VMS, ICCC, cloud vs on-prem hosting, SLA monitoring.

High integrity and a clean professional record in government dealings.

Major Responsibilities

* Build and maintain a 12-18-month opportunity pipeline for ITMS, AVLS/VTS, PIS, CCTV surveillance, ICCC and fleet-management projects.
* Monitor central schemes driving demand - PM e-Bus Sewa, FAME/PM E-DRIVE, Smart Cities Mission, Nirbhaya Fund (VLTD/panic button), AIS-140 mandates.

**2. Pre-Bid Shaping**

* Engage clients before RFPs are floated: product demos, PoCs, site visits and technical presentations.
* Influence technical specifications and eligibility criteria within ethical and procurement-rule limits.
* Draft and submit pre-bid queries; represent the company at pre-bid meetings.

**3. Bid Management**

* Run go/no-go decisions using a documented bid-qualification framework (fit, eligibility, competition, margin, risk).
* Own the full bid calendar: RFP analysis, compliance matrix, technical proposal, commercial bid, EMD/BG, DSC-based e-submission.
* Coordinate internal teams - solution architects, delivery, finance, legal - to meet every deadline with zero disqualifications.
* Structure consortia, OEM tie-ups and MAFs (manufacturer authorisation forms) where eligibility or scope demands it.
* Prepare and deliver technical presentations to evaluation committees.

**4. Commercials and contracting**

* Build pricing with finance: CAPEX/OPEX models, per-bus-per-month pricing, O&M and SLA-linked payments.
* Analyse risk in contract terms - liquidated damages, SLA penalties, performance bank guarantees, payment milestones, IP and data clauses.
* Lead negotiations and post-award formalities through to LoA, agreement signing and kick-off.

**5. Client management and growth**

* Act as the senior relationship owner for awarded accounts; resolve escalations with transport department officials.
* Drive change requests, scope extensions, renewals and replication of successful deployments into other states.
* Collect and maintain work-completion certificates, performance certificates and references that strengthen future eligibility.

**6. Governance and reporting**

* Maintain a bid repository: past proposals, compliance templates, credentials, CVs, certifications.
* Report weekly to leadership on pipeline, bid status, win/loss and competitor pricing.
* Run structured win/loss reviews after every result, including RTI or debrief requests where useful.
* Ensure full compliance with GFR 2017, CVC guidelines, Make-in-India / PPP-MII preference rules and the company's anti-bribery policy.

**Functional Competency**

1.  Government stakeholder management

2.  Tender / RFP analysis & compliance

5.     Analytical thinking and decision-making capability.

title: Business Development Manager - CEO's Office
description:
We're looking for one person who wants a real chance, not a desk job.

Zero Drive, the electric heavy-haul arm of Shri Dinesh Group, already runs electric trailers across India. Now we're building India's first charging network for electric trucks. You won't be the 50th person on a big team. You'll be the first, and what you build will carry your name.

Location: Thane, with frequent travel across India

Experience: 0 to 3 years (freshers welcome) | Education: MBA preferred

ABOUT ZERO DRIVE

Zero Drive is the electric heavy-haul arm of Shri Dinesh Group, a 30+ year old crane and logistics group. We already run electric trailers across India for one of the world's largest construction equipment makers. Our tagline is "Electrifying India's Highways", and we mean it literally.

WHO YOU WILL WORK WITH

You will work directly with Kartik Joshi (IIT Kharagpur, ex-OYO), who leads Zero Drive, and Shipra Joshi, VP Growth & Strategy at Zero Drive, who is leading our charging network strategy. You'll see how decisions are made, and you'll make some of them.

WHAT YOU WILL DO

- Build the charging network from zero: scout highway sites, evaluate land, deal with property owners, and work with power companies on grid connections.

- Win partnerships: approach oil companies (IOCL, BPCL, HPCL), state agencies and NHAI for charging sites and government tenders.

- Grow the freight business: find transporters and companies moving heavy loads who are ready to switch to electric, and turn them into customers.

- Work with numbers: build the business case for every site and recommend yes or no with data.

- Own it end to end: take every site and deal from first call to signed paper, with clear weekly updates.

WHO WE ARE LOOKING FOR

- MBA (or equivalent); freshers and people with up to 3 years in business development, sales, infrastructure, EV, energy, logistics or consulting

- Comfortable on highways and at sites as much as in meetings

- Good with Excel and simple numbers

- Speaks Hindi and English comfortably; Marathi or Gujarati is a plus

- Above all, ownership: you follow up without being chased, close every loop, and bring solutions, not just problems

BE HONEST WITH YOURSELF BEFORE YOU APPLY

This is not a comfortable job. You'll spend days on highways, deal with landowners and power offices, and hear "no" often. If that excites you more than it scares you, apply.

WHAT YOU EARN

- ₹8 lakh per year CTC (₹60,000 monthly gross)

- Uncapped performance bonus: ₹1,00,000 for every charging site signed, and 1% of billing from every new freight customer you bring in, for their first 12 months

- Travel expenses paid on actuals

WHERE THIS LEADS

Perform well and this role grows into heading our charging business as it scales.

HOW TO APPLY

We don't review applications on LinkedIn. We read every email.

If this role excites you, write to hr@shridinesh.com with:

- Subject: BDM Zero Drive | Your Name

- Your CV

- Why this role, in 5 lines or less

- One thing you started and finished on your own, without anyone asking or chasing you (3 to 5 lines)

Follow this format exactly. How carefully you apply tells us how carefully you'll work.

title: Psf Sales Executive
description:
**Company Description**
Bajaj Housing Finance Limited (BHFL) is an ‘Upper-Layer NBFC’ classified by the Reserve Bank of India under Scale Based Regulations and is a subsidiary of Bajaj Finance Limited, one of India’s most diversified non-banking financial companies. Headquartered in Pune and serving more than 128 million customers nationwide through the Bajaj group, BHFL provides financing solutions to individuals and corporate entities for purchasing and renovating homes and commercial spaces. The company offers loans against property for business and personal needs, as well as working capital financing to support business expansion. BHFL also extends funding to developers for residential and commercial projects and provides lease rental discounting to developers and high-net-worth individuals. The company holds strong credit ratings of AAA/Stable for long-term debt and A1+ for short-term debt from CRISIL and India Ratings, reflecting its financial stability and market credibility.
  
**Role Description**
The Psf Sales Executive is a full-time, on-site role based in Thane, focused on driving retail housing finance sales through direct customer engagement and channel management. Responsibilities include identifying and acquiring new customers, explaining loan products and eligibility criteria, and guiding applicants through documentation and onboarding. The role involves maintaining relationships with channel partners, builders, and referral sources to generate leads and achieve assigned sales and revenue targets. The Psf Sales Executive will conduct regular market visits, follow up on leads, ensure timely processing of applications, and deliver a high standard of customer service while adhering to company policies and compliance requirements. The role also requires preparing basic sales reports, updating CRM systems, and sharing market insights with the team to support business growth.
  
**Qualifications**
  

* Strong sales and business development skills, including lead generation, negotiation, and closing to achieve assigned targets.
* Customer relationship management abilities, with a focus on clear communication, service orientation, and trust-building.
* Basic knowledge of housing finance or retail lending products, with an understanding of documentation, eligibility, and compliance requirements.
* Ability to work on-site in Thane, conduct regular field visits, and collaborate effectively with internal teams and external partners.
* Proficiency in MS Office and basic CRM tools, with the ability to maintain accurate records and prepare simple sales reports.
* Preferred educational background: graduate degree in business, finance, commerce, or a related field; prior experience in housing finance or NBFC/banking sales is an advantage.
* Strong ethical standards, resilience under pressure, and a results-driven mindset aligned with regulatory and organizational guidelines.

The KAM is the single commercial point of contact at these accounts for spare parts, M-Powered contracts, retrofits and any other new AM offerings, and is responsible for converting whitespace into recurring aftermarket revenue.
  
  
**Key Responsibilities**

* Deliver the assigned account-level AM revenue target across spares, M-Powered, retrofits and new AM products
* Convert whitespaces in assigned regions – identify under-penetrated SKUs, machines and product categories and activate them
* Build and protect Milacron's entitlement value (SOM) capture at each account

**Customer Engagement & Coverage**

* Build relationships across plant-level and corporate-level decision-makers (maintenance, procurement, plant heads)
* Handle commercial and service-related escalations in coordination with the Regional Service team (Regional Service Managers and Service Engineers)

**Contracting & Upsell**

* Push Milacron spare part sales, consumable kits, and structured replacement programs
* Drive M-Powered contract closures; build the pipeline at the account level
* Coordinate with Service Engineers to convert any SE-flagged upsell opportunities in their accounts into closed orders

**Reporting & Governance**

* Maintain accurate account, opportunity and visit data in CRM / MIS
* Submit weekly coverage reports and monthly account reviews to the Regional Aftermarket Head

**SUCCESS METRICS / KPIS**

**Customer Coverage**
**Operational Discipline**

* Account AM revenue vs. target (primary KPI)
* SOM capture % at assigned customers
* M-Powered penetration in assigned accounts
* Customer visits per week / calls per week (PJP adherence %)
* Customer NPS at assigned accounts
* Whitespace accounts activated

* On-time submission of weekly / monthly reports

**Key Skill Requirements**

* Strong product and spare-parts knowledge (injection moulding preferred)

* Strong communication skills and resilience

Account Head - Acquisitions is an Individual Contributor who sells Infobip products to new Infobip customers and generates net new business. The role identifies and generates new business opportunities and pursues leads which are provided against a focused target account list.

**Why you'll love it here**

* Flexible work arrangements - We combine in-person collaboration with remote work and flexible working hours, because great ideas happen everywhere - and not always between 9 and 5.

* Career mobility - Your career is a journey. With internal mobility, upskilling, and mentorship, we help you shape your path.
* Professional development - Learning never stops. Onboarding, mentorship, and training programs help you grow - no matter where you start.

title: Sales Manager for Mumbai, India
description:
**Location: Mumbai, Maharashtra, India**
Are you a results-driven sales professional with a passion for developing customer relationships and delivering sustainable business growth? Do you thrive in a technical sales environment where innovation, customer focus, and strategic thinking drive success?
  
  
At DEIF, we are currently looking for a full-time Area Sales Manager to strengthen our presence in Western India by expanding our customer base, increasing market share, and delivering value-driven power management, automation, and energy management solutions.
  
  
DEIF A/S is a worldwide leader in power efficiency, and we are on a journey to make a real difference in the world. We pursue an ambitious growth strategy and strive to be a global trendsetter in power-efficient products and intelligent control solutions. Our ambition is to be the preferred partner for efficient power management, recognized for our innovative platforms, technical expertise, and customer-centric approach.
  
  
**About The Job**
As our new Area Sales Manager, you will be responsible for driving sales growth across your assigned territory by identifying new business opportunities, strengthening relationships with existing customers, and executing DEIF's sales strategy to achieve ambitious business targets.
  
  
Working closely with customers, distributors, consultants, OEMs, EPC contractors, system integrators, panel builders, and internal stakeholders, you will play a key role in expanding DEIF's market presence while ensuring exceptional customer satisfaction and long-term business partnerships.
  
  
This position is based in
**Mumbai**
and reports to the Deputy General Manager - Sales West. The role involves extensive travel across the assigned territory.
  
  
**Working Tasks & Responsibilities**

* Develop and execute sales strategies to achieve and exceed sales targets within the assigned territory.
* Identify new business opportunities and expand DEIF’s market presence across Power Generation, Industrial Automation, Data Centres, BESS, Renewable Energy, and Marine sectors.
* Build and maintain strong relationships with OEMs, EPC contractors, consultants, system integrators, panel builders, distributors, and end users.
* Promote DEIF’s technical solutions, including Generator Controllers, Power Management Systems (PMS), PLCs, SCADA, Protection Relays, and Energy Management solutions.
* Understand customer applications and provide value-driven technical solutions aligned with their power management and automation requirements.
* Prepare, negotiate, and close techno-commercial proposals, quotations, and supply agreements.
* Drive the complete sales cycle, from lead generation and customer engagement to technical discussions, negotiations, and order closure.
* Conduct customer visits, product presentations, demonstrations, technical discussions, seminars, and workshops to generate business and secure product approvals.
* Monitor market trends, competitor activities, customer requirements, and emerging technologies to identify new business opportunities.
* Collaborate with Engineering, Operations, Service & Support, Product Management, and Channel Partners for effective solution development and project execution.
* Maintain accurate sales pipelines, customer information, forecasts, and opportunities through the CRM system.
* Provide regular sales forecasts, market intelligence, and business performance updates to management and travel extensively across the assigned territory.

**What You'll Bring**

* Bachelor's degree or diploma in Electrical, Electronics, Instrumentation, or a related discipline.
* 8–12 years of experience in B2B technical sales, project sales, business development, or account management, preferably in the power, electrical, automation, or energy sector.
* Strong technical knowledge of Generator Controls, Generator Controllers, Power Management Systems (PMS), PLCs, SCADA, Protection Systems/Relays, and Energy Management Systems.
* Good understanding of power generation and DG applications, including generator control, synchronization, load sharing, power management, and electrical protection.
* Working knowledge of industrial automation, PLC-based control systems, SCADA, control panels, and system integration.
* Knowledge of BESS, hybrid power systems, renewable energy, and energy management solutions will be an advantage.
* Experience working with OEMs, EPCs, consultants, system integrators, panel builders, distributors, and end customers.
* Strong ability to understand technical requirements and convert them into practical, value-added solutions and techno-commercial proposals.
* Proven track record of achieving sales targets and managing the complete sales cycle from prospecting to order closure.
* Strong commercial, negotiation, presentation, communication, and stakeholder management skills.
* Experience with CRM systems, sales pipeline management, forecasting, and reporting.
* Willingness to travel extensively within the assigned territory.

**What Makes You Successful**
You are a commercially driven and customer-focused professional who enjoys building long-term partnerships and identifying opportunities that create value for customers. You combine strong business insight with technical knowledge and are motivated by achieving ambitious sales targets.
  
  
You have the ability to understand technical customer requirements, engage confidently with engineering and technical stakeholders, and position the right power management, automation, and energy solutions for the application.
  
  
You communicate effectively with stakeholders at all levels, demonstrate resilience when facing challenges, and excel in developing practical solutions that meet customer needs. Your collaborative mindset enables you to work successfully across functions while maintaining accountability for delivering results.
  
  
Above all, you are proactive, adaptable, technically curious, and passionate about contributing to DEIF's continued growth through innovation, customer excellence, and sustainable business development.
  
  
**Why Join DEIF?**
At DEIF, you'll become part of a global organization committed to innovation, sustainability, and empowering people. We offer a collaborative and inclusive work environment where your ideas are valued, your development is supported, and your contributions make a meaningful impact.
  
  
As part of our ambitious growth journey, you'll have the opportunity to work with industry-leading technologies, collaborate with talented colleagues across the globe, and help shape the future of intelligent power management, automation, and energy management solutions.
  
  
If you're ready to grow your career with a company that values innovation, teamwork, and customer success, we'd love to hear from you.
  
  
Cover letters are encouraged as part of your application.
  
  
At DEIF, we are Winning Together!
  
  
We promise you'll experience a culture based on values such as Ambitions, Perspective, and Respect, where we are Winning Together. We are a global company and work in many different locations – however, we are all united by a wish to make our customers and colleagues succeed. You'll experience a highly professional work environment where continuous learning, empowerment, and collaboration is essential.
  
  
We are in a continuous process of developing new intelligent products and solutions that can contribute to accelerating the green transition. Sustainability is central to our business, and we have recently been recognized in the EY Entrepreneur of The Year 2023, where we won the award in the ESG category.
  
  
Curious to learn more about the benefits of working at DEIF? Delve into the details by visiting our career page at
**https://career.deif.com**

**Folk Objects | Full-time | Mumbai (Hybrid)**

About Folk Objects

Folk Objects is a design-led home and living brand bringing together thoughtful design, distinctive objects and products for considered spaces. We work at the intersection of product, craft and contemporary living, with an ambition to build relationships with designers, architects and creative communities across the world.

About the Role

We’re looking for a Business Development, Partnerships & PR Manager to grow Folk Objects’ presence in India and international markets.

You’ll build relationships with architects, interior designers, independent creatives, design studios and relevant media, creating opportunities for our products to reach new audiences and become part of exciting projects around the world.

The role combines business development, community outreach, creative collaborations and PR. You’ll be responsible for identifying the right people and opportunities, initiating relationships, developing partnerships and executing campaigns that build both brand visibility and commercial growth.

This is a hands-on role for someone who is commercially driven, genuinely interested in design, and excited about building a globally relevant design brand.

What You’ll Do

**1. Global Business Development**

* Identify and build relationships with architects, interior designers, hospitality designers, design studios and other relevant trade buyers across India and international markets.
* Develop targeted outreach strategies to introduce Folk Objects’ products and collections to design professionals.
* Build and manage a pipeline of trade enquiries, project opportunities, bulk orders and repeat B2B business.
* Understand project requirements and connect designers with relevant products and furnishing solutions from our catalogue.
* Explore opportunities to get Folk Objects products specified in residential, hospitality and commercial projects.
* Develop relationships with international stockists, retail partners and potential distribution partners where relevant.
* Track outreach, meetings, leads, proposals and conversions to drive measurable business growth.

**2. Designer & Creative Partnerships**

* Build relationships with independent designers, artists, makers, photographers, stylists and other creatives.
* Identify opportunities for co-created collections, limited-edition products, creative collaborations and editorial projects.
* Develop partnership proposals that create value for both Folk Objects and its collaborators.
* Explore collaborations with complementary design brands, studios and creative businesses.
* Build a network of creatives who can contribute to the brand’s products, storytelling and visibility.

**3. Design Community & Outreach**

* Build and nurture a community of architects, interior designers and creative professionals around Folk Objects.
* Identify relevant design events, exhibitions, trade fairs, industry gatherings and networking opportunities in India and internationally.
* Organise or support designer meet-ups, product previews, studio visits and intimate community gatherings.
* Develop ongoing engagement with the design community through personalised outreach and meaningful interactions.
* Identify opportunities to showcase projects featuring Folk Objects products and build relationships through shared visibility.

**4. PR & Brand Visibility**

* Plan and execute PR campaigns to build Folk Objects’ visibility across design, architecture, interiors, lifestyle and relevant business publications.
* Build relationships with editors, journalists, publications, stylists and other media contacts in priority markets.
* Pitch product features, collection launches, founder stories, creative collaborations and brand narratives.
* Develop press lists, campaign calendars, pitches and press materials in collaboration with the internal team.
* Identify relevant design awards, exhibitions, editorial opportunities and industry platforms.
* Build sustained brand recognition rather than relying only on one-off media coverage.

**5. Strategy, Reporting & Execution**

* Map priority markets, target audiences and partnership opportunities.
* Build and maintain a structured database of designers, architects, creatives, media contacts and prospective trade partners.
* Manage outreach and follow-ups through a CRM or other tracking tools.
* Track key metrics, including qualified leads, project enquiries, active partnerships, revenue generated and PR placements.
* Work closely with the design, product, sales and marketing teams to translate opportunities into tangible outcomes.

What We’re Looking For

* 3–6 years of experience in business development, partnerships, PR or community outreach.
* Experience in interiors, architecture, furniture, home, lifestyle, design or another creative industry is strongly preferred.
* Excellent written and verbal communication skills, including personalised outreach and partnership pitching.
* Confidence in building relationships with senior professionals, both in India and internationally.
* An understanding of how architects and interior designers discover and specify products for their projects.
* Experience developing partnerships, executing PR campaigns or building professional communities.
* Strong organisational skills and the ability to manage multiple relationships and opportunities simultaneously.
* A proactive, resourceful approach with a clear focus on outcomes.

You’ll Be a Great Fit If You

* Have a genuine interest in design, architecture, interiors, craft and contemporary living.
* Enjoy building relationships from scratch and turning conversations into opportunities.
* Can balance commercial goals with thoughtful, long-term partnerships.
* Are comfortable reaching out to people across geographies and building a credible case for why they should work with Folk Objects.
* Have a global outlook and are curious about international design communities.
* Can move comfortably between a commercial conversation with an interior design studio, a creative collaboration with an independent artist and a PR pitch to a design editor.
* Are self-driven, organised and comfortable owning outcomes from idea to execution.

What Success Looks Like

* A growing network of architects, interior designers and trade partners in India and international markets.
* Qualified project enquiries, product specifications, bulk orders and repeat B2B business.
* Meaningful creative collaborations that strengthen the Folk Objects brand.
* Consistent PR coverage and increased visibility across relevant design and lifestyle platforms.
* A growing community of design professionals who engage with, specify and recommend Folk Objects.
* Measurable contribution to brand awareness, partnerships and revenue growth.

To Apply

Please share your CV and a brief overview of your experience in business development, partnerships, PR or community building. Include examples of partnerships, campaigns or business relationships you have personally developed.

**Location:**
Mumbai, Maharashtra

**Work Model:**
Hybrid

**Employment Type:**
Full-time

title: National Sales Manager - Corporate Hospital
description:
**Job Title**
National Sales Manager
  
  
**Business Unit**
Alternate Trade, GT & Institution Head

Mumbai, India
  
  
At Sun Pharma, we commit to helping you
**“Create your own sunshine”**
— by fostering an environment where you grow at every step, take charge of your journey and thrive in a supportive community.
  
  
**Are You Ready to Create Your Own Sunshine?**
As you enter the Sun Pharma world, you’ll find yourself becoming ‘Better every day’ through continuous progress. Exhibit self-drive as you ‘Take charge’ and lead with confidence. Additionally, demonstrate a collaborative spirit, knowing that we ‘Thrive together’ and support each other’s journeys.”
  
  
**Profile Summary**
Sun Pharma is looking for a National Sales Manager (NSM) – Corporate Hospital Business to lead and drive the growth of its Corporate Hospital Business across India.
  
  
The role will be responsible for business strategy, market-share growth, key hospital partnerships, institutional sales excellence, portfolio expansion and execution across the national hospital ecosystem. The incumbent will work closely with Sales teams, Marketing, Distribution and other cross-functional teams to build a strong, sustainable and future-ready hospital business.
  
  
This is a strategic leadership role requiring deep expertise in the exclusive hospital business, strong commercial acumen and established relationships with senior hospital stakeholders, particularly Procurement, SCM and Purchase leadership.
  
  
**Key Responsibilities**

* National Business Leadership

Own and drive the national Corporate Hospital Business, with accountability for growth, profitability, market share and business performance.
  
  
Develop and execute annual business plans, forecasts, budgets and growth strategies for the hospital channel.
  
  
Identify opportunities for geographical expansion, deeper hospital penetration and business development across Metro, Tier 1, Tier 2 and Tier 3 markets.
  
  
Track market dynamics, competitive landscape and regional performance, translating insights into actionable business strategies.
  
  
Drive sustainable growth through strategic account management and institutional business development.
  
  

* Corporate Hospital Business

Lead business development across large corporate hospital chains, standalone hospitals, trust accounts.
  
  
Build and strengthen strategic relationships with senior hospital decision-makers and key stakeholders.
  
  
Establish strong engagement with hospital SCM, Procurement, Purchase and Commercial leadership.
  
  
Drive hospital empanelment, formulary inclusion, explore business opportunities with new brand inclusions.
  
  
Develop and manage strategic relationships with key hospital networks and purchasing organisations.
  
  
Ensure strong execution of hospital-specific business plans and account strategies.
  
  

* Strategic Account Management

Develop a robust Key Account Management framework for top corporate hospital groups and strategic institutions.
  
  
Map decision-making structures and build relationships across hospital management, procurement, SCM, Purchase, clinical stakeholders and other influencers.
  
  
Identify and unlock new business opportunities within existing and emerging hospital networks.
  
  
Drive long-term partnerships with key institutional customers rather than transactional business relationships.
  
  

* Portfolio Expansion & New Product Launches

Identify portfolio gaps and market opportunities within the hospital channel.
  
  
Work closely with Marketing, distribution and Sales teams to develop a competitive hospital portfolio and channel strategy.
  
  
Drive launch excellence and new product availability across key institutions.
  
  
Ensure effective product placement, availability and execution within hospitals.
  
  
Monitor supply chain performance and proactively address product availability and service challenges.
  
  

* Team Leadership & Capability Building

Lead, coach and develop a high-performing national hospital business team comprising regional/zonal and frontline teams.
  
  
Build capabilities in institutional selling, strategic account management, hospital access, negotiation and stakeholder engagement.
  
  
Establish a strong performance culture with clear objectives, review mechanisms and accountability.
  
  
Develop talent and succession capability for the hospital business.
  
  

* Cross-Functional & Stakeholder Management

Partner closely with Supply Chain, Procurement, Finance, Marketing, Medical, Sales and Digital teams to deliver business objectives.
  
  
Drive effective coordination between commercial strategy and operational execution.
  
  
Represent the organisation at relevant hospital forums, industry platforms, conferences and strategic customer engagements.
  
  
Ensure adherence to company policies, compliance standards and established SOPs.
  
  

* Digital & Data-Driven Business Excellence

Drive adoption of CRM, analytics and digital tools across the hospital business.
  
  
Use business intelligence and performance dashboards to identify opportunities, track execution and improve productivity.
  
  
Build data-led approaches to customer segmentation, account prioritisation, forecasting and business planning.
  
  
Identify opportunities for technology-enabled hospital engagement and future-ready business models.
  
  
**Travel Estimate**
80%
  
  
**Job Requirements**
**Educational Qualification**
Graduate in Science/Pharmacy; MBA/PGDM preferred.
  
  
**Experience**
Minimum 10 years of exclusive Pharma Hospital Business experience.
  
  
Mandatory minimum 5 years of exclusive Hospital Business experience in a National role or having handled minimum 3 zones out of 4 zones in Pan India leadership role.
  
  
Only candidates with exclusive Hospital Business experience should apply.
  
  
Well-versed with the top-end corporate hospital ecosystem and senior hospital management.
  
  
Established relationships with senior stakeholders in SCM, Procurement, Purchase and Commercial functions of leading hospitals.
  
  
Strong understanding of the Indian hospital ecosystem and corporate hospital business models.
  
  
Proven track record of delivering business growth, strategic account development and large institutional business
  
  
**Your Success Matters to Us**
At Sun Pharma, your success and well-being are our top priorities! We provide robust benefits and opportunities to foster personal and professional growth. Join us at Sun Pharma, where every day is an opportunity to grow, collaborate, and make a lasting impact. Let’s create a brighter future together!

title: Sales Manager – Robotics Division
description:
Sales Manager – Robotics Division

Lead robotics sales at the first company in India to design, manufacture and assemble robots and AMRs in-house. Building India's robotics market from the front line is a priceless opportunity.

Sell cobots, industrial robots, AMRs, AGVs, humanoids and robot dogs, including Fairino, Yasaka, Unitree and Hiwin Robotics, to manufacturers across India.

Location: Navi Mumbai (Koparkhairane) HQ, with PAN India sales responsibility and regular travel to customer sites

Department: Robotics Division – Sales

Reporting to: Head – Sales / Business Head

Employment Type: Full-time

Experience: 5+ years, preferably in robotics, cobot or industrial automation sales

The Role

You will own sales for Luna's Robotics Division across India. You will build the strategy, grow key accounts and a strong pipeline, and lead a team of sales engineers. Working with our Field Application Engineers and Managers, you will turn customer problems into robot and AMR solutions, from first meeting and demo to order, commissioning and repeat business.

What You Will Do

• Sales strategy: build and run the robotics sales plan, choose target industries and regions, and set the market-entry approach for new products.

• Solution selling: sell robot, cobot, AMR/AGV, humanoid and robot dog solutions to manufacturers, from discovery and application study to proposal, negotiation and closure.

• Key accounts: own relationships with major customers and grow them into long-term partnerships with repeat orders.

• Pipeline: generate leads, qualify opportunities and keep a healthy, well-documented CRM pipeline.

• Demos and commissioning: work with the FAE/FAM team on demos, proof-of-concept trials, feasibility and smooth commissioning and handover.

• Channel partners: build and manage system integrators, distributors and channel partners to extend our reach across India.

• Team leadership: hire, train, set targets for, coach and motivate the robotics sales team, and build a high-performance sales culture.

• Targets: own order booking and revenue targets, track KPIs and take corrective action early.

• Forecasting and reporting: share accurate forecasts, pipeline reviews and sales reports with management.

• Market insight: track trends, competitors and emerging applications, and represent Luna at exhibitions and industry events.

• Collaboration: share field feedback with marketing, product, operations and our in-house robot design team to shape new products and offers.

• Customer success: support customers through the sales cycle and, with service and technical teams, resolve issues quickly.

Applications You Will Sell Into

Welding, laser cutting, palletizing, material handling, machine tending, assembly, gluing, intralogistics and warehouse automation, flexible manufacturing, metal processing, semiconductor, 3C electronics and new retail.

Must Have

• BE / B.Tech / Diploma in Mechanical, Mechatronics, Robotics, Electrical, Electronics, Instrumentation, Automation or a related discipline.

• 5+ years in B2B technical sales, preferably selling robots, cobots, AMRs or industrial automation.

• Proven record of meeting sales targets and closing solution sales with manufacturing customers.

• Strong understanding of robotics and industrial automation (robot arms, controllers, servo, drives, motion control, PLC, HMI).

• Experience managing key accounts and working with channel partners or system integrators.

• Excellent communication, presentation and negotiation skills; able to explain technical products in business language.

• Self-motivated, result-oriented and willing to travel across India.

Good to Have

• Experience selling ABB, FANUC, KUKA, Yaskawa, Universal Robots or similar robots is a plus.

• AMR/AGV, warehouse automation or intralogistics sales experience.

• Experience leading or mentoring a sales team.

• Existing network among OEMs, automotive, electronics, FMCG, pharma or general manufacturing customers.

• Familiarity with CRM tools and consultative selling methods.

What You Will Learn

Leading a robotics sales team; selling robotic systems, cobots, AMRs and humanoids across real applications; Luna's Solution Finder and consultative selling approach; robotics and laser automation workflows; and end-to-end B2B solution sales, from lead to repeat business.

Why Luna

• Be part of an India first: Luna designs, manufactures and assembles robots and AMRs in-house. Sell products built by our own team, alongside Fairino, Yasaka, Unitree and Hiwin Robotics. A priceless opportunity.

• A product range that opens doors: cobots, industrial robots, AMRs, AGVs, humanoids and robot dogs, so you can offer every customer a complete solution.

• Real ownership: shape the strategy, build your team and make fast decisions, with direct access to leadership.

• Grow as we grow: as the Robotics Division scales, your role grows into senior sales and business leadership.

• Strong technical backing: a dedicated FAE/FAM team for demos, trials and commissioning, so you can focus on winning business.

• Keep learning: principal and OEM trainings, manufacturer certifications, national and international exhibitions, and new tech in mobile robotics, vision and AI.

• Get rewarded: competitive compensation, performance-linked incentives, recognition for top performers and a friendly, growing team.

About Luna Technologies

Luna Technologies Pvt. Ltd., headquartered in Navi Mumbai (Koparkhairane), is the first company in India to design, manufacture and assemble robots and AMRs in-house. We also deliver industrial automation, motion control and mechatronics solutions with global technology partners. www.luna.co.in

How to Apply

Email your resume to recruitment3@luna.co.in and recruitment1@luna.co.in with the subject "Sales Manager – Robotics".

Luna Technologies Pvt. Ltd. is an Equal Opportunity Employer.

Agrocorp International is seeking a commercially driven and results-oriented Business Development Manager to grow Agrocorp Food Ingredients’ product portfolio and market presence in India. Based in Mumbai, this role will focus on driving sales and profitability, developing new business opportunities, and expanding customer relationships across the food, beverage and nutraceutical industries.

* Sales & Business Development
* Develop and execute sales strategies to expand Agrocorp Food Ingredients’ product portfolio and market share in India.

* Identify opportunities to expand product applications, customer segments and market reach.

* Commercial & Working Capital Management
* Monitor customer accounts receivable and ensure timely collection of outstanding payments.
* Manage inventory levels and stock ageing within acceptable business parameters.
* Support effective working capital management while balancing sales growth and commercial risks.
* Work closely with Customer Service and relevant internal teams to ensure the timely registration of customers, vendors and materials in Agrocorp’s ERP systems.
* Cross-Functional Collaboration
* Collaborate with the Business Head, suppliers, Customer Service and other internal stakeholders to ensure seamless execution of business activities.
* Provide timely updates on sales performance, pipeline development, market opportunities and customer requirements.

* Bachelor’s degree in Food Science, Chemistry, Chemical Engineering or a related discipline.
* 5–10 years of experience in sales or business development, preferably within food ingredients distribution or related industries.
* Proven experience in the food, beverage or nutraceutical sectors, with a strong understanding of ingredient markets and customer applications.
* Demonstrated track record of achieving sales and gross profit targets and developing new business accounts.
* Experience in customer negotiations, pricing strategy, account management and commercial risk assessment.
* Strong understanding of market dynamics, competitive positioning and working capital management.
