* Entrepreneurial mindset: Proactive hunter mentality with a strong drive to identify and capture new business opportunities.
* Commercial acumen: Strong understanding of sales, profitability, pricing and commercial negotiations.
* Strategic thinking: Ability to identify growth opportunities and translate market insights into actionable business strategies.
* Adaptability: Comfortable working in an evolving business environment with ambiguity and changing priorities.
* Relationship building: Excellent interpersonal, influencing and stakeholder management skills.
* Analytical ability: Strong analytical skills with the ability to interpret market data and identify business opportunities.
* Execution excellence: Highly organised, systematic and detail-oriented, with strong follow-through.
* Initiative and accountability: Self-motivated, results-driven and willing to take calculated risks to achieve business objectives.
* Customer focus: Committed to understanding customer needs and delivering sustainable commercial value.
* Collaboration: Effective team player who can work across functions and engage with diverse, multicultural stakeholders.

Agrocorp International is a leading global agri-commodities company, connecting farmers, processors, and markets across key regions worldwide. title: Regional Business Development  - West
description:
Job Description

Regional Business Development – West Region

SUMMARY

The Regional Business Development role will be responsible for driving
**profitable network expansion and New Store Openings across the West Region**
in alignment with the overall business plan and expansion strategy of the Brand.

The role will lead
**market identification, catchment development, property scouting, feasibility assessment, commercial negotiations and end-to-end closure of new store opportunities**
across both
**High Street and Mall formats**
. The position will work closely with Operations, Finance, Projects, Legal and other stakeholders to ensure timely and commercially viable store openings.

The role will also be responsible for building a strong
**property pipeline, identifying new markets and clusters, and continuously improving the quality and profitability of the regional store network**
.

KEY RESPONSIBILITIES

Regional Market Strategy & Expansion Planning

* Drive the
  **West Region expansion strategy**
  in line with the organization’s Pan-India business plan and annual NSO targets.
* Identify and prioritize
  **new cities, markets, clusters and catchments**
  based on market potential, customer demographics, competition and business opportunity.
* Develop short-term and long-term
  **market reach and penetration plans**
  for the region.
* Conduct regular market and competition mapping to identify emerging retail markets and expansion opportunities.
* Develop and maintain a
  **state-wise and city-wise property pipeline**
  covering High Streets, Malls and other relevant retail destinations.
* Identify white spaces and under-penetrated markets to support future network expansion.
* Provide market intelligence and expansion recommendations to the Head – Business Development.

Property Identification & Evaluation

* Generate, validate and evaluate property leads across the West Region.
* Identify suitable
  **High Street and Mall properties**
  based on catchment potential, visibility, accessibility, size, frontage, competition and commercial viability.
* Conduct property visits and assessments in coordination with Operations and relevant stakeholders.
* Evaluate the suitability of buildings, locations and catchments against the required store formats and business requirements.
* Build strong relationships with
  **landlords, developers, mall management teams, property consultants and brokers**
  to strengthen the property pipeline.
* Maintain an updated database of available, upcoming and potential properties across the region.

Business Feasibility & Commercial Evaluation

* Lead the preparation of
  **market feasibility and business cases**
  for identified properties.
* Work closely with Finance to prepare and validate
  **PFR, IRR, ROI and other financial feasibility parameters**
  .
* Conduct cluster analysis and assess sales potential, occupancy cost, investment requirements and profitability.
* Ensure proposed locations meet approved business and financial thresholds before proceeding for final approval.
* Benchmark rentals, deposits, CAM and other occupancy-related costs across comparable markets.
* Continuously identify opportunities to improve store economics and enhance profitability.

Commercial Negotiation & Property Closure

* Lead negotiations with landlords, developers and mall management for commercially viable terms.
* Negotiate
  **rent, lease tenure, escalation, deposits, CAM, fit-out period, rent-free period and landlord scope**
  to optimize store economics.
* Drive negotiations to achieve the best possible commercial terms while maintaining strategic location quality.
* Coordinate with Legal for title due diligence, documentation and agreement closure.
* Ensure timely closure of LOIs, lease agreements and other required documentation.
* Maintain strong relationships with key property stakeholders to create a sustainable regional property pipeline.

Post-Opening Performance & Expansion Effectiveness

* Track the performance of newly opened stores against approved
  **PFR / IRR / sales projections**
  .
* Analyze variances between projected and actual store performance and identify corrective actions.
* Capture learnings from new store openings and incorporate them into future site selection and feasibility assessments.
* Monitor the performance of new markets and clusters to identify opportunities for further expansion.
* Support the identification of locations that can strengthen overall network productivity and profitability.

Stakeholder & Cross-Functional Management

* Work closely with the
  **Head – Business Development**
  on regional expansion strategy, pipeline and NSO delivery.
* Partner with Operations for market assessment, catchment validation and store readiness.
* Partner with Finance for business case preparation, PFR/IRR validation and investment approvals.
* Partner with Projects and Design for store planning, fit-out and handover.
* Coordinate with Legal for due diligence, agreements and documentation.
* Work with IT and other support functions to ensure complete pre-opening readiness.
* Collaborate with Group Real Estate / relevant Business Development teams wherever opportunities for joint negotiations or property synergies exist.
* Provide regular
  **regional expansion MIS, pipeline reports and NSO dashboards**
  to leadership.

title: Executive – AMC Sales & Business Development
description:
**Company Description:**
Liaison Bank is a specialized service provider focused on comprehensive Licensing and Liaisoning solutions for businesses across multiple sectors. As a trusted vendor of Mahanagar Gas Limited, the organization has a strong presence in the energy industry and a proven record of managing complex regulatory requirements. The team supports clients by handling licensing processes and coordinating with government authorities, helping organizations remain compliant while concentrating on core business activities. With deep expertise in regulatory frameworks and efficient process management, Liaison Bank offers reliable, end-to-end compliance support. The company is committed to delivering accurate, timely, and customer-focused services that simplify regulatory obligations.

**Job Purpose**

To generate new business opportunities and acquire corporate clients for Liaison Bank's Annual Maintenance Contract (AMC), compliance, and related business services. The role involves identifying prospective customers, conducting client meetings, presenting service offerings, preparing proposals, following up on leads, and converting prospects into paying customers.

The ideal candidate should be proactive, target-oriented, confident in field sales, and capable of building strong relationships with business owners and corporate decision-makers.

Key Roles and Responsibilities

**A. Lead Generation & Business Development**

* Identify potential B2B customers across Mumbai and nearby commercial and industrial areas.
* Generate leads through cold calling, field visits, networking, referrals, and online research.
* Develop a database of prospective clients, including commercial establishments, offices, restaurants, hotels, hospitals, factories, warehouses, and real estate businesses.
* Identify customer requirements for AMC, maintenance support, compliance, and related services.

**B. AMC Sales & Client Acquisition**

* Promote and sell AMC packages and relevant service solutions offered by Liaison Bank.
* Explain service scope, benefits, contract terms, and renewal requirements to prospective clients.
* Schedule client meetings and conduct face-to-face sales presentations.
* Prepare quotations and commercial proposals in coordination with the concerned team.
* Follow up with prospects, negotiate within approved commercial limits, and close sales.
* Build a pipeline of recurring-revenue opportunities through new contracts and renewals.

**C. Client Relationship Management**

* Establish and maintain professional relationships with clients and key decision-makers.
* Understand customer needs and coordinate with internal teams to recommend suitable services.
* Ensure timely communication regarding proposals, contract status, and service requirements.
* Identify opportunities for repeat business, cross-selling, and upselling.

**D. Sales Targets & Reporting**

* Achieve assigned monthly and quarterly lead-generation, client-acquisition, and revenue targets.
* Maintain an updated record of leads, meetings, proposals, follow-ups, and closures in the CRM or sales MIS.
* Submit daily field visit reports and periodic sales performance updates.
* Track pending quotations, conversion ratios, AMC renewals, and sales pipeline progress.
* Coordinate with the operations and service delivery teams for customer onboarding and contract handover.

Educational Qualification & Experience

* Graduate in any discipline; a qualification in Business Administration, Marketing, or Sales will be an advantage.
* 1–3 years of experience in B2B field sales, business development, corporate sales, or service sales.
* Experience in AMC sales, facility management, technical services, compliance services, or recurring service contracts will be preferred.
* Freshers with strong communication skills and a demonstrable aptitude for field sales may also be considered.
* Working knowledge of MS Excel, email communication, and CRM tools is desirable.

Preferred Industry Background

Candidates from the following sectors will be preferred:

* AMC and maintenance services
* Facility management and building services
* Fire and safety services
* Electrical and technical services
* Licensing and regulatory compliance
* Government liaisoning and business consulting
* Real estate, construction, hospitality, and commercial services
* Other B2B service-based industries

Key Skills & Competencies

* Strong verbal communication and presentation skills.
* Lead generation, prospecting, and client acquisition.
* Negotiation, persuasion, and sales closure.
* Confidence in meeting new customers and decision-makers.
* Relationship management and effective follow-up.
* Target orientation and willingness to work in the field.
* Self-motivation, ownership, and a go-getter attitude.
* Professional conduct and timely reporting.

Key Performance Indicators (KPIs)

Performance will be measured against the following parameters:

1. Number of qualified leads generated.
2. Number of client meetings and field visits completed.
3. Number of new customers acquired.
4. Monthly AMC contract value and revenue achieved.
5. Lead-to-client conversion ratio.
6. Number and value of proposals submitted and closed.
7. AMC renewals and repeat business generated.
8. Accuracy of CRM updates and timely submission of sales reports.
9. Follow-up effectiveness and sales pipeline management.
10. Coordination for client onboarding and payment follow-ups, wherever applicable.

Compensation & Career Opportunity

* Annual CTC of up to ₹6 LPA, based on relevant experience and suitability.
* Performance-linked incentives, subject to company policy.
* Exposure to B2B sales, AMC contracts, corporate client acquisition, and business compliance solutions.
* Opportunity to grow within the Sales & Business Development function based on performance.

Ideal Candidate Profile

We are looking for a street-smart, energetic, and result-oriented sales professional who enjoys meeting clients, generating business opportunities, and closing deals. Candidates should be comfortable with 100% field-based sales, local travel across Mumbai, and working towards clearly defined revenue targets.

**Interested candidates who are Mumbai-based, actively seeking a job, and available to join at the earliest are encouraged to apply and share their CV at 90821 24622/9136655976.**

title: Sales Intern
description:
**Fiscus is hiring a sales intern to help sell AI-driven loan analysis to banks and NBFCs,

reporting to the Sales Head.

About Fiscus

Fiscus is the agentic layer for loan analysis, built by BridgeUp T ech in Mumbai. It covers

the full loan lifecycle, from the first bank statement to the final repayment.

Analyse: reads bank statements in any format, scanned or native, with 95%+

categorisation accuracy and a tampering check on every document.

Triangulate: cross-checks bureau tradelines against actual EMI outflows, and GST

turnover against banked revenue.

Decide: Fiscus Copilot answers credit questions in plain language, with every claim

traced to the exact statement page.

Monitor and collect: keeps watching borrower banking after disbursal, flags stress

early, and ranks collections queues by who can actually pay.

Our buyers are credit, risk and collections heads at banks and NBFCs. A full analysis takes

minutes instead of days. Learn more at fiscus.ai.

The role

You will build pipeline for an enterprise B2B product sold to some of the most demanding

buyers in India: bank and NBFC credit teams. Sales cycles run months, decisions involve

committees, and every claim gets tested on the buyer's own files.

This is not a calling-list job. You will learn how Indian lenders underwrite, find the right

person inside each institution, and get them to put Fiscus on a set of statements they

have already analysed. You will sit in on demos and pilots, and your work will feed directly

into revenue.

What you'll do

Build target lists: map banks, small finance banks, NBFCs and co-operative banks by

AUM, lending segment (MSME, business loans, LAP , working capital) and current bank

statement vendor.

Find the decision-makers: identify the Head of Credit, CRO, Head of Collections and

CTO at each account, and who influences them.

Run outbound: personalised email, LinkedIn and calls that lead to first meetings. Every

message should reference something specific to that lender.

Set up evaluations: coordinate side-by-side runs where prospects send statements

they have already analysed and we compare accuracy, depth and time.

Support demos and pilots: prepare account briefs before calls, take notes, and send

follow-ups within 24 hours.

Track competitors: keep a running view of incumbent bank statement analysers, their

pricing and where buyers say they fall short.

Keep the CRM honest: log every touch, keep stages accurate, and send a weekly

pipeline summary with numbers, not adjectives.

Feed marketing: log objections and questions from sales conversations so they

become blog posts, FAQs and LinkedIn content.

Who we're looking for

Must have

Final-year student or recent graduate in commerce, finance, economics, engineering or

an MBA programme.

Sharp written and spoken English. Y ou can write a four-line cold email a senior banker

will actually answer.

Comfort calling people far more senior than you, and hearing "no" without losing

momentum.

Working knowledge of Excel or Google Sheets.

Curiosity about how lending works, and willingness to learn credit basics in your first

two weeks.

Good to have

A prior internship in a bank or NBFC credit team, or in B2B or fintech sales.

Experience with LinkedIn Sales Navigator, Apollo, HubSpot or Clay.

Hindi, Marathi, Gujarati, T amil or another regional language, for regional NBFCs and co-operative banks**

title: Sales Manager
description:
Sales Manager – MumbaiPosition Details

**Position:**
Sales Manager

**Company:**
Jewel Trendz Pvt. Ltd.

**Location:**
Mumbai, Maharashtra

**Work Model:**
On-Site

**Employment Type:**
Full-Time

**Function:**
Sales & Business Development

**Reporting To:**
Director – Sales & Marketing / Senior Management

**Compensation:**
Fixed Salary + Performance-Based Incentives

About Jewel Trendz Pvt. Ltd.

Jewel Trendz Pvt. Ltd. is a business consulting, management advisory and event organisation company operating in the Gems & Jewellery industry. The company creates business opportunities through jewellery exhibitions, trade shows, B2B networking platforms, memberships, branding, marketing and sales consultancy for jewellery manufacturers and retailers across India and international markets.

We are looking for a proactive, target-oriented Sales Manager to drive revenue, acquire new clients and build strong business relationships within the Gems & Jewellery industry.

Key Responsibilities

**1. Sales & Revenue Generation**

* Achieve monthly, quarterly and annual sales targets assigned by management.
* Generate revenue through exhibitions, trade shows, sponsorships, memberships, sales consultancy and other assigned business verticals.
* Identify prospects, conduct sales calls, present proposals, negotiate and close deals.
* Develop a strong sales pipeline and maximise revenue through repeat business, upselling and cross-selling.

**2. Business Development & Client Acquisition**

* Identify and approach jewellery manufacturers, wholesalers, retailers, brands, sponsors and corporate clients.
* Build relationships with business owners, directors and key decision-makers.
* Generate new business through cold calling, referrals, networking, email, WhatsApp and direct meetings.
* Identify new customer segments and business opportunities within the industry.

**3. Exhibition & Event Sales**

* Promote Jewel Trendz exhibitions, including Gems & Jewellery Shows, Corporate Diamond Shows, Silver Shows and Lab-Grown Diamond Jewellery Shows.
* Sell exhibition stalls, sponsorship packages, memberships and other commercial offerings.
* Explain participation benefits, buyer access, networking opportunities and business potential.
* Drive exhibitor acquisition, repeat participation and event-specific revenue targets.
* Coordinate with event operations and client services teams to ensure smooth client onboarding.

**4. Lead Generation & Follow-Up**

* Generate qualified leads through industry databases, referrals, outbound calls and marketing campaigns.
* Maintain regular follow-ups with prospective and existing clients.
* Qualify leads based on business requirements, budget and purchase timelines.
* Reactivate inactive customers and convert suitable prospects into paying clients.
* Ensure timely follow-up on all important sales opportunities.

**5. Customer Relationship Management**

* Build long-term relationships with exhibitors, jewellery manufacturers, retailers and sponsors.
* Understand customer requirements and recommend suitable services and participation packages.
* Encourage repeat business, referrals and additional purchases.
* Address customer queries professionally and coordinate with relevant departments for resolution.

**6. Sales Planning & Execution**

* Prepare daily, weekly and monthly sales plans.
* Prioritise high-potential prospects and revenue-generating activities.
* Execute management-approved sales strategies and promotional campaigns.
* Monitor market developments, competitor activities and customer preferences.
* Recommend improvements to sales pitches, packages and customer acquisition strategies.

**7. CRM & Reporting**

* Maintain accurate lead databases, sales pipelines and customer records.
* Submit daily sales activity reports and periodic performance updates.
* Track calls, meetings, proposals, conversions, bookings and collections.
* Prepare realistic sales forecasts and update management on business opportunities.
* Coordinate with finance for invoices and payment follow-ups.

**8. Internal Coordination & Professional Conduct**

* Coordinate with marketing, event operations, client services and finance teams.
* Ensure accurate communication of approved pricing and commercial terms.
* Protect confidential customer information and company data.
* Follow company policies, reporting procedures and professional standards.
* Take ownership of assigned targets and escalate significant client or commercial issues appropriately.

Candidate Profile

We are looking for a confident, commercially aware and self-motivated sales professional who can generate leads, convert prospects and deliver measurable business results.

**Qualifications & Experience**

* Bachelor's degree in Business Administration, Sales, Marketing, Commerce or a related field preferred.
* 3–7 years of relevant experience in sales, business development or B2B client acquisition.
* Proven ability to generate business and achieve sales targets.
* Experience in exhibitions, events, corporate sales, memberships or business services is preferred.
* Strong communication, negotiation, presentation and closing skills.
* Good knowledge of MS Excel, email, WhatsApp Business and CRM systems.
* Strong follow-up, time-management and organisational abilities.
* Ability to work independently in a target-driven environment.

Experience in the Gems & Jewellery industry, particularly with manufacturers, wholesalers, retailers and exhibitions, will be an advantage.

Required Competencies

The successful candidate should be:

* Target-oriented and commercially driven.
* Proactive in lead generation and client acquisition.
* Confident in negotiations and sales closures.
* Persistent in follow-ups and relationship management.
* Organised in maintaining sales records and reporting.
* Accountable for assigned targets and business outcomes.
* Professional in client communication and internal coordination.

Compensation Structure

**Fixed Salary + Performance-Based Incentives**

* Fixed monthly salary based on experience, skills and suitability.
* Additional performance-based incentives linked to eligible sales and target achievement.
* Incentive eligibility, calculation methodology and payout terms will be communicated by the company.
* Opportunity to increase earnings through consistent performance and revenue generation.

Key Performance Indicators (KPIs)

Performance will be evaluated based on:

1. Achievement of assigned monthly and quarterly sales targets.
2. Number of qualified leads generated.
3. Lead-to-customer conversion rate.
4. Revenue generated from exhibitions, memberships and assigned services.
5. Number of new customers acquired.
6. Repeat business, customer retention and referrals.
7. Sales follow-up discipline and pipeline accuracy.
8. Timely submission of sales reports and forecasts.
9. Support for payment collection and outstanding follow-ups.
10. Compliance with company policies and approved commercial terms.

Specific targets will be assigned by management according to business requirements.

Why Join Jewel Trendz?

* Work with leading jewellery manufacturers, retailers and industry professionals.
* Participate in the growth of established B2B jewellery exhibitions and business platforms.
* Build valuable industry relationships and business development skills.
* Earn performance-based incentives in addition to a fixed salary.
* Develop long-term career opportunities based on performance and contribution.

title: Business Development Manager
description:
**Key purpose of the role**
CISS is Redington's IT services business. It delivers deployment, implementation, professional and managed services across Cybersecurity, Software, IDCS (Integrated Data Centre Solutions), Server & Storage, Cisco and Networking. We sell these services through Redington's channel partners, alongside every product deal we distribute.
  
  
We are looking for a driven Business Development Manager to grow CISS services revenue in their region. The role builds a qualified services funnel, works with Redington's sales teams (ASMs) to turn product conversations into services opportunities, and takes those opportunities through to order and billing.
  
  
The ideal candidate has sold IT services or solutions in IT distribution, an OEM, a system integrator or the channel partner ecosystem. They understand that services are sold differently from boxes: by scope, outcome and delivery, not by price list.
  
  
**Key responsibilities**
**Build the services funnel**

* Identify and qualify services opportunities across Cybersecurity, Software, IDCS, Server & Storage, Cisco and Networking: deployment, implementation, migration, professional services, training and managed services, including SOC (security operations).
* Work with ASMs on their partner accounts to generate services leads from product deals, so that services are proposed with the hardware or software, not after it.
* Engage channel partners and system integrators to position Redington as their services delivery arm, and activate new partners for services.
* Turn OEM-generated and large-account leads into services opportunities.

**Take opportunities to closure**

* Qualify every lead on customer, need, timeline and size, and take it through to proposal, order and billing.
* Work with practice leads, presales and delivery teams to scope services, build the bill of quantities and statement of work, and prepare proposals and commercials.
* Run joint customer calls with partners and ASMs, and handle negotiation through to purchase order.
* Track every order in hand through delivery so that it converts into billing on time.

**Enable the sales teams and partners**

* Brief ASMs and partners on the CISS portfolio and how to pitch services, using the practice playbooks.
* Support partner enablement sessions, webinars and partner round tables in the region.

**Run the business with discipline**

* Keep the funnel accurate and current in RediCRM: every lead tagged with customer, branch, practice and stage.
* Publish weekly funnel and forecast updates. Track win/loss and record a reason for every loss.
* Monitor the market, competitor services offerings and partner needs to spot new opportunities.

**How Success Is Measured**

* Qualified services funnel built, and its conversion to orders
* Services revenue billed against target
* Partners activated for services, and leads generated with ASMs
* Services attach on product deals in the region
* Funnel hygiene and forecast accuracy in RediCRM

**Preferred Candidate Profile**

* Bachelor's degree in Engineering, Information Technology, Business Administration, Commerce or a related field. An MBA is an advantage.
* 2–6 years of B2B sales or business development in the IT industry, with at least 2 years selling IT services or solutions.
* Experience in IT distribution, an OEM, a system integrator or a managed services provider is preferred.
* Exposure to one or more of these areas:
* Cybersecurity services (SOC, managed security, implementations)
* Data centre, server and storage deployment and migration(Dell, HPE, Lenovo & others)
* Networking services (Cisco, Juniper, HPE Aruba and others)
* Software, platform and AI services(IBM, Redhat, Oracle )
* Managed services and IT outsourcing
* Understanding of how services are scoped, priced and delivered: SOW, BOQ, time and material versus fixed price, and recurring revenue.
* Good grasp of the channel ecosystem and how to win partners' trust as a delivery partner.
* Strong communication, presentation, negotiation and relationship skills.
* Comfortable working across sales, presales, practice and delivery teams without direct authority over them.
* Target-driven, organised, and disciplined with CRM and reporting.
* Willing to travel for partner and customer meetings within the region.

title: Senior Director, Sales
description:
**Who We Are**
Duck Creek Technologies is the intelligent solutions provider defining the future of the property and casualty (P&C) insurance industry. Our modern SaaS platform enables insurers to run agile, cloud-based operations and deliver better customer experiences.
  
  
Duck Creek is a flexible-first company, offering employees autonomy in how they manage their work. * Manage the existing pipeline in India to successful closure.
* Identify new business opportunities and cultivate strong relationships with key stakeholders and clients.

* Leverage existing client relationships.
* Work with SI partners to develop strategies to address client needs and market dynamics and build pipeline.
* Work closely with the APAC Marketing Lead to drive marketing activities that build Duck Creek Technologies’ brand in India and generate leads and opportunities.
* Use Salesforce to manage the pipeline and ensure data is accurate and timely.
* Use Duck Creek Technologies’ Value Selling Framework for all deals. Training and certification is provided, and the tools and methodology are embedded in Salesforce.
* Attend Sales Forecast Meetings and provide regular updates against quarterly and annual targets.
* Attend Duck Creek Technologies events as required, which may include the annual client event “Formation,” the annual Global Kick-Off (GKO) for go-to-market, and relevant client and marketing events.
* Perform all other duties as required.
* Act in accordance with and as a good steward of Duck Creek Technologies’ mission, vision, and core values.

**What Success Looks Like**

* Existing pipeline is managed through successful closure.
* New business opportunities, leads, and pipeline are developed in the India market.
* Strong relationships are maintained with clients, SIs, solution partners, consulting partners, industry analysts, and regulators.
* Pipeline data in Salesforce is accurate and timely.
* Regular updates are provided against quarterly and annual targets.
* Duck Creek Technologies’ brand presence in India is supported through relevant marketing and client activities.

**What You’ve Done**

* 15+ years of experience in sales leadership roles, preferably in the P&C insurance or SaaS industry.
* Deep understanding of the India market and regional business landscape.
* Strong existing relationships and market presence.
* Proven experience in developing and executing market-expansion strategies.
* Strong leadership and strategic planning skills.
* Experience in managing client and stakeholder relationships and pipeline growth.
* Ability to work closely with cross-functional teams and stakeholders.
* Excellent communication and presentation skills.
* Proven experience managing a pipeline, forecasting, and related operational discipline.

**Preferred**

* Familiarity with the P&C insurance industry and working with multinational companies.
* Experience working with SI partners and leveraging networks for business development.
* Knowledge of marketing strategies to build brand presence in new markets.
* Experience working with insurance industry regulators.
* Experience working with industry analysts.

**Skills & Capabilities**

* Market dynamics and business environment in the Asia region.
* Strategies for client acquisition and retention.
* Understanding of investment planning and budget management.
* Strategic planning and execution.
* Relationship management and networking.
* Business development and pipeline generation.
* Marketing and brand-building.
* Ability to develop and implement comprehensive business plans.
* Ability to collaborate effectively with internal and external stakeholders.
* Ability to adapt to changing market conditions and client needs.
* Ability to drive results and achieve business objectives.
* Strong leadership and decision-making.
* Proactive and results-oriented.
* Collaborative and team-oriented.
* Innovative and forward-thinking.

CORE COMPETENCIES
  
  
Our team is built on strong core values that guide how we work and grow together. We prioritize clear and thoughtful communication, fostering open collaboration across diverse perspectives to achieve shared goals. We approach challenges with curiosity and critical thinking, seeking creative solutions while remaining adaptable in a fast-changing environment. We take accountability for our work and outcomes, holding ourselves to high standards of integrity and professionalism. Above all, we are committed to doing the right thing—treating others with respect, embracing continuous learning, and engaging inclusively across cultures and backgrounds.
  
  
LEARN MORE
  
  

* Company Website – Transforming Insurance with Duck Creek's SaaS Solutions
* Life at Duck Creek – Duck Creek
* Benefits & Rewards – Wellbeing & Rewards - Duck Creek

LOCATION & WAYS OF WORKING
  
  
Duck Creek is a flexible-first company, offering employees autonomy in how they manage their day-to-day work. As part of our Flying Together approach, we are thoughtfully increasing opportunities for in-person collaboration by focusing on hiring in designated locations.
  
  
This role is aligned to a specific location, and you are expected to reside within reasonable proximity to that location. You will partner with your leader to participate in meaningful in-person moments that support team connection, collaboration, and business priorities.
  
  
At the start of your employment, your work may be performed remotely, subject to business needs and company guidelines. As our Flying Together approach continues to evolve, you may be expected to transition to a hybrid work arrangement, including working from a designated office location on a schedule determined by your leader and organizational needs.
  
  
The Company reserves the right to modify your work arrangement, including location expectations and in-person requirements, based on business needs, organizational policy, or regulatory considerations.
  
  
**What We Stand For**
Our global team values the unique perspectives each employee brings. Our success is driven by an inclusive culture where everyone can learn from one another, regardless of role or background. This collaborative approach helps us continuously improve our products, services, and systems.
  
  
Duck Creek is committed to equal opportunity for all employees and applicants, with decisions based on skills, experience, and achievements—without regard to any protected status.
  
  
We strive to lead by example in inclusion, diversity, and equity, creating an environment where employees can be their authentic selves. Our values guide us: We Prioritize Respect, We Listen, We Care, We Add Value, and We Lead.

Myaar Globus is a growing global education platform that helps students pursue higher education opportunities abroad. title: Sales Advisor
description:
**Please note:**
Tapi will never ask candidates to provide personal documents or sensitive personal information by phone or email during the recruitment process. If you receive a request of this nature and are unsure whether it is genuine, please contact us directly.
  
  
The Role
  
  
We have an exciting opportunity for someone who is passionate about people and customer service! This role is all about assisting the customer to bring their vision to life through the power of great product. Tapi are offering an enthusiastic, driven individual the opportunity to join the Tapi family. Our teams hold a wealth of industry knowledge where you will learn and develop from the best in the flooring business. If you are looking to take the next step and join a revolution, look no further, and apply today.
  
  
**Your Responsibilities**

* Work together with your store team to “wow” our customers at every turn.
* Provide top notch customer service, helping customers with pre-sales queries and order completions, as well as post-sales questions and (very rarely!) escalating the odd complaint.
* Support your team with promotional changes and store housekeeping, and report into one of our fab Store Managers (a master of all things flooring)!
* Always be on the lookout for new ways to improve our store, our service, and better serve our customers.
* We’ll teach you all you need to know about our glorious products and collections, so you can offer bespoke advice to each individual customer.
* We’ll also teach you how to draw and cost a room, so you can deliver flooring excellence to our customers.

**The Big Package**

* 25% colleague discount
* Salary sacrifice pension
* Perks platform (cheap cinema tickets, cashback and discounts on well-known brands)
* Employee Assistance Programme
* A day off for your birthday
* Cycle to work scheme

**About You!**
You’re in that little sweet spot of being sales driven AND customer focused. And you’re passionate about what you do.
  
  
We’re after a speedy thinker who’s nice to their core. A presentable, switched-on, and honest person, who brings a little joy to every interaction. You’re naturally self-motivated, enthusiastic, and keen to impress. You sweat the small stuff and have a “no customer left behind” attitude (we have a 5\* Trust Pilot rating to maintain)!
  
  
You're up for a challenge and thrive in a busy store environment. You are always on the lookout for ways to improve things for customers, colleagues, and you have a bias towards action.
  
  
**Get to Know us!**
Hello, we’re Tapi and we’re slightly obsessed with floors. We’re a flooring retailer with a difference, here to blow a breath of fresh air into the world of carpet and flooring shopping - and we’d love for you to join the revolution!
  
  
The Tapi story starts in 2015, when a handful of flooring industry specialists passionate about flooring decided to do things differently. With hundreds of years of flooring knowledge between us, our mission was to make buying flooring reassuringly simple for our customers – and show that it could be fun!
  
  
Over the past 10 years, we’ve grown massively to become the largest flooring retailer in Britain – something we’re super proud of. You’re likely to find a
  
  
Tapi showroom in your local town and we’ve got a fleet of home consultants zooming around the country. In 2024, we added the Carpetright brand, 54 flooring stores, and as many Carpetright colleagues as possible into the Tapi family. Our 5-star service remained outstanding as the team went above and beyond to show exactly why our customers rate us ‘excellent’ on Trustpilot.
  
  
So, what’s the secret to our success? Our people. Even though there’s nearly a whopping 1500 of us, we’re still a company with family values at the heart. Wherever you’re based – at the office, in a store or on the road - we all work together as a team. Some people have been with us from the very beginning while others plan to retire here, so we must be doing something right!
  
  
We care deeply about personal development which is why we launched the Tapi Academy - a 12-week training plan for all new flooring sales advisors, with 12-weeks OTE guaranteed while you learn the ropes. We celebrate milestones and award successes – and we shout about it! We organise Tapi socials where teams can come together and let their hair down, and we have (mostly) friendly competitions between locations.
  
  
It’s a happy place to work and when you love what you do, customers will see that too. And making our customers happy is the reason we get out of bed in the morning.
  
  
*Tapi Carpets & Floors is an Equal Opportunities Employer. Our policy is clear: there shall be no discrimination on the basis of age, disability, sex, race, religion or belief, gender reassignment, marriage/civil partnership, pregnancy/maternity, or sexual orientation. We are an inclusive organisation and actively promote equality of opportunity for all with the right mix of talent, skills and potential. We welcome all applications.*
*INDLP*

title: Associate Director Private Clients (Sales)
company: Henley & Partners - The Firm of Global Citizens®
description:
**Joining Henley & Partners**

As the leading global citizenship and residency advisory firm for over two decades, Henley & Partners helps clients navigate the complex landscape of investment migration and citizenship planning.

**Why Choose Henley & Partners?**

* **Global Impact:**
  Make a difference by helping individuals and families access new opportunities and secure a brighter future through alternative citizenship and residency options.
* **Cutting-Edge Expertise:**
  Join industry pioneers providing innovative solutions and exceptional service through an extensive international network.
* **Dynamic Culture:**
  Work in a multicultural and inclusive environment with over 40 offices worldwide, fostering collaboration and personal growth.
* **Continuous Learning:**
  Benefit from ongoing professional development, training programs, and industry conferences to enhance your skills.
* **Impactful Projects:**
  Engage in high-profile projects that shape the future of investment migration and global mobility.
* **Work-Life Balance:**
  Enjoy flexible working arrangements and benefits that support your well-being.

...but that's enough about us, let's talk about you!

As an Associate Director Private Clients, you will be a brand ambassador for Henley & Partners and a key driver of new business growth. This is a proactive, relationship-driven sales role focused on acquiring high-net-worth clients through direct business development, networking, and strategic referral partnerships.

You will build and manage your own pipeline by developing relationships with intermediaries, professional advisors, family offices, private banks, wealth managers, and other centres of influence, while also identifying direct client opportunities.

Success requires a commercial mindset, entrepreneurial drive, resilience, and a passion for building relationships. Technical knowledge of residence and citizenship planning can be taught; what matters most is your ability to create opportunities, win new business, and deliver an exceptional client experience.

**Responsibilities:**

* Generate leads through prospecting, networking, referrals, strategic partnerships, events, and other business development activities.
* Develop and convert a pipeline of high-net-worth clients for residence and citizenship planning services.
* Build and maintain strong relationships with intermediary partners, professional advisors, family offices, private banks, wealth managers, lawyers, tax advisors, and other referral sources.
* Own the full sales cycle, from prospecting and qualification through consultation, proposal, and conversion.
* Conduct consultative client meetings, understand client objectives, and recommend suitable solutions.
* Deliver compelling presentations and maintain consistent follow-up throughout often complex sales processes.
* Meet or exceed agreed sales, pipeline, and revenue targets while maintaining accurate CRM records.
* Collaborate with internal Relationship Managers and operational teams across the globe to ensure a seamless client experience.
* Nurture long-term client relationships, identifying referral and cross-selling opportunities.
* Work closely with India Office Head and Represent Henley & Partners with professionalism, discretion, and integrity while staying informed on market developments and relevant programs.

**Candidate Profile**

We are looking for an ambitious, commercially driven individual with a strong hunter mentality and a proven ability to build relationships and generate new business.

The ideal candidate will demonstrate:

* A proactive, entrepreneurial approach with strong self-motivation and accountability.
* Proven ability to generate opportunities through networking, referrals, and business development.
* Resilience, persistence, and confidence in managing long sales cycles.
* Excellent relationship-building, communication, negotiation, and presentation skills.
* A consultative sales approach with the ability to understand client needs and recommend appropriate solutions.
* Credibility and discretion when working with high-net-worth individuals and senior professional advisors.
* A collaborative mindset and the ability to learn complex products quickly.

**Requirements:**

* Minimum 8 years' experience in business development, consultative sales, client acquisition, or a similar revenue-generating role.
* Master's degree in Business, Economics, Marketing, or a related field preferred, or equivalent commercial experience.
* Demonstrated success in generating new business/leads and achieving sales targets.
* Experience working with high-net-worth clients, private banks, wealth managers, family offices, professional services, luxury sectors, or similar relationship-led industries is advantageous.
* Experience in residence or citizenship planning is beneficial but not essential; full training will be provided.
* CRM proficiency, strong business software skills, multilingual capabilities, and local market knowledge are advantageous.

Join our team and be part of an organization that values innovation, fosters collaboration, and believes in the potential of its employees. We offer competitive compensation, comprehensive benefits, and a dynamic work environment that encourages growth and personal development.

If you are seeking a challenging yet rewarding opportunity where your ideas can make a real impact, we invite you to apply today.

We value your privacy and are committed to protecting your personal information. By applying to this vacancy, you confirm that you have read, understood, and agree to abide by our privacy policies. For more details about our Privacy Policy please visit: https://www.henleyglobal.com/privacy-policy

title: Sales Manager
description:
**Sales Manager – API Distribution & Relationship Management**

**Company:**
AIRIQ 365 LIMITED

**Department:**
Hotel Business

**Locations:**
**2 - Mumbai and Bangalore**

**Employment Type:**
Full-time

**Reporting To:**
Head – Hotel Business

**Experience:**
6–8 years in relevant roles

**Travel:**
Regular travel for partner meetings and business development

**Role Overview**

The Sales Manager – API Distribution & Relationship Management will drive AIRIQ’s hotel business by acquiring, activating and managing B2B API distribution partners, including OTAs, travel platforms, travel management companies, bed banks and other travel intermediaries.

The role involves expanding the distribution of AIRIQ’s pre-purchased and directly contracted hotel inventory, generating profitable sales and developing long-term partner relationships. The selected candidate will work closely with Technology, Distribution, Procurement, Revenue, Operations and Finance to ensure successful onboarding, consistent booking production and account growth.

**Key Responsibilities**

**1. Partner Acquisition and Business Development**

* Identify and acquire partners for the distribution of AIRIQ’s hotel inventory through APIs.
* Build and maintain a sales pipeline across relevant domestic and international markets.
* Present AIRIQ’s hotel portfolio, destination coverage, inventory availability and commercial advantages.
* Understand prospective partners’ requirements and propose suitable commercial arrangements.
* Negotiate pricing structures, payment terms and business commitments within approved guidelines.
* Coordinate agreements, documentation and internal approvals.

**2. API Onboarding and Partner Activation**

* Manage the commercial onboarding process from agreement signing through integration, testing and go-live.
* Coordinate with partner and internal technical teams on API access, hotel mapping, inventory availability and booking requirements.
* Track onboarding milestones and resolve business dependencies to support timely activation.
* Ensure relevant hotels and destinations are enabled on partner platforms.
* Drive initial bookings and develop newly integrated partners into consistently productive accounts.

**3. Relationship and Account Management**

* Act as the primary commercial contact for assigned API distribution partners.
* Develop relationships with partner leadership, sourcing, sales, revenue, product and technical teams.
* Understand each partner’s customer segments, destination demand, booking patterns and growth opportunities.
* Prepare account plans covering sales targets, inventory promotion and business expansion.
* Conduct regular performance reviews and agree on actions to improve production.
* Coordinate the resolution of commercial, booking and service escalations.

**4. Sales Growth and Inventory Distribution**

* Achieve agreed targets for room nights, revenue, contribution and productive accounts.
* Promote AIRIQ’s pre-purchased and directly contracted hotel inventory across partner networks.
* Increase sales of priority hotels, destinations and travel periods.
* Work with Revenue on partner-specific pricing, mark-ups, offers and promotional campaigns.
* Identify opportunities to increase wallet share and reactivate low-producing accounts.
* Share partner demand and hotel sourcing requirements with Procurement.

**5. Distribution Performance and Market Intelligence**

* Monitor partner searches, bookings, conversion, cancellations and hotel-level production.
* Coordinate action on rate competitiveness, availability, mapping errors and booking issues affecting sales.
* Review search-to-book performance and identify opportunities to improve conversion.
* Track competitor offerings, partner feedback and emerging market demand.
* Recommend improvements to AIRIQ’s hotel portfolio and distribution proposition.

**6. Credit, Collections and Reporting**

* Coordinate partner credit limits, payment schedules and collections with Finance.
* Monitor outstanding balances and escalate overdue payments or credit concerns.
* Ensure commercial commitments remain within approved policies and authority limits.
* Maintain accurate CRM records, sales pipelines, account plans and business forecasts.
* Submit regular reports on partner acquisition, activation, production and account performance.

**Candidate Profile**

* Graduate in any discipline; a qualification in travel, hospitality or business management is preferred.
* **6–8 years of experience**
  in B2B hotel sales, API distribution, bed-bank sales or travel account management.
* Established relationships with hotel API buyers, OTAs, travel platforms, travel management companies or other relevant distribution partners.
* Proven ability to acquire new accounts and grow existing partner business.
* Working understanding of hotel APIs, hotel mapping, room and rate plans, booking flows and distribution commercials.
* Experience coordinating API partner onboarding with technical teams.
* Understanding of hotel pricing, margins, credit exposure and commercial negotiations.
* Strong communication, presentation, negotiation and relationship-management skills.
* Proficiency in Excel, CRM systems and sales reporting.
* Candidates should be based in, or willing to relocate to,
  **Mumbai or Bengaluru**
  , depending on the position.

**Key Performance Indicators**

* New API distribution partners acquired.
* Partners integrated, activated and generating bookings.
* Time from agreement signing to go-live and first booking.
* Room nights, revenue and contribution from assigned accounts.
* Sales of priority pre-purchased and directly contracted inventory.
* Growth, retention and wallet share of existing partners.
* Improvement in partner conversion and productive hotel coverage.
* Timely collections and adherence to approved credit terms.
* Accuracy of sales forecasts and account reporting.

title: Sales Manager
description:
**Company Description**
Divya Shipping India Pvt Ltd is a shipping and logistics company operating in the dynamic maritime and trade environment of India. The organization focuses on delivering reliable, cost-effective solutions to clients across domestic and international markets. Working closely with partners and customers, the company aims to streamline cargo movement and optimize supply chains. Team members can expect a professional environment that values accountability, client service, and operational efficiency. The company offers opportunities for growth to individuals who are committed to performance and relationship-building in the logistics sector.
  
**Role Description**
The Sales Manager role at Divya Shipping India Pvt Ltd is a full-time, on-site position based in Mumbai. The Sales Manager will be responsible for identifying and developing new business opportunities, managing existing client accounts, and maintaining strong customer relationships in the shipping and logistics sector. Day-to-day tasks include prospecting and meeting potential clients, preparing and presenting sales proposals, negotiating rates and contract terms, and coordinating with operations and customer service teams to ensure smooth service delivery. The role also involves monitoring market trends, tracking competitors, creating sales forecasts, and reporting on pipeline and performance to leadership. The Sales Manager is expected to work closely with internal stakeholders, uphold high professional standards, and contribute to revenue growth and brand reputation.

* Candidates should possess strong sales, account management, and business development skills, with experience in managing end-to-end sales cycles.
* Candidates should possess skills in client relationship management, negotiation, and customer service to build long-term partnerships and resolve issues effectively.
* Candidates should possess skills in market analysis, forecasting, and basic data interpretation to identify opportunities and support decision-making.
* Candidates should possess effective communication, presentation, and interpersonal skills to engage with clients and collaborate with internal teams.

* Bachelor’s degree in Business, Commerce, Logistics, or a related field is preferred; equivalent work experience will also be considered.
* Comfort working in an on-site, fast-paced environment in Mumbai, with proficiency in MS Office and CRM tools.

title: Sales Manager
description:
**Company Description**

title: Specialist, Product Sales - Securities Services, Transaction Banking
description:
**Job Description**
**DBS India - Culture & Behaviours**

* Build Pride and Passion to Protect, Maintain and Enhance DBS’ Reputation
* Enhance Knowledge Base, Build Skill Sets & Develop Competencies

* Execute at Speed While Maintaining Error Free Operations
* Develop a Passion for Performance to Grow Talent Pool
* Maintain the Highest Standards of Honesty and Integrity

**Business Function**
Global Transaction Services (GTS) comprises of Cash & Trade, Securities Services and Fiduciary Services. In an increasingly borderless world marked by burgeoning Asset transactions expertise in trade finance services is an invaluable asset. With cash the lifeblood of every company, so too, is a good understanding of how to manage these cashflows. Trade Finance, together with Cash & Securities Management, is the mainstay of GTS, and is extended to Funds, MNCs and corporate clients for their local and cross-border financial transaction needs.
  
  
**Job Purpose**
You will be responsible for Custody, Derivative Clearing (Professional Clearing Member (“PCM”), Fund Accounting Products and Designated Depository Participant (“DDP”) role. The individual will have responsibility for regulatory compliances, P&L and product strategy. The individual will have to collaborate closely with external stakeholders across SEBI, RBI, IFSCA, Exchanges, Depositories, Clearing Corporations, Custodians. The individual will also have to collaborate closely with internal stakeholders across relationship, Group SFS, Compliance, Legal, FCSS, Technology, Operations, Sales and Client Management teams. The industry is embarking on a period of significant change, innovation and new business opportunities and DBS India is looking to play a leadership role. The role will report directly to the India Product Head of Securities and Fiduciary Services.
  
  
**Key Accountabilities**

* Activities related to client onboarding, due diligence and regulatory compliances.
* Lead the development and execution of the India custody product strategy including ongoing priorities and alignment with Indian regulatory changes and Group guidelines
* Collaborate on commercial topics with key stakeholder and business partners across functions including legal, risk and compliance.
* Explore new business opportunities that help to shorten the chain of custody, drive efficiency and reduce risk
* Developing and driving the vision and product strategy
* Partner with the business to drive revenue and profitable growth
* Own product across Custody, PCM, Fund Accounting in both India and IFSC-GIFT
* Partner with operations to manage operating costs, drive process improvements and improve cost to serve
* Provide market insights to drive development and competitive positioning of the product
* Identify areas of improvement in the core products
* Participate in Industry groups across the region to drive market leadership and change
* Partner with clients and industry participants to drive and deliver value added products

**Job Duties & Responsibilities**

* On boarding of client in coordination with the relationship team and operations team
* Responsibility for ensuring that the compliance of all procedures with banking/statutory requirements and securities industry are updated as per market developments.
* Participating in projects affecting custody processes arising from new/revised business areas.
* Initiate continual enhancements to productivity and quality of service in line with developments within Processing & Services Group and the Bank
* Planning for operational changes to meet securities and custody market developments
* Ensure prompt responses to clients’ queries (24-hr turnaround / acknowledgement).
* Work with the client on account structure so that the account registration process with SEBI is smooth.
* Liaise with client on the account opening document requirements.
* Ensure that the transition of new business is smooth.
* Liaise with other sections within branch, with Head Office on regulatory or operational issues impacting credit arrangements and overall Bank relationship
* Keep abreast of market developments and keep the clients updated on the same.
* Participate in execution of the India custody product strategy including ongoing priorities and annual investment decisions and alignment with Indian regulatory changes and Group guidelines
* Identify areas of improvement in the core products
* Explore new business opportunities that help to shorten the chain of custody, drive efficiency and reduce risk
* Participate in Industry groups across the region to drive market leadership and change
* Partner with clients and industry participants to drive and deliver value added products
* Collaborate on commercial topics with key stakeholder and business partners across functions including legal, risk and compliance.

**Required Experience**

* Mid/Senior level, experienced talent with deep subject matter expertise in Custody, Fund Accounting, DDP and PCM functions and the broader asset servicing product set
* Proven track record of working with large complex clients and establishing strong partnerships at all levels
* Strong working knowledge of technology, market infrastructures and industry partners that support the custody chain
* Excellent client skills and the ability to engage at all levels
* Strong understanding of operational processes across all aspects of Custody, DDP, PCM and Fund Accounting functions
* Ability to effectively communicate at all levels within an organization
* Demonstrates strong leadership skills and the ability to effectively manage and mentor staff
* Proven ability to execute on product deliverables and strategic vision

**Education / Preferred Qualifications**

* An MBA or Chartered Accountant or equivalent degree is preferable, with at least 4-5 years with Custody/product knowledge & in Securities market regulations.
* Good understanding of the product management process
* Strong understanding of SEBI, RBI, FEMA, IFSCA, Depository regulations
* Market knowledge and experience of Custody business, with reference to customer preferences and requirement would be preferable.
* Experience in FPI, FVCI and AIF business is an added advantage
* Degree in Securities Law is preferable
* Should be street smart with good communication skills

**Core Competencies**

* Expertise and experience in FEMA compliance and capital account transactions.
* Good understanding of the Product management process
* Sound technical knowledge of Securities and Fiduciary Service business
* Good problem solving/analytical, planning & organising skills. Planning, scheduling and monitoring deliverables, within a stipulated time frame using effective methods
* Good team management skills / working with multiple stakeholders
* Good interpersonal and communications skills.

**Technical Competencies**

* Sound understanding of Securities Services products and associated systems, technology platforms and operational procedures
* Strong knowledge of SEBI, FEMA, Depository, IFSA and associated regulations
* In-depth understanding of Securities and Fiduciary Services business and associated technology platforms and operational procedures
* Internet and Microsoft Office Skills

**Work Relationship**

title: ADMINISTRATIVE.BUSINESS DEVELOPMENT MANAGER I
description:
Nabors is a leading provider of advanced technology for the energy industry. With operations in about 20 countries, Nabors has established a global network of people, technology and equipment to deploy solutions that deliver safe, efficient and responsible hydrocarbon production. By leveraging its core competencies, particularly in drilling, engineering, automation, data science and manufacturing, Nabors aims to innovate the future of energy and enable the transition to a lower carbon world.
  
  
The Business Development Manager is responsible for identifying and developing new business opportunities, expanding customer relationships, and driving revenue growth for Nabors within the oil and gas industry. The role focuses on market analysis, strategic account management, tendering, commercial negotiations, and securing new contracts for drilling services, rig operations, and related oilfield solutions. The position works closely with internal stakeholders to develop commercially viable solutions, strengthen market presence, and achieve organizational business objectives.
  
  

* Identify, evaluate, and pursue new business opportunities in the oil and gas industry, including drilling services, rig contracts, and related oilfield solutions.
* Develop and implement business development strategies aligned with organizational objectives and regional growth plans.
* Establish and maintain strong relationships with existing and prospective customers, including oil and gas operators, drilling contractors, and industry stakeholders.
* Conduct market research and competitor analysis to identify emerging opportunities, industry trends, customer requirements, and potential risks.
* Identify and monitor tender opportunities, requests for proposals (RFPs), and requests for quotations (RFQs).
* Coordinate the preparation and submission of technical and commercial proposals in collaboration with relevant internal departments.
* Lead or support commercial negotiations, pricing discussions, contract reviews, and business agreements within the authorized scope.
* Develop account plans and maintain a qualified sales pipeline to support revenue forecasting and business planning.
* Prepare regular reports on business development activities, sales forecasts, customer engagement, tender status, and market intelligence.
* Collaborate with operations, engineering, finance, legal, supply chain, and other relevant departments to ensure alignment of proposed solutions with customer requirements and business capabilities.
* Monitor contract awards, customer feedback, and market developments to identify opportunities for repeat business and service expansion.
* Ensure that all business development activities comply with company policies, applicable legal and regulatory requirements, contractual obligations, and ethical business practices.
* Represent the company at customer meetings, industry conferences, exhibitions, and business development events, as required.
* Support the achievement of revenue targets, profitability objectives, customer satisfaction, and sustainable business growth.

* Master's degree in Business Administration, Marketing, or a related discipline.
* Experience in bidding and tender management for drilling contracts, rig services, oilfield equipment, or integrated oilfield solutions.
* Experience working with oil and gas operators, drilling contractors, procurement teams, and other industry stakeholders.
* Familiarity with regional oil and gas markets, tender portals, procurement procedures, and commercial contracting practices.
* Experience in preparing bid strategies, pricing models, commercial evaluations, and contract proposals.
* Demonstrated ability to develop new accounts, secure contracts, and contribute to revenue growth.

* Develop a clear understanding of the company's services, brand positioning, and communication approach.

Working closely with colleagues from different teams, you will help solve challenges and improve access to healthcare. * Share clear, accurate, and science-based information to support healthcare professionals’ decisions.
* Ensure accurate recording and reporting of activities, outcomes, and customer feedback using company tools.
* Collaborate with colleagues from different teams to address customer needs and improve patient access to care.
* Continuously update your knowledge of clinical evidence, market trends, and ways to improve your performance.

Why You?
  
  
Work type
  
  
This role is on-site in Navi Mumbai with regular travel within the assigned area. You will join a supportive team that encourages coaching and practical feedback. We welcome applicants from all backgrounds and experiences. Inclusion is important to us, and we create a workplace where everyone can contribute and grow.
  
  
Basic Qualification
  
  
We are seeking professionals with the following required skills and qualifications to help us achieve our goals:
  
  

* Bachelor’s degree from a recognised institution.
* Minimum 1 year of customer-facing experience in field sales, medical business, or territory management roles.
* Valid driver’s licence and willingness to travel regularly within the territory.
* Good verbal and written communication skills in English and Marathi or Hindi.

**Preferred Qualification**

* Ability to use customer insights and simple data to guide your priorities.

**Job Location - Navi Mumbai**

Customer Centric Selling, Data to Insights, Digital Fluency, Omnichannel, Sales Territory Management, Scientific Literacy
  
  
**Why GSK?**
**Uniting science, technology and talent to get ahead of disease together.**
GSK is a global biopharma company with a purpose to unite science, technology and talent to get ahead of disease together. We aim to positively impact the health of 2.5 billion people by the end of the decade, as a successful, growing company where people can thrive. We get ahead of disease by preventing and treating it with innovation in specialty medicines and vaccines. We focus on four therapeutic areas: respiratory, immunology and inflammation; oncology; HIV; and infectious diseases – to impact health at scale.
  
  
People and patients around the world count on the medicines and vaccines we make, so we’re committed to creating an environment where our people can thrive and focus on what matters most. title: Senior Cloud Services Sales Specialist
description:
**Make an impact with NTT DATA**
Join a company that is pushing the boundaries of what is possible. We are renowned for our technical excellence and leading innovations, and for making a difference to our clients and society. Our workplace embraces diversity and inclusion – it’s a place where you can grow, belong and thrive.
  
  
**Title:**
Senior Cloud Services Sales Specialist
  
  
**Locations:**
Gurgaon/ Bangalore/ Mumbai
  
  
**About the Role:**
NTT DATA is a strategic technology services and solutions partner of AWS, Microsoft Azure and Google Cloud, helping enterprises modernize their technology environments and accelerate cloud, data and AI transformation.
  
  
We are looking for an experienced Cloud Specialist Sales professional to drive cloud-led business development and Sales across NTT DATA’s enterprise client base. The role will operate within NTT DATA India working horizontally across Client Management, Business Units, hyperscaler alliance teams, solutioning/presales and delivery organizations.
  
  
The Cloud Specialist Seller will act as a cloud subject-matter sales leader and opportunity orchestrator, identifying and creating cloud transformation opportunities, shaping customer conversations, developing qualified pipelines and bringing the right NTT DATA and hyperscaler capabilities together to progress opportunities through to closure.
  
  
The role requires someone who can operate effectively across organizational boundaries, influence without direct authority, engage senior customer stakeholders and translate cloud technology capabilities into measurable business outcomes.
  
  
**Key Responsibilities:**

* Cloud Business Development & Pipeline Creation
* Develop and execute cloud sales strategies across an assigned portfolio of enterprise customers.
* Identify opportunities across cloud migration, modernization, application

transformation, infrastructure modernization, cloud-native development, managed cloud services and cloud optimization.
  
  

* Proactively create demand rather than relying solely on existing account pipeline.
* Build and maintain a healthy pipeline of qualified cloud opportunities and achieve agreed sales/revenue targets.
* Identify opportunities to expand existing NTT DATA relationships through cloud-led transformation initiatives.
* Develop account-level cloud whitespace maps covering AWS, Azure and GCP

opportunities.
  
  

* Client Engagement & Consultative Selling
* Engage with CIOs, CTOs, CDOs, CISOs, business leaders and technology decision-makers to understand transformation priorities.
* Lead executive-level conversations around the business value of cloud, rather than selling individual cloud products.
* Understand customer technology landscapes, transformation roadmaps, business drivers and pain points.
* Position NTT DATA’s capabilities together with hyperscaler technology to develop differentiated customer propositions.
* Build trusted-advisor relationships with customers and establish NTT DATA as a strategic cloud transformation partner.
* Matrix / Client Manager Collaboration

As a horizontal specialist organisation, the role will work closely with Client Managers and BU sales teams across NTT DATA.
  
  
**Key responsibilities include:**

* Partner with Client Managers to identify and qualify cloud opportunities within strategic accounts.
* Work across multiple BUs to leverage existing customer relationships and industry expertise.
* Establish joint account plans with Client Managers and BU leadership.
* Support Client Managers with cloud-specific opportunity identification, qualification and strategy.
* Bring specialist cloud expertise into broader account planning and customer

engagements.
  
  

* Maintain clear ownership and engagement models with Client Managers to avoid channel conflict and ensure a coordinated customer experience.
* Influence stakeholders across the matrix without relying on direct reporting authority.
* Hyperscaler Alliance Engagement
* Develop strong working relationships with AWS, Microsoft and Google Cloud sales and technical teams.
* Create joint account strategies and opportunity plans with hyperscaler sellers.
* Leverage hyperscaler funding, migration programs, assessments, workshops, incentives and partner programs to accelerate opportunities.
* Coordinate joint customer engagements involving NTT DATA and hyperscaler teams.
* Build differentiated propositions leveraging NTT DATA’s services capabilities and hyperscaler platforms.
* Track hyperscaler ecosystem developments and translate relevant capabilities into customer opportunities.
* Opportunity Shaping & Sales Leadership
* Lead the commercial sales strategy for qualified cloud opportunities.
* Develop opportunity plans covering customer business problem, solution proposition, stakeholders, competition, commercial model and path to closure.
* Coordinate with solution architects, presales, delivery, commercial and legal teams.
* Ensure opportunities are appropriately qualified before significant presales investment.
* Lead proposal strategy, customer presentations, workshops and executive engagements.
* Maintain accurate CRM hygiene, forecasting and opportunity reporting.
* Drive opportunities from initial qualification → solution shaping → proposal →negotiation → closure.
* Cloud Solution & Commercial Understanding

The successful candidate should have sufficient technical understanding to engage credibly with customers and technical stakeholders across:
  
  

* Cloud migration and modernization
* IaaS / PaaS / SaaS
* Cloud-native architectures
* Containers and Kubernetes
* Data platforms and analytics
* AI/ML and Generative AI workloads
* Cloud security
* Networking and hybrid cloud
* DevOps / DevSecOps
* FinOps and cloud optimization
* Managed cloud services

The role is not expected to be the primary technical architect, but must be able to understand customer requirements, challenge solution assumptions and connect technical capabilities to business outcomes.
  
  

* Internal Orchestration

The specialist seller will act as the single-threaded sales orchestrator for cloud opportunities, bringing together:
  
  
Client Manager → BU → Cloud Specialist → Presales/Solution Architecture → Delivery →Hyperscaler → Commercial/Finance
  
  
**Responsibilities include:**

* Establishing the right internal team for each opportunity.
* Creating clear roles, responsibilities and next steps.
* Driving opportunity cadence and governance.
* Removing internal blockers.
* Ensuring commercial, solution and delivery stakeholders remain aligned.
* Maintaining momentum from opportunity creation through closure.

**Required Qualifications:**

* 8–10+ years of enterprise technology sales experience, preferably including significant cloud sales experience.
* Proven experience selling AWS, Azure and/or GCP solutions/services.
* Experience in a Systems Integrator, IT Services company, hyperscaler or technology consulting organisation preferred.
* Demonstrated experience managing complex enterprise sales cycles.
* Experience working in a matrixed organisation is highly desirable.
* Experience selling through or alongside hyperscaler partner ecosystems preferred.
* Technical & Business Skills

**Strong understanding of:**

* AWS / Azure / GCP cloud platforms
* Cloud transformation and modernization
* Data & AI workloads
* Cloud economics and business cases
* Enterprise architecture concepts
* Managed services
* Cloud security
* Digital transformation
* Sales Competencies
* Consultative / value-based selling
* Enterprise account planning
* Opportunity qualification
* Pipeline generation
* Executive stakeholder management
* Deal shaping and negotiation
* Partner ecosystem management
* Forecasting
* Cross-functional influence
* Strong communication and presentation skills

**Workplace type:**
On-site Working
  
  
**About NTT DATA**
NTT DATA is a $30+ billion business and technology services leader, serving 75% of the Fortune
  
  
Global 100. We are committed to accelerating client success and positively impacting society through
  
  
responsible innovation. We are one of the world’s leading AI and digital infrastructure providers, with
  
  
unmatched capabilities in enterprise-scale AI, cloud, security, connectivity, data centers and
  
  
application services. Our consulting and industry solutions help organizations and society move
  
  
confidently and sustainably into the digital future. As a Global Top Employer, we have experts in more
  
  
than 70 countries. We also offer clients access to a robust ecosystem of innovation centers as well as
  
  
established and start-up partners. NTT DATA is part of NTT Group, which invests over $3 billion each
  
  
year in R&D.
  
  
**Equal Opportunity Employer**
NTT DATA is proud to be an Equal Opportunity Employer with a global culture that embraces diversity. We are committed to providing an environment free of unfair discrimination and harassment. We do not discriminate based on age, race, colour, gender, sexual orientation, religion, nationality, disability, pregnancy, marital status, veteran status, or any other protected category. Join our growing global team and accelerate your career with us. Apply today.
  
  
**Third parties fraudulently posing as NTT DATA recruiters**
NTT DATA recruiters will never ask job seekers or candidates for payment or banking information during the recruitment process, for any reason. Please remain vigilant of third parties who may attempt to impersonate NTT DATA recruiters whether in writing or by phone in order to deceptively obtain personal data or money from you. Win new Industrial, Manufacturing and Mobility clients for Taggd — selling RPO and project-based hiring solutions to CHROs and Talent Acquisition Heads across Automotive, Aerospace and Defence, Chemicals, EPC, Manufacturing and Logistics, and closing enterprise deals of ₹1 Crore and above against a ₹5 Crore annual new sales revenue target.

New Business Acquisition

* Own the ₹5Crore annual new sales revenue target, delivered primarily through new logos in the assigned segment.
* Build and work a named list of target accounts, and open conversations with senior HR and business leadership through referrals, events and direct outreach.

Solution Selling and Deal Closure

* Run a consultative sales process — understand the client's hiring plan, volumes, roles and pain points before proposing a solution.
