title: Account Executive - Portfolio
description:
**Meet the Team**
We are seeking a dynamic, results-driven Portfolio Sales Account Executive to join our Service Provider team in Mumbai. In today’s rapidly evolving digital landscape, telecommunications and service provider networks are undergoing unprecedented transformation driven by AI, cloud adoption, 5G deployment, and critical digital infrastructure modernization. In this role, you will provide strategic account leadership to navigate these complex industry shifts, driving new business growth and expanding existing relationships with telecommunications companies, managed service providers, and digital infrastructure partners. You will own the entire sales lifecycle—from strategic prospecting and account planning to complex negotiations and closing. The ideal candidate possesses a deep understanding of the service provider landscape in India, a proven track record of exceeding quota in technology sales, and the ability to articulate high-value business solutions to C-level executives.
  
  
**Key Responsibilities**

* Develop and execute a comprehensive strategic sales plan for assigned account within the service provider sector to achieve and exceed annual revenue targets.
* Provide strategic account leadership to align our portfolio with customer business outcomes amidst ongoing digital infrastructure, AI, cloud, and 5G transformations.
* Orchestrate cross-functional teams and internal resources—including product specialists, solution engineers, and customer success teams—to lead complex, multi-stakeholder sales cycles.
* Identify, cultivate, and close new business opportunities while simultaneously expanding our footprint within existing client portfolios.
* Build and maintain strong, trusted relationships with C-level executives, procurement teams, and key technical decision-makers within major service provider organizations.
* Conduct high-impact presentations, product demonstrations, and executive briefings that effectively communicate our value proposition and technical capabilities.
* Maintain accurate and up-to-date sales pipeline data, forecasts, and customer records using our CRM platform.
* Monitor market trends, competitor activities, and regulatory changes within the Indian telecommunications and service provider industry to identify emerging opportunities.
* Participate in industry events, trade shows, and networking functions to represent the company and generate new leads.

**Minimum Qualifications**

* Bachelor’s degree in Business Administration, Information Technology, Engineering, or a related field. An MBA or postgraduate qualification is a plus.
* 7–10 years of experience in enterprise B2B sales, including at least 4 years selling technology solutions to telecommunications operators, service providers, or related organizations in India.
* Experience meeting or exceeding annual sales targets for complex, high-value technology solutions.
* Strong understanding of the Indian telecommunications and Service Provider ecosystem, including telecom operators, internet service providers, and cloud service providers.
* Working knowledge of IP/MPLS, SRv6, Agentic Operations (Agentic Ops), and Crossworks, with the ability to connect these technologies to customer needs and network transformation initiatives.
* Understanding of Data Center business and networking infrastructure, with the ability to connect Service Provider solutions with data center, cloud, and digital infrastructure requirements.
* Strong communication, negotiation, and presentation skills, with experience engaging customers across different levels of an organization, including senior and executive leaders.
* Experience managing complex sales opportunities, including commercial negotiations, multi-year agreements, and Requests for Proposals (RFPs).
* Strong business and financial understanding, with the ability to develop and communicate value propositions and commercial proposals.
* Experience using CRM platforms and sales enablement tools to manage customer relationships, opportunities, and sales pipelines.
* Fluency in English and Hindi is required. Knowledge of regional languages spoken in Mumbai and surrounding business hubs is a plus.

**Preferred Qualifications**

* Experience working with Service Provider NPE (Network Platform Engineering) or supporting SP network transformation initiatives.
* Experience in the Service Provider or Telecommunications industry, with an established understanding of customer needs and market dynamics.
* Experience supporting or leading digital transformation initiatives within large organizations.
* Experience managing complex, long-cycle sales opportunities involving multiple stakeholders.
* Knowledge of AI, cloud computing, networking, software-defined networking (SDN), and 5G technologies and their application in the Service Provider market.
* Experience building relationships with senior decision-makers across major Service Provider accounts in India.
* Experience working with Global Systems Integrators (GSIs) and other strategic technology partners is a plus.

Why Cisco?

title: Sales Lead, Luxury Villa Project
description:
**Sales Lead, Luxury Villa Project**

**Location:**
Nariman Point, Mumbai, with regular site visits to Khalapur, Raigad

**Experience:**
3–8 years

**About the Company**

Omegarealtech is hiring for Silhara, a luxury villa project of private residences in the Sahyadris, developed by Omega. The company is building a buyer-facing sales process around qualified digital enquiries, responsive communication, informed site visits, and compliant transaction management. The role is based from the company’s Nariman Point office and supports buyer engagement for the Khalapur project. The team works across marketing, sales, legal, and finance to move qualified buyers from initial enquiry through meetings, site visits, token booking, and agreement for sale. Candidates will join a project environment where accurate information, disciplined follow-up, CRM visibility, and buyer trust are central to commercial performance. The company expects sales communication to remain aligned with approved project materials and applicable Maharashtra real estate requirements. This is an opportunity to take ownership of a measurable luxury residential sales funnel while representing a distinctive Sahyadri private-residence project to Mumbai, Pune, Raigad, and wider buyer markets.

**About the Role**

As Sales Lead, you will own the conversion of qualified digital enquiries into office meetings, Khalapur site visits, token bookings, and signed agreements for sale. You will be the primary buyer contact from first response through transaction completion, using WhatsApp, phone, email, meetings, site walkthroughs, CRM discipline, and structured follow-up as your operating levers. Success means responding within two hours during business hours, qualifying buyer intent and fit, building a visible pipeline, and converting serious buyers without compromising accuracy or compliance. You will present approved pricing, unit options, and payment plans, address objections within authorised terms, coordinate site logistics, and partner with marketing, legal, and finance. The role is based at Nariman Point, Mumbai, with Khalapur site visits two to three days each week.

**Key Responsibilities**

* Own every inbound enquiry from WhatsApp, social media, and property portals, responding within two business hours and prioritising follow-up by buyer fit, intent, and responsiveness.
* Qualify buyers against budget, timeline, purpose, decision-makers, and purchase readiness, creating clear CRM notes that separate serious opportunities from casual enquiries.
* Convert qualified leads into Nariman Point meetings and Khalapur site visits by coordinating schedules, transport, access, visit plans, and post-visit next steps.
* Present approved pricing, unit options, and payment plans accurately, resolving objections on price, location, timelines, and construction within authorised commercial terms.
* Drive qualified buyers from site visit and token booking through agreement for sale, coordinating dependencies with legal and finance to reduce transaction delays.
* Maintain complete CRM records and submit weekly reporting on leads, qualification, meetings, visits, bookings, and pipeline value for management visibility.
* Feed structured insights to marketing on lead quality, buyer objections, source performance, and conversion patterns so campaigns generate stronger opportunities.
* Protect buyer trust and company compliance by using approved project information, MahaRERA details, and authorised claims while safeguarding personal data under company policy.

**Essential Skills & Technologies**

* Three to eight years of premium or luxury residential sales experience, including a demonstrable record of converting inbound enquiries into meetings, site visits, bookings, and agreements.
* Strong phone, WhatsApp, email, and in-person selling skills, with the judgement to qualify efficiently, negotiate within approved terms, and communicate clearly with high-net-worth buyers.
* Practical CRM capability covering lead activity, qualification notes, follow-up tasks, pipeline stages, weekly reporting, and feedback loops with marketing and management.

**Additional Plus**

* Villa, resort, second-home, or luxury residential sales experience is strongly preferred because the buyer journey involves considered purchases, site visits, and multiple decision-makers.
* Experience working with NRI buyers, home loans, payment-plan structures, and the Mumbai, Pune, Raigad, Khalapur, or Lonavala buyer market is advantageous.
* Hindi or Marathi fluency, a valid MahaRERA agent registration, or a valid driving licence would strengthen effectiveness in this role.

**What You'll Bring**

* A proven record in premium residential sales, with the stamina to work every qualified lead systematically and the commercial judgement to focus time on buyers most likely to progress.
* Strong buyer conversations across phone, WhatsApp, email, and face-to-face meetings, translating needs into relevant unit options and clear next steps without overselling.
* Confidence hosting office meetings and site walkthroughs, coordinating practical details, and following up within 24 hours with accurate summaries, commitments, and decision paths.
* Discipline with CRM systems and reporting, ensuring every active opportunity has current qualification notes, an agreed next action, and a reliable pipeline stage.
* Negotiation ability within approved pricing and payment terms, with sound judgement on when to involve management, legal, or finance rather than making unauthorised commitments.
* Working knowledge of MahaRERA and Maharashtra property transactions, including the importance of approved project information, accurate documentation, and careful handling of buyer data.
* Market familiarity across Mumbai, Pune, Raigad, Khalapur, and the Lonavala belt, plus comfort discussing home loans and structured payment plans.
* English proficiency is required; Hindi or Marathi is strongly preferred. You should be Mumbai-based, willing to visit Khalapur two to three days weekly, and able to obtain MahaRERA registration before joining if needed.

**Why Join Us**

* Own a complete luxury residential sales funnel rather than a narrow activity segment, with direct influence over lead quality, buyer experience, conversion, bookings, and transaction completion.
* Represent a distinctive private-residence project in the Sahyadris while working across marketing, legal, and finance to turn qualified interest into measurable commercial outcomes.
* Work from Nariman Point while engaging directly with buyers and the Khalapur project, combining metropolitan access with an on-site, relationship-led sales cycle.

**What We Offer**

* Full-time Sales Lead opportunity based at Nariman Point, Mumbai, with regular travel to the Khalapur project site.
* Opportunity to own buyer engagement from first digital enquiry through site visit, token booking, and agreement for sale.
* Cross-functional exposure to marketing, legal, and finance within a luxury villa sales environment.

* Fluent Marathi and Hindi on the phone; clear written English

Apply here on LinkedIn. We read every application. If your profile fits, we will send you a short form with six questions — that is how we decide who to meet. Answer it properly and we will call you in for an interview, online or at our Vashi office.

At J.C. Fitkneesguy Pvt. Ltd., we specialize in helping individuals overcome chronic knee conditions such as osteoarthritis, ligament injuries, and post-surgical rehabilitation challenges, including ACL and meniscus surgeries.

Our team of experienced sports physiotherapists and strength and conditioning coaches provides personalized online knee rehabilitation programs designed to help clients reduce pain, restore mobility, improve strength, and regain confidence in their daily lives.

We are looking for a motivated and results-driven \*\*Sales Consultant\*\* who can understand clients' concerns, communicate effectively, and successfully sell our online knee rehabilitation programs.

**About the Role**

As a Sales Consultant, you will be responsible for interacting with prospective clients seeking solutions for knee pain, sports injuries, and rehabilitation needs.

You will conduct one-on-one sales consultations over Google Meet, understand clients' concerns, explain our knee rehabilitation programs, handle objections, and convert qualified prospects into paying clients.

The role requires strong communication, consultative selling, consistent follow-ups, objection handling, and sales closing skills.

**Key Responsibilities**

###
**Requirements & Skills**

\*\*1. Strong Communication Skills\*\*

\*\*2. Sales & Objection Handling\*\*

- Ability to manage challenging conversations and address client doubts effectively.

- Persistence in following up with leads, including those who are hesitant, undecided, or require multiple conversations before making a decision.

- Strong ability to build trust, maintain client relationships, and convert follow-ups into successful sales.

- A result-oriented mindset with a strong focus on achieving sales targets.

\*\*3. Technical & Organizational Skills\*\*

- Good working knowledge of \*\*Google Sheets and Google Calendar\*\*.

- Ability to maintain organized lead records, track follow-ups, and manage appointments.

- Comfortable using Google Meet and other digital communication platforms.

- Willingness to quickly learn and adapt to new software, CRM platforms, and company systems.

\*\*4. Professional Qualities\*\*

- Strong work ethic, discipline, accountability, and professionalism.

- Self-motivated, persistent, target-oriented, and committed to achieving results.

- Willingness to learn, accept feedback, and continuously improve.

- Strong team collaboration and time-management skills.

- Ability to work independently in a remote environment.

\*\*5. Industry Knowledge (Preferred)\*\*

- Interest in fitness, rehabilitation, and helping individuals improve their quality of life.

- Candidates with experience in sales, physiotherapy, rehabilitation, fitness consultation, or service-based sales will be preferred.

\*\*P.S. Added Advantage:\*\* Preference will be given to candidates with a background in physiotherapy or strength and conditioning.

\*\*Note:\*\* Prior sales experience is an advantage but not mandatory. Candidates with excellent communication skills, a willingness to learn, and strong sales potential are encouraged to apply.

- \*\*Uncapped Incentives:\*\* No upper limit on commission earnings.

We are a Meta Technical Partner, working with leading brands across FMCG, Consumer Goods, Construction Materials, Auto Components, Agri and more — digitising their General Trade supply chain at scale, on WhatsApp.
  
  
The General Trade channel moves ₹50 lakh crore of goods every year in India. It runs on relationships, phone calls, and gut feel. ZoTok is the infrastructure layer that brings AI-powered speed, visibility and intelligence to that channel — without asking anyone to change the way they work.
  
  
**The Role**
We are looking for a Senior Sales Manager who has lived the General Trade grind — someone who has walked the market with an ASM or Zonal hat, understands the pain of a missed beat or a stockist claim gone wrong, and can walk into a Supply Chain Head's office and earn credibility in the first five minutes. You will own enterprise pipeline, run consultative sales cycles, and close deals that matter.
  
  
**Why ZoTok is the smartest career move for a seasoned GT Sales Leader**
The AI-for-Sales industry is one of the fastest-growing sectors globally — and ZoTok sits at a rare intersection: cutting-edge AI technology applied to a domain you already know deeply. Your years of managing zones, building distributor relationships and driving secondary sales are not just relevant here — they are your single biggest competitive advantage. You will be selling to people who think like you did, solving problems you have have lived firsthand.
  
  
This is not a role for someone who waits for a brief. We are looking for someone with a go-getter, ownership mindset — someone who can walk into an ambiguous situation, map the client's pain, design a solution on the fly and drive it to closure. If you have ever stood in a market and figured it out with no playbook, you will feel at home here.

* You understand the Distributor-Retailer-Brand triangle from the inside — beat plans, secondary sales, claim cycles, ROI conversations — and can walk into a Supply Chain or Sales Head's office and earn credibility in the first five minutes

. We help enterprises turn open and closed models into

without vendor or infrastructure lock-in.

****DL-Backtrace****

, enable explainability and auditability at a scale that enterprise AI demands.

Our customers deploy AI in environments where failures are expensive, regulation is real, and evidence matters: banking, financial services, insurance, and other high-risk domains.

****Senior AI Solutions Architect****

to lead strategic, high-value customer engagements and support large enterprise transactions. This is a senior, customer-facing pre-sales role for someone who combines
****deep AI understanding, system-level thinking, and executive communication skills****

.

****sovereign, governed, and defensible AI systems****

using Lexsi’s platform and research-led primitives.

This role is not about running delivery projects. It is about
****owning technical credibility in complex sales cycles****

.

You will lead technical discovery, solution design, and executive-level presentations for large, multi-stakeholder customers across Europe, the Middle East, and South Asia. You will frame customer problems around AI sovereignty, risk, governance, cost, and control, and translate them into clear architectures and evidence-backed solutions.

You will support advanced demos and proofs-of-concept, and help customers understand how Lexsi enables governed LLM gateways, explainability at scale, alignment and fine-tuning pipelines, and runtime observability.

Internally, you will act as the voice of the customer, feeding structured insights back into product, platform, and go-to-market strategy.

Who You Are

****pre-sales, solution architecture, or technical consulting roles****

tied to complex enterprise deals. You have built or shipped AI products and understand modern ML systems beyond surface-level tooling.

You are comfortable discussing topics such as explainability, alignment, evaluation, and deployment trade-offs with both researchers and senior enterprise stakeholders. You can walk into a high-stakes meeting and clearly explain why governance, auditability, and model optionality matter, without losing the room in technical detail.

You write clearly, present confidently, and operate well in ambiguity. You enjoy shaping solutions rather than following scripts.

Why This Role at Lexsi

You will work at the frontier of
****trustworthy and mission-critical AI****

, influencing how advanced research is adopted in real enterprises. You will play a visible role in large strategic deals and help define how Lexsi is positioned with regulators, banks, and global institutions.

With our ingenuity, drive and deep curiosity we discover new insights, innovations, and solutions that efficiently and responsibly resolve complex natural resource, digital, energy transition and infrastructure challenges.
  
  
**Job Details**
As a Business Development Manager, based in Mumbai, your primary responsibility for the company is to increase Viridien's visibility in the country, open the doors for new businesses, client relationships and network. To ensure that the company has the necessary visibility for key accounts of strategic importance to the company, within a given geographical (sub-region) perimeter.
  
  
**Key Responsibilities**
**Business Development & Market Engagement**

* Develop and maintain high-level relationships with NOCs, government agencies, regulatory bodies, and key industry stakeholders.
* Identify, originate, and mature new multi-client seismic opportunities across India.
* Drive business development activities, including opportunity qualification, commercial negotiations, consortium development, and strategic partnerships.
* Participate in government engagement initiatives to strengthen industry collaboration and support favorable regulatory frameworks.
* Monitor licensing rounds, lease sales, exploration activity, and client investment plans to identify new business opportunities.
* Work closely with imaging, processing and geology teams to develop and commercialize new seismic programs.
* Represent the company at industry conferences, workshops, trade missions, and technical forums to enhance market visibility and industry engagement.
* Support regional sales efforts through technical presentations, client workshops, and value demonstrations.

**Technical & Geoscience Support**

* Conduct basin screening and regional evaluations to identify and prioritize new multi-client project opportunities.
* Perform subsurface assessments, integrating petroleum geology, basin analysis, tectono-stratigraphy, structural interpretation, and seismic interpretation.
* Evaluate geological risks, exploration potential, and seismic imaging challenges to support project selection and investment decisions.
* Contribute technical input to survey design, acquisition planning, processing workflows, and imaging strategies.
* Prepare and deliver technical studies, presentations, and client-facing evaluations that clearly communicate project value and subsurface insights.
* Provide technical support to business development teams across the APAC region.
* Work closely with the Regional Technical Manager to develop technical solutions addressing client exploration and development challenges.
* Independently execute technical evaluations and provide balanced, commercially focused recommendations to support business growth.

**Preferred Qualifications & Experience**

* MSc or equivalent degree in Geology, Geophysics, or a related Earth Science discipline.
* 8+ years of experience in oil and gas exploration, with exposure to both subsurface evaluation and commercial/business development activities.
* Strong seismic interpretation skills using industry standard software (eg. Kingdom, Petrel, DUG etc.)
* Familiarity with GIS, preferably ArcPro.
* Strong knowledge of petroleum systems, basin analysis, seismic interpretation, and exploration workflows.
* Demonstrated experience working with NOCs, government organizations, and E&P operators in India.
* Proven ability to identify, develop, and mature exploration or multi-client opportunities.
* Excellent communication and presentation skills, with the ability to translate technical concepts into business value.
* Strong commercial acumen combined with a solid technical foundation.
* Self-motivated, collaborative, and able to work independently in a dynamic regional environment.

**Why Work with us?**
**Benefits**
At Viridien, we are dedicated to providing the needs of our employees; and we know every employee has unique personal goals, family circumstances, and preferences. That is why we offer a wide array of benefits to promote and enhance your total well-being:
  
  
**India**

* Flexible Hybrid Work Model
* Comprehensive Personal and Family Healthcare
* Supportive Financial Assistance
* Attractive Meal and Transport Allowance
* Fun Employee Wellness & Sustainable Activities

**Our Hiring Process**
At Viridien, we are committed to delivering a respectful, inclusive, and transparent recruitment experience.

title: Fixed Income Derivatives Sales Analyst
description:
**Job Description**
Support EMEA Fixed Income Derivatives Sales with pricing, structuring, analytics, and client materials; automate workflows
  
  
As a Fixed Income Derivatives Sales Analyst within the EMEA Sales team (Markets Group, CIB Research & Analytics) you will be responsible for supporting sales coverage through interest rate hedging and derivatives solutions for corporate clients. You will structure and price vanilla and bespoke derivatives using internal models, run analytics, and quantify key market and credit risks. You will work on trade ideas and client-ready strategies by synthesizing macro drivers and internal/external research and analysing payoff profiles for client objectives. You will create tailored client materials (pitchbooks, factsheets, and market analysis) and articulate product rationale in the current environment. You will support end-to-end trade execution and lifecycle processes while driving automation and process improvements using Python/VBA.
  
  
**Key Responsibilities**

* Support Fixed Income Derivatives sales/marketing coverage by understanding client objectives and identifying suitable interest rate hedging and derivatives solutions for corporate clients
* Structure and price derivative solutions (vanilla and bespoke) using internal flow pricing models and by combining option strategies, and run relevant analytics to support pricing metrics and quantify market/credit risks
* Generate trade ideas and client-ready strategies by synthesizing macroeconomic drivers and external/internal research, and optimizing payoff profiles for the target client base
* Create client materials for meetings including tailored pitchbooks/factsheets and market analysis, articulate product rationale for the current environment and backtest strategy outcomes where applicable
* Manage end-to-end trade support across the lifecycle including instrument setup/creation, booking support, term sheet preparation, note issuance coordination, and responding to post-trade client queries (settlements, lifecycle calculations, reconciliations, and documentation checks)
* Drive process improvement and automation for the sales team by building tools to streamline recurring workflows and daily tasks using Python/VBA

**Required Qualifications, Skills And Capabilities**

* Strong knowledge of derivatives and greeks – indices, futures, and options
* Strong knowledge of Equities, Rates, FX, and Commodities
* Knowledge of VBA and any object-oriented programming language (specifically Python)
* Close attention to detail and ability to work at very high standards of precision
* Ability to work in a fast-paced environment with Strong quantitative and analytical skills
* Good communication and team skills in a multi-location set up

title: Manager, Agency Sales
description:
**About the Role**

Razorpay Ads is building a commerce media and audience intelligence business powered by Razorpay’s transaction ecosystem. We are looking for a
**Manager – Agency Sales**
to build and scale our relationships with leading media agencies, digital agencies, agency trading teams, and their advertiser portfolios.

This is a high-ownership role at the intersection of
**advertising, data, commerce and fintech**
. You will be responsible for making Razorpay Ads a strategic partner for agencies — helping them leverage Razorpay’s audience intelligence and media capabilities to solve advertiser objectives across performance, customer acquisition, brand building, audience targeting and measurement.

The role goes beyond selling individual campaigns. You will own agency relationships, develop advertiser pipelines within agency portfolios, unlock briefs and budgets, and build a repeatable agency-led revenue engine for Razorpay Ads.

**What You’ll Own**

**Agency Relationship & Business Development**

* Build and own strategic relationships across leading agency networks, independent agencies and digital/performance agencies.
* Develop strong relationships with senior stakeholders across
  **agency leadership, investment, planning, strategy, digital, performance and account management teams**
  .
* Establish Razorpay Ads as a preferred partner for data-led, commerce-media and performance advertising solutions.
* Create agency-level account plans covering priority agencies, key stakeholders, advertiser portfolios, opportunities and revenue potential.
* Drive regular agency engagements, capability sessions, workshops and joint client conversations.

**Advertiser & Revenue Development**

* Identify high-potential advertisers within agency portfolios and build a structured pipeline of briefs and opportunities.
* Work with agency teams to understand advertiser objectives, media plans, campaign challenges and investment priorities.
* Convert agency relationships into
  **active advertisers, repeat advertisers and scalable revenue opportunities**
  .
* Own the sales cycle from prospecting and solutioning through proposal, commercial negotiation, campaign closure and renewal.
* Drive penetration across priority categories including
  **BFSI, fintech, D2C, e-commerce, travel, consumer internet, auto and other digitally intensive categories**
  .
* Build quarterly and annual agency revenue plans and maintain strong visibility on pipeline, closures and forecasts.

**Consultative & Solution Selling**

* Translate advertiser and agency briefs into solutions using Razorpay Ads’ media, audience and data capabilities.
* Position Razorpay’s transaction-led audience intelligence as a differentiated alternative or complement to conventional digital targeting signals.
* Develop solutions spanning
  **audience intelligence, transaction-led targeting, onsite/offsite media, performance campaigns, brand campaigns and measurement**
  .
* Build compelling narratives and proposals that connect Razorpay’s capabilities to measurable advertiser outcomes.
* Partner with agencies to create customized solutions rather than relying on standardized inventory-led selling.

**Agency GTM**

* Build a structured GTM strategy for priority agency groups and their advertiser portfolios.
* Map agency stakeholders, key accounts, upcoming pitches, annual planning cycles and seasonal/festive opportunities.
* Identify opportunities for agency-level partnerships, preferred partner programs, joint pitches and advertiser workshops.
* Develop repeatable playbooks for converting agency relationships into briefs, campaigns and recurring advertiser investments.
* Represent Razorpay Ads at relevant agency forums, industry conversations and advertiser engagements.

**Campaign Success & Account Growth**

* Partner closely with Campaign Management, Product and Operations teams to ensure campaigns deliver against advertiser objectives.
* Stay engaged beyond campaign closure to ensure strong advertiser and agency experience.
* Use campaign results and insights to drive renewals, upsells and larger annual commitments.
* Identify opportunities to expand successful campaigns across brands, categories and agency teams.
* Build case studies and proof points that can accelerate adoption across the wider agency ecosystem.

**Market Intelligence & Product Feedback**

* Maintain a strong understanding of the Indian digital advertising ecosystem, agency structures, advertiser budgets and emerging media trends.
* Track competitive offerings across ad networks, commerce media, retail media, audience platforms and large digital publishers.
* Bring structured agency and advertiser feedback to Product, Strategy and Campaign teams.
* Help shape Razorpay Ads’ positioning, packaging, pricing and product roadmap based on market demand.

**What Success Looks Like**

Success in this role will be measured primarily through:

**Agency penetration:**
Depth and quality of relationships across priority agencies and senior agency stakeholders.

**Active advertisers:**
Number of advertisers activated through the agency ecosystem.

**Quality advertisers:**
Ability to acquire strategic advertisers with meaningful and scalable budget potential.

**Advertiser retention:**
Repeat campaigns and continued investment from activated advertisers.

**Pipeline creation:**
Strength and quality of advertiser briefs and qualified opportunities generated through agencies.

**Revenue:**
Achievement of quarterly and annual revenue objectives.

**Strategic relationships:**
Ability to convert transactional agency relationships into long-term partnerships.

**What We’re Looking For**

* **5–8 years of experience**
  in agency sales, digital advertising, media sales, adtech, commerce media, publisher sales or related businesses.
* Strong existing relationships across
  **media agencies, digital agencies and/or performance agencies**
  in India.
* Demonstrated experience selling digital advertising solutions through agencies and influencing advertiser budgets.
* Strong understanding of the digital advertising ecosystem including
  **Meta, Google, programmatic, publisher media, performance marketing and brand advertising**
  .
* Ability to engage comfortably with stakeholders ranging from agency planners and account leads to Business Heads, Managing Partners and CXOs.
* Strong consultative selling and solutioning capabilities — able to start with a client problem rather than an inventory proposition.
* Strong commercial orientation with experience owning pipelines, negotiations and revenue targets.
* Good understanding of advertising metrics including CPM, CPC, CTR, CPL, CPA, ROAS, reach, frequency and brand/measurement metrics.
* Ability to interpret campaign performance and convert results into a compelling growth narrative.
* Strong presentation, communication and negotiation skills.
* High ownership, bias for action and comfort operating in an early-stage business where GTM playbooks are still being built.

**Strong Plus**

* Experience working at an
  **ad network, large digital publisher, commerce/retail media network, DSP, adtech platform or agency partnership function**
  .
* Existing relationships across leading agency networks and independent digital agencies.
* Experience selling to BFSI, fintech, D2C, e-commerce or consumer internet advertisers.
* Experience selling both
  **performance and branding solutions**
  .
* Exposure to first-party data, audience intelligence, CDPs, clean rooms, retail/commerce media or transaction-led advertising.
* Experience building a new agency channel or GTM motion from an early stage.

**The Person We’d Like to Hire**

We are looking for someone who is
**well-networked but not dependent on their network; commercially aggressive but consultative in approach; comfortable selling what exists today while helping shape what needs to be built tomorrow**
.

The ideal candidate understands how agencies operate, knows how budgets and briefs move through the ecosystem, can open senior-level conversations, and has the persistence and strategic thinking required to turn those relationships into a sustainable revenue engine for Razorpay Ads.

description:

GoKwik is building the growth operating system for D2C and eCommerce brands, enabling businesses to optimise checkout, reduce RTO, power payments, drive retention, and unlock post-purchase engagement. You will own the sales lifecycle, build strategic customer relationships, and translate market opportunities into sustainable revenue growth.

* New Business Development: Identify, prospect, and acquire new clients across the logistics, eCommerce, and supply chain ecosystem.

title: Clinical Sales Executive
description:

We’re a team of engineers, clinicians, and innovators united by one purpose: to make surgery smarter, safer, and more human. Every day, our work helps care teams perform with greater precision and patients recover faster, improving outcomes around the world.
  
  
The problems we solve demand creativity, rigor, and collaboration. The work is challenging, but deeply meaningful—because every improvement we make has the potential to change a life.

*da Vinci®*
Surgical Systems.

title: Regional Sales Manager
description:
Saferr | School Safety Technology

Website: https://saferr.app

Location: Bengaluru / Chennai / Hyderabad / Kochi/ Delhi NCR / Mumbai / Pune – flexible

Region: Karnataka, Tamil Nadu, Kerala, Telangana, Andhra Pradesh, North, West & East India

Experience: 5–12 years

**About Saferr**

Saferr is building a safer and more accountable way for schools to manage student pickup and release.

Our platform helps schools ensure that every child is released only to an authorised person, while giving schools and parents a simple, secure and auditable process.

We are now looking to partner with schools across India and are building our regional sales team.

**The Role**

We are looking for a Regional Sales Manager – South India who already has strong relationships within the school ecosystem.

This is not a traditional cold-sales role.

We are specifically looking for someone who can use their existing network and credibility with schools to open doors, meet school leadership, demonstrate Saferr and take schools from the first conversation through pilot and commercial onboarding.

**What You Will Do**

* Build and manage Saferr’s school network across South India.
* Leverage your
  **existing relationships with school owners, trustees, principals, administrators and management teams**
  to introduce Saferr.
* Identify and prioritise schools that are a strong fit for the platform.
* Secure meetings and conduct product presentations and demonstrations.
* Understand each school’s current student pickup, dispersal and safety processes.
* Work with the Saferr team to structure pilots and implementations.
* Manage the complete sales cycle from introduction → demo → pilot → commercial closure → onboarding.
* Develop relationships with school groups and chains for multi-school opportunities.
* Represent Saferr at relevant school conferences, associations and education events.
* Build a strong pipeline and deliver agreed school onboarding targets.

**Who We Are Looking For**

* **5+ years of experience working with or selling to schools.**
* An
  **active network of school decision-makers across South India.**
* Direct relationships with principals, school owners, trustees, directors or senior administrators.
* Experience selling EdTech, school ERP/SIS, security systems, transportation solutions, payments, insurance, hardware, curriculum products or other products/services to schools is preferred.
* Good understanding of decision-making and procurement within private schools.
* Strong presentation, relationship-building and closing skills.
* Entrepreneurial and comfortable working in a fast-moving, early-stage environment.
* Willingness to travel extensively within the region.

**What Matters Most**

We are less interested in the number of years on your CV and more interested in one question:

Can you open doors at good schools because you already know the people who run them?

If the answer is yes, we would like to speak with you.

**Success in This Role**

Success will be measured primarily by qualified school meetings generated, pilots initiated, schools commercially onboarded, students covered by Saferr, and development of school groups and multi-school partnerships.

**Why Saferr**

Student dispersal and pickup is one of the most sensitive daily operations for a school, yet in many schools the process still depends heavily on manual identification, phone calls and individual staff knowledge.

Saferr is building the technology layer to make this process verified, secure and accountable.

Every child. Every pickup. Verified.

Learn more at https://saferr.app

At Frauscher, we are dedicated to delivering the world’s most reliable train detection and wayside object control solutions. * Support preparation and verification of as-built information based on actual site installation.
* Track and close punch-list items and support customer inspection, acceptance, and handover activities.
* Coordinate with installation and construction subcontractors at site and monitor their progress, quality, and compliance with approved procedures.
* Provide regular updates of site progress, manpower, material requirements, risks, delays, and outstanding activities.

* Support timely completion of assigned projects and maintain a zero-failure approach through proper planning, installation, inspection, and testing.
* Always aim for zero failures

**Eligibility Criteria:**

* Diploma or BE / Btech - Electrical, Electronics, Electronics & Communication, Instrumentation, Mechanical, Rail Transportation or related engineering discipline.
* 3 or more years of experience in site execution, installation, testing and commissioning, preferably in railway signalling, electrical, electronics, industrial automation, or infrastructure projects.

* Good coordination, communication, reporting, and problem-solving skills.

* Mumbai

In short: People who aspire for more – individuals who are willing to contribute their passion, creativity and skills to help advance our shared vision. If you’re ready to revolutionize how the world moves for future generations, Wabtec is the place for you.

Business developers are results driven, client committed, and highly collaborative. Business Developers will be given a territory of Large Enterprise prospects, which may be completely new prospects with no existing spend or could be clients within other Gartner areas. Gartner has a promote from within culture and limitless opportunities for progression. Gartner leaders embrace this culture and are focused on helping associates achieve success in current role, as well as coaching associates to the next role or path, whether it be more senior BD levels, account management paths, or sales leadership. Typical internal promotions include:
  
  

* Business Development Director

* Collaborative, team-oriented culture that embraces inclusion
* Professional development and career growth opportunities

At Gartner, Inc. (NYSE:IT), we guide the leaders who shape the world.
  
  
Our mission relies on expert analysis and bold ideas to deliver actionable, objective business and technology insights, helping enterprise leaders and their teams succeed with their mission-critical priorities.
  
  
Since our founding in 1979, we’ve grown to 20,000 associates globally who support over 13,000 client enterprises in ~90 countries and territories. We do important, interesting and substantive work that matters. That’s why we hire associates with the intellectual curiosity, energy and drive to want to make a difference. The bar is unapologetically high. So is the impact you can have here.
  
  
**What makes Gartner a great place to work?**
Our vast, virtually untapped market potential offers limitless opportunities – opportunities that may not even exist right now – for you to grow professionally and flourish personally. How far you go is driven by your passion and performance.
  
  
We hire remarkable people who collaborate and win as a team. Together, our singular, unifying goal is to deliver results for our clients.
  
  
Our teams are inclusive and composed of individuals from different geographies, cultures, religions, ethnicities, races, genders, sexual orientations, abilities and generations.
  
  
We invest in great leaders who bring out the best in you and the company, enabling us to multiply our impact and results. This is why, year after year, we are recognized worldwide as a great place to work.
  
  
**Gartner is the world authority on AI**
At Gartner, you’ll join a company at the very center of the AI revolution. Gartner has proactive, objective guidance throughout clients’ AI journeys. We set the standard for how organizations leverage artificial intelligence to drive meaningful impact. You’ll have access to unmatched resources, expertise, and technology, and play a key role in helping Gartner and our clients innovate and grow as we leverage AI to transform business and technology landscapes.
  
  
It’s an exciting time to be at Gartner, with limitless opportunities to make a real impact, grow your skills, and build a lasting, meaningful career in a field that’s reshaping the way we operate. If you’re passionate about AI and want to be part of a team that’s guiding the leaders who shape the world, Gartner is the place for you.

Gartner offers world-class benefits, highly competitive compensation and disproportionate rewards for top performers.

title: Digital Advertising Sales — Mumbai
description:
Location: Mumbai — Work from Office / Hybrid

Role Type: Individual Contributor — hands-on hunting, pitching and closing

Experience: 3–8 years of Digital Advertising / Digital Media Sales experience

Compensation: ₹8–18 LPA fixed, calibrated to experience, network and closure track record + uncapped performance-linked commissions and bonuses tied directly to closed advertising business.

Exceptional candidates with proven relationships across brands, media agencies and advertising decision-makers can expect the top of the band — or beyond.

Read This Before Applying

This is a pure Digital Advertising Sales role.

We are looking for an experienced Digital Ad Sales professional who knows how to sell advertising solutions to brands, advertisers and media/advertising agencies.

This is not a marketing role, account-management role, campaign-operations role, customer-success role or team-management role.

You will be expected to prospect, pitch, negotiate and close digital advertising business every week.

If you have not personally sold digital advertising, digital media, programmatic, CTV, creator/influencer advertising or related advertising solutions to brand or agency decision-makers, please do not apply.

If you are looking for a fully remote position or a role focused primarily on servicing existing accounts, this position is not for you.

What is Social Gear?

Social Gear is a unified Digital Advertising Platform that enables brands and agencies to plan and execute advertising campaigns through a single interface across:

\* Creator / Influencer Marketing

\* Display Advertising

\* Programmatic Advertising

\* Connected TV (CTV)

\* Email Advertising

\* Digital Campaign Management

The platform is powered by Amazon, Google and other open exchanges, with targeting capabilities ranging from local and hyperlocal to national and global, including territory-based and multicultural targeting.

Our strongest growth area today is Creator Marketing, where we help brands discover relevant creators, verify authenticity and execute measurable campaigns.

And we own something that most advertising platforms cannot claim: LYKSTAGE, our own premium video streaming platform with Connected TV inventory across Roku, Apple TV, Amazon Fire TV, Samsung TV, LG TV and Android/Google TV.

This gives our Digital Ad Sales team the ability to sell both third-party digital advertising inventory and owned premium CTV inventory—providing advertisers with greater transparency and differentiated placement opportunities.

Social Gear serves advertisers across India, the US, UK, Canada, UAE and Singapore.

What You Will Own

This is a new-business Digital Advertising Sales role.

You will:

\* Hunt and acquire new brands, advertisers and advertising/media agencies.

\* Build your own pipeline through outbound prospecting, personal relationships, referrals and partnerships.

\* Identify advertising budgets and decision-makers within target brands and agencies.

\* Pitch Social Gear’s Digital Advertising solutions to Marketing Heads, CMOs, Brand Managers, Media Buyers, Agency Owners and other advertising decision-makers.

\* Conduct product and advertising-platform demos, both in person and virtually.

\* Understand a client’s marketing and advertising objectives and recommend the appropriate digital advertising solution.

\* Sell Creator Marketing, Display, Programmatic, CTV and other digital advertising solutions.

\* Prepare advertising proposals and media plans.

**Job description**

**Be the person IVF embryologists and clinicians call first!**

DSS Imagetech is looking for a driven sales professional to take charge of a west region, selling the IVF lab equipment that clinics depend on every day, and to build lasting relationships with the specialists who use them.

**The role at a glance:**

You will own IVF equipment sales for a Mumbai-based territory, working directly with the embryologists and clinicians who run IVF labs. It is a hands-on, field-first role: you demo the equipment, win the order, and stay on to support the customer after the sale.

**Role:**
Assistant Sales Manager – IVF Equipment

**Company:**
DSS Imagetech Pvt. Ltd.

**Location:**
Mumbai

**Experience:**
3 to 7 years

**What you'll do**

*Your job is to hit territory and brand-wise sales targets while becoming the trusted name in every IVF lab you cover. In practice, your week blends five kinds of work.*

* **Sell:**
  You own the sales numbers for your assigned territory, both overall and brand by brand. That means running product demos for
  **micromanipulators**
  ,
  **CO2 incubators**
  ,
  **laminar flow**
  systems and microscopes, guiding each customer from first enquiry to confirmed order, and managing orders and customer records through CRM and SAP.
* **Build relationships:**
  IVF is a specialist community, and trust is everything. You will stay in regular contact with embryologists, clinicians and technicians, and keep the database of embryologists and clinicians accurate and up to date so that no opportunity slips through.
* **Grow the territory:**
  You will research the market, track trends, study competitors, and spot new business opportunities before anyone else does, then turn those insights into your sales strategy for the territory.
* **Support after the sale:**
  A sale is only the beginning. You will work closely with the service and application teams to resolve customer queries quickly, and you will provide post-sale assistance so each installation keeps delivering for the lab.

**Who you are**

You are a confident, technically credible communicator who is equally comfortable at the lab bench and in the meeting room.

* **Experience and skills:**
  You bring 3 to 7 years of experience, along with excellent communication and presentation skills that let you explain complex equipment simply. You have strong technical and product knowledge of IVF equipment such as micromanipulators, CO2 incubators, laminar flow systems and microscopes, and an in-depth understanding of the IVF equipment and consumables markets. You are hands-on with G Suite, MS Office and CRM, and you are willing to travel across the region.

* **Education:**
  A science degree (BSc or MSc) is the foundation. A B.Tech in Biotechnology or Biomedical Engineering is preferred.

**Why DSS Imagetech**

You will join DSS Imagetech Pvt. Ltd., part of the DSS Group of Companies, a healthcare conglomerate, and sell technology that sits at the heart of fertility care. Instead of a single product line, you will work with a portfolio of core IVF lab equipment, which gives you more to talk about with every customer. Dedicated service and application teams stand behind each installation, so you can promise support and deliver it. And in a field where reputation travels fast, you will build your name with embryologists and clinicians across your territory.

title: Sales Business Development
description:
# JOB DESCRIPTION – INSIDE SALES ENGINEER

\*\*Company:\*\* Synergie Controls & Systems Pvt. Ltd.

\*\*Location:\*\* Taloja, Navi Mumbai, Maharashtra

\*\*Department:\*\* Sales & Business Development

\*\*Position:\*\* Inside Sales Engineer

\*\*Employment Type:\*\* Full-Time

\*\*Work Mode:\*\* Hybrid – Taloja Office + Work from Home as per company policy

\*\*Reporting To:\*\* Sales Manager / Head – Business Development

## 1. Job Purpose

The Inside Sales Engineer will be responsible for \*\*generating and qualifying sales enquiries, customer follow-up, preparing and coordinating quotations, maintaining the sales pipeline, and converting enquiries into orders\*\*.

The candidate will work closely with the \*\*Sales, Estimation, Engineering, Purchase, Stores and Project teams\*\* to ensure timely response to customers and effective closure of business opportunities.

The role is particularly focused on Synergie's \*\*Industrial Automation, Siemens products, PLC/HMI/SCADA, Drives, Control Panels, MCC/PCC Panels, automation projects and services\*\*.

## 2. Key Responsibilities

### A. Lead Generation & Customer Development

\* Generate new leads through:

\* Cold calling

\* Email campaigns

\* LinkedIn

\* Existing customer references

\* Online enquiries

\* Industrial databases

\* Customer mapping

\* Identify potential customers in:

\* Steel and metals

\* Manufacturing industries

\* OEMs

\* EPC contractors

\* System integrators

\* Panel builders

\* Pharma

\* Food & Beverage

\* Packaging

\* Water treatment

\* Cement, glass, rubber, sugar and other industries

\* Develop and maintain a database of prospective customers.

\* Identify decision-makers such as Purchase, Electrical, Automation, Maintenance, Projects and Plant Heads.

### B. Enquiry Management

\* Receive and understand customer enquiries.

\* Review technical requirements, BOQ, BOM, specifications and drawings.

\* Clarify missing information with customers.

\* Register every enquiry in the CRM/system.

\* Categorize enquiries based on product, project value, customer and probability.

\* Ensure no enquiry or customer follow-up is missed.

### C. Quotation & Pre-Sales Support

Coordinate with the estimation and engineering teams for preparation of:

\* Siemens PLC quotations

\* HMI and SCADA solutions

\* VFD / AC & DC Drive quotations

\* PLC/Automation Panels

\* MCC/PCC/LT Panels

\* Control Desks

\* DCS / PCS7 solutions

\* Retrofit and migration projects

\* Automation modification and upgradation

\* AMC and service requirements

Support preparation of \*\*BOQ/BOM, technical offers and techno-commercial quotations\*\*.

### D. Customer Follow-Up

\* Follow up systematically on all submitted quotations.

\* Understand the customer's feedback, competition and expected order date.

\* Record quotation status in CRM.

\* Follow up for:

\* Technical approval

\* Commercial negotiation

\* Purchase order

\* Payment

\* Dispatch

\* Maintain a daily follow-up schedule.

\* Escalate high-value or critical opportunities to the Sales Manager.

### E. Sales Conversion

\* Work towards converting enquiries into orders.

\* Understand why an enquiry is lost and record the reason.

\* Track:

\* Enquiry value

\* Quotation value

\* Expected order value

\* Probability

\* Expected order date

\* Competitor

\* Gross margin

\* Support negotiation with customers within approved company limits.

\* Identify opportunities for repeat business and additional products.

### F. CRM & Sales Reporting

Maintain accurate and updated information in \*\*Zoho CRM / company sales systems\*\*.

Daily update should include:

\* New enquiries

\* Calls made

\* Customer discussions

\* Quotations submitted

\* Follow-ups completed

\* Orders received

\* Lost enquiries

\* Next action and follow-up date

Prepare regular:

\* Daily sales activity report

\* Weekly enquiry report

\* Sales pipeline report

\* Quotation follow-up report

\* Order conversion report

\* Lost enquiry analysis

### G. Customer Relationship Management

\* Maintain professional communication with customers.

\* Develop long-term relationships with existing customers.

\* Regularly contact inactive/old customers.

\* Identify new requirements from existing customers.

\* Generate opportunities for:

\* Retrofit

\* PLC migration

\* Drive replacement

\* Panel modification

\* Automation upgradation

\* Service

\* AMC

\* Spares

\* New projects

### H. Coordination with Internal Teams

Coordinate closely with:

\*\*Sales → Estimation → Engineering → Purchase → Production → Testing → Projects → Accounts\*\*

Ensure proper communication of customer requirements and commercial commitments.

## 3. Technical Knowledge Required

Candidate should have basic understanding of:

\* Siemens PLC – S7-1200 / S7-1500

\* HMI

\* SCADA / WinCC

\* AC Drives / VFD

\* DC Drives

\* MCC / PCC / LT Panels

\* PLC Automation Panels

\* Control Panels

\* Electrical components

\* Motors and basic electrical systems

\* Industrial automation

\* Basic electrical drawings and BOQ/BOM

Knowledge of \*\*Siemens automation products\*\* will be strongly preferred.

## 4. Qualification

\*\*Diploma / B.E. / B.Tech\*\* in:

\* Electrical Engineering

\* Electronics Engineering

\* Electronics & Telecommunication

\* Instrumentation Engineering

\* Automation Engineering

MBA/PG Diploma in Sales & Marketing will be an advantage.

## 5. Experience

\*\*Experience:\*\* 1–5 years preferred.

Candidates with experience in:

\* Industrial Automation

\* Electrical products

\* Control Panels

\* Siemens products

\* Industrial B2B sales

\* Technical sales

\* Inside sales

\* Electrical/automation distribution

will be preferred.

Freshers with strong communication skills and technical knowledge may also be considered for a trainee/entry-level position.

## 6. Required Skills

### Technical Skills

\* Basic knowledge of PLC, HMI, SCADA and Drives

\* Understanding of electrical panels and automation products

\* Ability to understand BOQ/BOM

\* Basic technical proposal understanding

### Sales Skills

\* Lead generation

\* Cold calling

\* Customer follow-up

\* Enquiry handling

\* Quotation follow-up

\* Negotiation

\* Order conversion

\* Customer relationship management

### Software Skills

\* MS Excel

\* MS Word

\* PowerPoint

\* CRM software – preferably Zoho CRM

\* Email communication

\* Basic knowledge of ERP systems will be an advantage

### Behavioural Skills

\* Good spoken and written English

\* Good communication skills

\* Positive attitude

\* Strong follow-up discipline

\* Target-oriented approach

\* Ability to work independently

\* Good coordination skills

\* Professional customer handling

\* Willingness to learn

## 7. Hybrid Work Model

This position will follow a \*\*hybrid working model\*\*.

The employee may work from home for defined inside-sales activities such as:

\* Customer calling

\* Email follow-up

\* CRM updating

\* Lead generation

\* Quotation follow-up

\* Sales reporting

However, the employee must attend the \*\*Taloja office whenever required\*\* for:

\* Sales meetings

\* Internal coordination

\* Product/technical training

\* Quotation discussions

\* Customer meetings

\* Sales reviews

\* Team meetings

\* Important project discussions

\*\*Work-from-home is subject to performance, discipline, availability and management approval.\*\*

## 8. Key Performance Indicators – KPIs

The employee will be evaluated on:

| KPI | Measurement |

| ------------------ | ----------------------------------- |

| New Leads | Number of qualified leads generated |

| Customer Calls | Daily/weekly activity |

| Enquiries | Qualified enquiries generated |

| Quotations | Number and value of quotations |

| Follow-Up | % of quotations followed on time |

| Conversion | Enquiry-to-order conversion % |

| Sales | Monthly / annual order value |

| New Customers | Number of new active customers |

| CRM Discipline | 100% enquiry and follow-up updating |

| Lost Enquiries | Proper reason and analysis |

| Collection Support | Coordination for payment follow-up |

## 9. Sales Target Responsibility

The Inside Sales Engineer will be given \*\*monthly, quarterly and annual sales targets\*\*.

\*\*Lead Generation → Qualified Enquiry → Quotation → Follow-Up → Conversion → Order Value → Gross Margin\*\*

\* Technically inclined

\* Target-oriented

\* Comfortable with telephone-based sales

\* Good in Excel and CRM

\* Interested in industrial automation

\* Willing to learn Siemens products

\* Capable of working independently in a hybrid environment

\* Focused on converting enquiries into business

## 11. Compensation & Incentives

Salary will be based on \*\*experience, technical knowledge and sales capability\*\*.

Performance-based incentives may be provided based on company sales and incentive policy.

## 12. Career Growth

A successful candidate can grow into:

\*\*Inside Sales Engineer → Senior Inside Sales Engineer → Technical Sales Engineer → Sales Manager → Business Development Manager\*\*

\*\*This is not a simple telecalling position.\*\*

The candidate must be capable of understanding the customer's \*\*technical requirement, coordinating with the engineering/estimation team, following up commercially and contributing to actual order conversion.\*\*

title: Sales Manager - Projects
description:
**About Spaceline Infra Pvt. Ltd.**

Spaceline Infra is a channel partner for leading global interior and architectural product brands, including Knauf, Armstrong, Danoline, dormakaba, Shaw Contract and Hörmann. Our portfolio covers ceilings and acoustic systems, access solutions, key & wall solutions, doors & hardware, and flooring.

For many years, we have served clients across West India in corporate offices, retail, hospitality, healthcare, education, premium residential, government and institutional buildings, industrial and warehousing, infrastructure, and specialised venues such as auditoriums and data centres. We offer both supply-only and turnkey solutions.

**The role**

This role is focused entirely on project sales across West and Central India.

You will own the project pipeline from first contact to collected payment. That means getting our brands specified with architects and designers, winning orders from contractors and developers, and working with our execution team to deliver. You will report directly to a Director.

**What you'll do**

**Get specified**

* Build relationships with architects, interior designers, PMCs, specialist consultants and contractors so our brands are specified early and stay specified through to the order.
* Run product presentations, CPD sessions and sample showings with design firms.

**Win orders**

* Find and qualify project leads across commercial offices, hospitality, healthcare, education and retail.
* Work with our estimation team on quotations and tender responses, and lead pricing negotiations with contractors, developers and end clients.
* Coordinate with brand principals on technical support, pricing approvals and samples.

**Deliver and collect**

* Hand won orders to our execution and accounts teams with clear scope, timelines and payment terms.
* Stay involved until delivery and installation are complete, and follow up on payments until they are collected.

**Plan and report**

* Maintain an up-to-date pipeline of leads, quotes and orders, and share a weekly update with the Directors.
* Meet quarterly sales targets.
* Help refine our project sales approach and, as the business grows, hire and lead a small sales team.

**What we're looking for**

**Must have**

* 4–8 years of B2B project sales in interior or building products, such as ceilings, acoustics, flooring, doors, hardware, glass or façade systems.
* A working network of architects, interior designers, contractors and PMCs in Mumbai, with reach into other West India cities.
* A record of closing project orders, from getting a product specified through to the purchase order.
* Comfort reading drawings and BOQs and discussing technical specifications.
* Willingness to travel across the territory.
* Fluent English and Hindi. Marathi is a plus.
* A bachelor's degree. A degree in engineering, architecture, interior design or construction, and/or an MBA, is a strong advantage.

**Good to have**

* Experience working with brands like Armstrong, Saint-Gobain, Knauf, dormakaba, Hörmann or a flooring manufacturer, or with one of their channel partners.
* Experience with tenders for corporate, hospitality or institutional projects.
* Disciplined about tracking leads, follow-ups and forecasts, whether in a CRM or a spreadsheet.

**Who you are**

* Excellent communication and people skills, with clients and within the team.
* High integrity: honest and reliable on pricing, commitments and how you represent us.
* Eager to learn our products in depth and to grow with the company.
* Comfortable in a fast-paced organisation where priorities can shift quickly.
* Proactive and a team player. Once your own area is on track, you step in to support wherever needed. This is central to how we work.

**What we offer**

* Fixed salary of Rs. 9-12 LPA, depending on experience.
* Attractive performance incentives, paid quarterly, with no upper cap.
* Travel and mobile allowances.
* A portfolio of globally recognised brands to sell.
* Direct access to the Directors, quick decisions, and room to grow into a sales leadership role.

**How to apply**

Please email your CV to Tanmay Jayaswal at t.jayaswal@spacelineinfra.com with the subject line "Sales Manager – Projects". In your email, briefly describe one project you have closed, including what you sold, who specified it and how you secured the order. Please also tell us why you would like to join Spaceline Infra.

title: Business Head - Reddit Ads Sales
description:
**Are you ready to join our digital revolution journey?**
At
**Aleph**
, we’re not just part of the digital advertising landscape—we’re shaping its future. Representing the world’s leading platforms, including TikTok, Amazon, Google, and nearly 55 others, we operate in 130+ markets across new and existing geographies.
  
  
Our mission is to empower advertisers and brands to unlock the full potential of these platforms' advertising capabilities. By fostering long-lasting partnerships, we create limitless opportunities for people and businesses to advertise effectively at both local and global levels.
  
  
With a presence spanning continents, Aleph offers you the chance to be part of a fast-growing, innovative team where your work makes a direct impact. If you’re ambitious, forward-thinking, and eager to thrive in a dynamic, global environment, Aleph is the perfect place to build your career.
  
  
The
**Business Head for Reddit Advertising**
, India, will be a visionary and results-driven leader responsible for the strategic growth and overall financial performance of the Reddit advertising partnership business within India. Based in either our Mumbai or Delhi office, this pivotal role involves maximizing revenue generation, leading local sales and operations, and cultivating high-level relationships with major advertisers, agency partners, and the regional Aleph & Reddit team. The ideal candidate possesses a deep understanding of the digital media and advertising landscape in India, exceptional commercial acumen, and proven team leadership capabilities — making this a strong fit for professionals searching for Head of Sales, or Digital Advertising Sales Head roles in the India market.
  
  
**What You Will Do**

* Strategic Business & Revenue Leadership
* P&L Ownership: Drive and manage the full profit and loss (P&L) for the Reddit advertising business in India, with a primary focus on achieving and exceeding ambitious sales and revenue targets.
* Market Strategy: Develop and execute a robust, localized sales strategy to effectively monetize Reddit's advertising inventory, grow market share, and establish Reddit as a leading digital advertising platform in India.
* Forecasting & Reporting: Provide accurate sales forecasting, track key performance indicators (KPIs), and deliver comprehensive business performance reports to Aleph and Reddit leadership.
* Client and Partner Relationship Management
* Executive Stakeholder Management: Cultivate and maintain strong, high-level, and strategic relationships with key C-level executives at Reddit's regional teams, major local and global advertisers, and media/creative agency holding groups.
* Partnership Growth: Act as the primary local representative and expert for the Reddit partnership, ensuring alignment on commercial goals, product updates, and go-to-market strategies.
* Market Advocacy: Drive thought leadership and market education on the value of digital advertising and Reddit's advertising solutions within the India ecosystem.
* Commercial Development & Innovation
* Sales Program Development: Conceptualize, champion, and implement innovative sales pitches, business cases, and advertiser programs that effectively demonstrate the ROI of Reddit Ads and accelerate client investment.
* Product Evangelism: Work closely with technical and product teams to translate new Reddit advertising products (e.g., dynamic ad insertion, advanced targeting) into compelling commercial opportunities for the local market.
* Big Deal Closure: Lead negotiations and secure major, strategic advertising deals with top-tier brands and agencies.
* Team Management and Operational Excellence
* Team Leadership: Recruit, mentor, and lead a high-performing sales, client solutions, and operations team, fostering a culture of accountability, continuous learning, and sales excellence.
* Operational Efficiency: Oversee the operational workflow, including media sales, payments, billing, and creative support, ensuring seamless service delivery and adherence to all global and local compliance standards.
* Performance Management: Establish clear team objectives, conduct regular performance reviews, and ensure the team is leveraging Aleph's proprietary technology and services to achieve optimum results.

**What We Are Looking For**

* Bachelor's degree in Business Administration, Marketing, or a related field; a master's degree is a plus.
* Minimum of 8+ years of progressive experience in digital media, advertising sales, or business development, with at least 3–5 years in a senior leadership or Head of Business/Sales role, preferably within a global technology or media company.
* Local Market Expertise: Deep, verifiable experience and a strong network within the Indian media, advertising, and agency landscape (Mumbai/Delhi ecosystem experience preferred).
* Commercial Acumen: Proven track record of managing a significant P&L, consistently exceeding sales quotas, and driving strategic partnerships.
* Leadership Skills: Exceptional ability to lead, inspire, and develop a multidisciplinary team.
* Communication: Fluent in English, with outstanding presentation, negotiation, and cross-cultural communication skills.

**Why Join Aleph**

* Shape a market from the top: Own the P&L and go-to-market strategy for one of the world's most recognizable digital platforms in one of its fastest-growing advertising markets — India.
* Direct influence, high visibility: Work at the intersection of Aleph and Reddit's regional leadership, with a seat at the table for product, commercial, and partnership decisions.
* Growth-stage energy, established backing: Join a business at an exciting inflection point in India's digital advertising sector, backed by Aleph's global infrastructure and Reddit's growing ad platform.

**Why Join Us?**
Aleph is a place of many cultures, perspectives, and talents. We support each other, creating an environment of giving and receiving. We value partnership and communication because we believe it takes a group of people to achieve great things. We are energized by our ever-changing industry, our curiosity keeps us learning and seeking out new opportunities.
  
  
We stay flexible and adaptable, and believe in moving with the speed of change. We encourage everyone to strive for more, providing our internal talent with growth opportunities and the ability to learn together.

By overseeing guest-facing operations, team leadership, service excellence, vendor management, and operational efficiency, the Hospitality Manager elevates the customer journey, strengthens brand image, and creates memorable experiences for HNI, UHNI, NRI, celebrity, and VIP visitors.

* Guest Experience Leadership
* Design and deliver an exceptional guest journey from arrival to departure.
* Ensure every visitor receives personalized, warm, and professional service aligned with luxury hospitality standards.
* Develop memorable experiences for HNI, UHNI, NRI investors, celebrities, and VIP guests.
* Personally oversee all VIP visits and high-profile customer engagements.
* Resolve guest concerns promptly with professionalism and discretion.
* Monitor guest feedback and implement continuous service improvement initiatives.

* Maintain impeccable presentation and luxury hotel standards across all areas.
* Team Leadership & Development
* Lead, inspire, and develop a high-performing team of Guest Relations Executives, Reception Associates, Concierge Associates, Butler Team, Pantry Associates, Housekeeping Supervisors, Housekeeping Associates, and support staff.
* Handle recruitment, onboarding, performance management, training, grooming & etiquette coaching, shift planning, employee engagement, and succession planning.
* Foster a culture of service excellence, accountability, and continuous improvement.

* Conduct regular service audits and coaching sessions to ensure consistency.
* Food & Beverage Management
* Oversee premium pantry and refreshment operations with focus on presentation, inventory management, product quality, food safety, vendor coordination, cost control, and wastage minimization.
* Vendor & Service Partner Management
* Manage vendors for Housekeeping, Security, Pest Control, HVAC, Landscaping, Floral Services, Coffee Machines, Water Purification, Consumables, and Waste Management.
* Monitor performance through SLAs, periodic reviews, and quality audits.
* Facility Coordination

* Maintain full operational readiness of the sales gallery at all times.
* Maintain AMC and Service Records and follow-up timely services
* Facilitate breakdown recovery by handymen services or authroised vendor partners

* Manage operational budgets, hospitality costs, inventory planning, stock audits, asset tracking, consumption analysis, vendor billing, and cost optimization.
* Quality Assurance & Compliance
* Ensure adherence to SOPs, Brand Standards, Safety & Hygiene protocols, and Operational Checklists.
* Conduct audits and implement corrective actions.
* Reporting & Management Information
* Prepare Daily Operations Reports, Weekly Dashboards, Guest Feedback Analysis, Incident Reports, Vendor Reviews, Budget Reports, and Monthly Hospitality Scorecards.
* Provide data-driven recommendations for improvement.

**Educational Qualifications**
Bachelor’s Degree in Hotel Management, Hospitality Management, Business Administration, or Tourism Management. Master’s Degree or PG in Hospitality Management is preferred.
  
  
**Experience**
7–12 years of progressive experience in luxury hospitality with a minimum 3 years in a managerial/leadership role. Experience in luxury hotels (Taj, Oberoi, Four Seasons preferred).
  
  
**Key Competencies**

* Luxury Guest Experience & VIP Management
* Front Office, Concierge & Butler Services
* Housekeeping & Food & Beverage Operations
* Team Leadership & People Development
* Vendor & Contract Management
* Budget & Inventory Control
* Quality Assurance & Service Audits
* Excellent Communication & Presentation Skills
* Microsoft Office Suite

**Key Performance Indicators (KPIs)**

* Customer Satisfaction (CSAT/NPS)
* Audit Scores
* Vendor SLA Compliance
* Team Productivity & Retention

title: Sponsorship Sales Specialist
description:
**India worships one sport. Every kid here can talk about a cover drive before they learn alphabet. But somewhere past the boundary ropes, a new arena is filling up cages instead of pitches, fighters instead of batsmen and it is growing faster than most people in the room realise.** 




**Having spent close to two decades inside this sport, as India's only UFC panellist on Sony, I have witnessed MMA go from a niche YouTube search to genuine obsession for a generation that grew up on octagon highlights. Superhuman Sportz exists to give that obsession a real home \- India's first structured combat sports IP, built fighter\-first, from Amateur to Pro.** 




  





**We have run the events. We have filled the galleries. Now we need someone who can walk into a boardroom and make a brand believe what a packed arena can offer.** 




  





**THE ROLE** 




**You will be the person who turns** 
*“never heard of it”* 
 into a signed sponsorship deal. That means two very different conversations, often in the same week \- getting a foot in the door with a brand executive and then discussing with CMO or Founder to sign the sponsorship contract with us.
 



  





 WHAT'S EXPECTED FROM YOU
 


* Open doors at the ground level : build real relationships with brand marketing teams who can get you into the room.
* Close the deal with CMOs and founders directly : this isn't a role that hands off the hard conversation to someone senior.
* Figure out which brands actually belong here : sports \& fitness, energy \& nutrition, auto \& two\-wheelers, fintech and lifestyle and go after them with intent, not a spray\-and\-pray list.
* Own the pipeline end to end : from first cold outreach to a signed contract supported by founders.
* Build the sponsorship playbook as you go : work closely with the founders to shape packages that make maximises category ROI.



  





**EXPERIENCE WE ARE LOOKING FOR** 



* 3\-7 years in sponsorship sales, media sales or brand partnerships. Prior exposure in revenue generation in Media, Sports industry would be useful
* A real track record of closing deals at the CMO/founder level, not just managing accounts someone else opened.
* Comfortable moving between a first cold conversation and a boardroom negotiation, often in the same deal cycle.
* Startup instincts \- lean team, fast calls, no big brand name to lean on yet. You build the credibility as you go.



  





  





**THE SKILLS THAT ACTUALLY MATTER HERE** 



* Storytelling that makes a CXO see themselves inside an emerging sports that hasn't been told yet. This sport won't sell off a template.
* Out\-of\-the\-box thinking \- the standard logo and banner pitch doesn't work in a category brands haven't budgeted for. You will have to invent the ask.
* Sharp category instinct \- knowing exactly why a brand fits before you ever pick up the phone.
* A high tolerance for “no” \- you are not selling an established property, you are building category belief one conversation at a time.



  





**WHERE** 




**Mumbai preferred. Open to Delhi and Bangalore for the right person.** 




  





*If you ever watched a room turn from skeptical to sold and you want to do that for a sport that's about to explode in this country , let's talk.*
