title: Event Sales Manager
description:
***ABOUT THE COMPANY***




  





 Messe Berlin India is a subsidiary of Messe Berlin GmbH, one of the world’s leading trade fair and conference organisers. As part of Messe Berlin’s international network, Messe Berlin India is focused on developing and expanding the company’s presence in the Indian market through a growing portfolio of B2B exhibitions and conferences across key industry sectors.
 



  





***RESPONSIBILITIES***




  





 We are looking for a commercially driven and results\-oriented
 **Event Sales Manager** 
 to join our team in India. The role will be responsible for driving exhibitor and sponsorship sales across Messe Berlin India’s growing portfolio of B2B exhibitions and conferences.
 



  





 The ideal candidate is a proactive sales professional with strong business development and relationship management skills, capable of developing new accounts, managing existing clients, and identifying commercial opportunities across different industry sectors.
 



  





 Experience in the travel and tourism and/or fresh produce sectors would be an added advantage.
 



  





**Key responsibilities include:** 




  





**Sales \& Revenue Generation** 



* Drive exhibition space, sponsorship, advertising, and other commercial sales to achieve agreed revenue targets.
* Identify, prospect, and secure new exhibitors, sponsors, pavilions, and commercial partners across relevant industry sectors.
* Develop and maintain a strong sales pipeline through prospecting, referrals, industry research, networking, and market engagement.
* Prepare sales proposals, quotations, contracts, and commercial presentations tailored to client requirements.
* Conduct regular follow\-ups with prospects and existing clients to convert opportunities into confirmed participation.
* Identify opportunities to cross\-sell and upsell exhibition space, sponsorships, branding, and other event products.



  





**Account Management** 



* Build and maintain strong, long\-term relationships with exhibitors, sponsors, key accounts, associations, and industry partners.
* Manage assigned accounts throughout the sales cycle, from initial engagement and proposal development through contract signing, event delivery, and post\-event follow\-up.
* Understand client objectives and recommend appropriate participation packages, sponsorship opportunities, and branding solutions.
* Drive exhibitor retention and rebooking by maintaining strong client relationships and delivering a high standard of service.
* Coordinate with internal teams to ensure commercial commitments to exhibitors and sponsors are delivered effectively.



  





**Business \& Market Development** 



* Research and map target sectors, companies, and market segments relevant to assigned events.
* Identify new business opportunities, industry clusters, associations, government\-linked organisations, and potential international participation.
* Monitor industry trends, competitor events, pricing, and market developments to support sales strategy and positioning.
* Support the development of international pavilions, group participation, and strategic commercial partnerships.
* Represent Messe Berlin India at industry events, trade fairs, roadshows, networking activities, and client meetings where required.



  





**Sales Planning \& Reporting** 



* Maintain accurate and up\-to\-date sales pipelines, forecasts, and account information in the CRM system.
* Provide regular sales updates, revenue forecasts, market feedback, and competitor intelligence to management.
* Monitor performance against individual and event sales targets and take appropriate action to address gaps.
* Maintain accurate records of leads, opportunities, activities, contracts, and confirmed business.



  





**Cross\-Functional Collaboration \& Event Support** 



* Work closely with Project, Marketing, Conference, Partnerships, Finance, and Operations teams to support the commercial objectives of assigned events.
* Collaborate with Marketing on lead\-generation campaigns, sales materials, and targeted market outreach.
* Coordinate with Operations and Project teams on exhibitor requirements and commercial commitments.
* Support onsite exhibitor and sponsor servicing, key account management, and client engagement during events.
* Participate in post\-event reviews and provide client and market feedback to support future event development.



  





***QUALIFICATIONS***



* Minimum 3–5 years of sales experience, preferably within B2B exhibitions, conferences, sponsorship, media, trade associations, or a related commercial environment.
* Proven track record of achieving sales targets and developing new business.
* Strong prospecting, negotiation, presentation, and closing skills.
* Comfortable with cold calling, client meetings, networking, and consultative selling.
* Strong account management and relationship\-building capabilities.
* Ability to understand different industry sectors and translate client objectives into relevant commercial opportunities.
* Strong organisational and time\-management skills with the ability to manage multiple accounts and deadlines.
* Experience using CRM systems and maintaining structured sales pipelines.
* Experience working within an international or multicultural business environment would be an advantage.



  





***WHY JOIN US?***




  





 At Messe Berlin India, you will be part of a growing international exhibition business with the opportunity to work across established event brands as well as new launches in the Indian market. You will collaborate with colleagues and partners across Messe Berlin’s international network and contribute directly to the commercial growth of our exhibition portfolio in India.
 



  





 If you are ready to take the next step in your career in the exhibitions and events industry, we would be pleased to hear from you. Send your application to
 **hr@messe\-berlin.in** 
 .
 



  





*\*\*Only shortlisted candidates will be contacted. We thank all applicants for their interest in joining Messe Berlin India.*

title: Sales and Client Engagement Internship
description:
Reaviva Holistic Health is a premium, science\-led wellness centre in Santacruz West, Mumbai, offering integrated care across aesthetics, fitness, recovery, nutrition and mental well\-being. We are offering a six month, full time internship for management graduates who wish to build a career in sales and client relationship management.
 



  





**The Role** 




 The intern will manage the enquiries the centre receives each day, engaging prospective clients by telephone and WhatsApp, and converting genuine interest into booked consultations. The quality of the first conversation determines whether an enquiry becomes a consultation, so the internship suits candidates who are articulate, assured on the telephone, and comfortable being assessed on measurable outcomes from the outset.
 



  





**Key Responsibilities** 



1. Contact every enquiry generated by the centre's marketing activity by telephone, and complete the agreed follow\-up sequence for those not reached at the first attempt
2. Qualify each enquiry through structured discussion, establish the prospective client's requirement and circumstances, and book a consultation at the centre
3. Respond to inbound telephone calls, WhatsApp messages and direct messages within the agreed response time, through the working day
4. Improve the attendance rate of booked consultations through timely reminders and a clear explanation of what the appointment involves
5. Record every conversation and update the enquiry stage in the customer relationship management system as it occurs, so that no enquiry is lost and no client is contacted twice on the same matter
6. Submit a daily summary of calls placed, connections made and consultations booked, and take part in the weekly review of the enquiry funnel
7. Uphold the confidentiality, discretion and presentation standards expected in a premium health and wellness environment, and make no claim about a treatment or an outcome that has not been approved by the medical team



  





**Candidate Requirements** 



1. A postgraduate degree in management, either completed or in the final stage, from a recognised institution
2. Spoken English of a high standard, together with fluency in Hindi. A clear, courteous and unhurried telephone manner is the principal requirement of the role
3. The ability to listen attentively, to ask considered follow\-up questions rather than rely on a script, and to converse with senior professionals with confidence
4. Comfort with daily measurement of calls made, connections achieved and consultations booked
5. Working knowledge of spreadsheets and of customer relationship management systems
6. Availability to work full time from the centre at Santacruz West for the full six months



 What the Internship Offers
 


1. A monthly stipend, confirmed at the time of offer
2. Structured training in the consultative selling of high value services, provided by the Sales Manager
3. Exposure to the complete client journey, from first enquiry through consultation to treatment
4. A certificate of completion, and consideration for a permanent position at the end of the term, subject to performance



  





**Position Details** 




 Position: Sales and Client Engagement Intern
 



 Reporting to: CMO / Sales Manager
 



 Location: Santacruz West, Mumbai. This is a full time, on site internship and is not remote or hybrid
 



 Duration: Six months
 



 Working days: Monday to Saturday
 



 Working hours: 11:00 AM to 8:00 PM
 



  





**How to Apply** 




 Please apply through LinkedIn, or send your curriculum vitae and a brief covering note to hardikdesai@reavivaholistichealth.com. Shortlisted candidates will be contacted for an on\-site discussion.

**GTM \& Partnerships** 



* Build and execute the GTM strategy

**Business Operations** 



* Own business\-side execution

* Track commercial metrics and outcomes

**Fundraising \& Company Building** 



* Support investor conversations
* Help build the company's commercial narrative
* Participate in strategic decisions
* Help build the team as Orkeneo scales



  





**Who We're Looking For** 




 We're looking for someone who is
 **strong in sales and business development first** 
 and wants to grow into a full founder role.
 



  





 You could be from:
 


* Restaurant Technology / FoodTech
* POS companies
* Restaurant chains
* B2B SaaS
* Enterprise Sales
* Business Development
* Strategic Partnerships
* Startup Growth
* Founder’s Office
* Hospitality Technology

 , restaurant chains or B2B SaaS companies would be relevant — but
 **network \+ execution ability matters more than brand names.** 




  





**You should be able to:** 



* Sell to restaurant owners and decision\-makers
* Build relationships from zero
* Generate your own leads
* Run discovery calls and demos
* Close pilots/customers
* Build partnerships
* Work independently without constant direction
* Understand business numbers
* Make decisions under uncertainty
* Take ownership of outcomes, not just activities
* Commit for the long term



  





**A strong existing network among restaurant owners/chains, POS companies or B2B buyers is a major advantage.** 




  





**Founder Commitment** 




 This is
 **not a salaried employment opportunity** 
 .
 



  





 We are looking for a
 **true founding partner** 
 who is willing to commit full\-time after a mutually agreed evaluation period.
 



  





 The selected co\-founder will receive
 **meaningful founder equity** 
 , subject to mutually agreed responsibilities, contribution, vesting and documentation.
 



  





**Financial commitment** 




 The incoming co\-founder should also be prepared to contribute
 **50% of mutually agreed founder/company capital requirements** 
 , alongside the existing founder, as required for essential company expenses and growth.
 



  





 The exact contribution, equity structure, vesting, roles and decision rights will be discussed transparently before the partnership is finalized and documented formally.
 



  





**Evaluation Before Long\-Term Partnership** 




 We don't want to make a founder decision based only on interviews.
 



  





 Shortlisted candidates may work with us through a
 **3–4 week real\-world founder evaluation** 
 , focused on:
 


* Restaurant outreach
* Customer discovery
* Sales conversations
* Pilot acquisition
* PMF validation
* GTM execution
* Working style and ownership

 **how we actually work together** 
 before entering into a long\-term co\-founder partnership.

**Mumbai / Thane preferred** 




  





 Open to candidates elsewhere in India if they can work closely with the founding team and customers.

 **build a company**

title: Technical Sales Engineer
description:
**Company Description** 
 Kirti Lasers specializes in the design, development, and prototyping of advanced laser systems for industrial, medical, and defense applications. The company’s work spans laser materials processing, high‑power and pulsed laser systems, and precision optics and optical metrology. Teams at Kirti Lasers use CAD/CAM tools and specialized measurement instruments to build, test, and optimize laser solutions. The organization emphasizes laser safety, robust electronic control systems, and continuous process improvement to deliver high‑quality, reliable products. This environment offers technical professionals the opportunity to work with cutting‑edge laser technologies and contribute to performance\-critical solutions.
   

**Role Description** 
 The Technical Sales Engineer role is a full\-time, on\-site position based in Mumbai. The individual in this role will engage with prospective and existing customers to understand their technical requirements, propose appropriate laser solutions, and support the sales process from initial inquiry through order closure. Day\-to\-day responsibilities include preparing technical proposals and presentations, conducting product demonstrations, and collaborating with engineering teams to translate customer needs into feasible configurations. The Technical Sales Engineer will also provide pre\-sales and post\-sales technical support, assist with troubleshooting, and ensure timely resolution of customer issues. Regular activities involve maintaining accurate sales documentation, tracking opportunities in the pipeline, and contributing feedback to improve products and customer experience.
   

**Qualifications**
* Candidates should possess strong Technical Sales and Sales skills to identify opportunities, manage the sales cycle, and achieve revenue targets.
* Candidates should possess Sales Engineering and Technical Support skills to interpret customer requirements, configure solutions, and assist with implementation and issue resolution.
* Candidates should possess excellent Communication skills to explain complex technical concepts clearly, prepare documentation, and collaborate with customers and internal teams.
* Candidates should ideally have experience in laser systems, optics, or industrial equipment, with the ability to quickly learn product specifications and applications.
* A bachelor’s degree in engineering (such as Electrical, Electronics, Mechanical, or related field) or equivalent practical experience is preferred.
* Ability to work on\-site in Mumbai, travel to customer locations as needed, and maintain a customer\-focused, solution\-oriented mindset.
* Strong problem\-solving, presentation, and negotiation skills, along with proficiency in standard office and CRM software, are beneficial.

title: Account Manager - Strategic Sales
description:
**Who are we and what do we do?**
 BrowserStack is the world’s leading cloud\-based software testing platform, empowering over 50,000 customers—including Amazon, Microsoft, Meta, and Google—to deliver high\-quality software at speed. Founded in 2011 by Ritesh Arora and Nakul Aggarwal, the company has grown to support more than two million tests daily across 22 global data centers, providing instant access to 35,000\+ real devices and browsers.
   

  

 With over 1,200 employees and a remote\-first approach, BrowserStack operates at the intersection of scale, reliability, and innovation. Its suite of products spans manual and automated testing, visual regression, accessibility, and test management—all designed to simplify the testing process for modern development teams. Behind the scenes, BrowserStack continues to push the boundaries with AI capabilities like smart test case generation and design, flakiness detection, auto\-healing and more —helping teams reduce maintenance overhead, debug faster, and catch issues earlier in the development lifecycle.
   

  

 Recognized for its innovation and growth, BrowserStack has been named to the Forbes Cloud 100 list for four consecutive years. With backing from investors like Accel, Bond, and Insight Partners, the company continues to expand its product offerings and global footprint. Joining BrowserStack means being part of a mission\-driven team dedicated to shaping the future of software testing.
   

  

**Location: This is a remote position; however, the role requires the candidate to be based in Mumbai.**
**Role in a Nutshell**
 The Strategic Account Manager role is focused on owning, retaining, and expanding a defined book of strategic executive through structured farming, deep customer engagement, and long\-term value creation. This role emphasizes account growth with success driven by multi\-product expansion, renewal strength, and durable executive relationships.
   

  

 You will work with complex, global accounts within engineering\-led organizations, partnering closely with internal teams to unlock expansion opportunities across usage, teams, and product lines. This role reports to the Sales Manager.
   

  

**Desired Experience**
 We are looking for a seasoned Account Manager with a strong track record of expansion\-led revenue ownership in B2B SaaS or enterprise technology environments.
   

  

* 5\-8 years of B2B SaaS experience, with 2\-3 years of experience in a farming / Account Management focused role
* Demonstrated success achieving and exceeding expansion, renewal, and net revenue retention targets
* Recent experience explicitly aligned to Account Management, Farming, Expansion, Upsell / Cross\-sell
* Willingness to work region\-aligned time zones, based on customer coverage
* Passionate about tech and SaaS; extreme customer centricity and empathy; strong desire to work in a fast\-paced, self\-directed start\-up environment
* Solid understanding of Software SaaS/ SaaS adjacent business models and a high degree of comfort and skill in selling to and engaging with technical audiences and executive\-level stakeholders.
* Global Market Experience (Preferred): Previous exposure or success in international sales and account management will be considered a significant plus.
* Bachelor’s degree required; Engineering / Technology background preferred


**What Will You Do?**
****Account Ownership, Expansion \& Lifecycle Expertise****
* Own a portfolio of strategic customers with accountability for long\-term revenue growth and retention.
* Strong understanding of upsell, cross\-sell, and renewal mechanics across multi\-product SaaS portfolios
* Proven ability to identify expansion levers using usage data, customer maturity, org structure, and business goals


**Executive \& Technical Engagement**
* Ability to engage confidently with engineering leaders, technical stakeholders, and economic buyers
* Strong grasp of SaaS business models and comfort selling into technical organizations


**Own \& Grow Strategic Accounts and Build Customer Partnerships**
* Engage customers through regular in\-person meetings, including onsite visits, to strengthen relationships and accelerate account growth
* Own a defined book of strategic accounts with full responsibility for retention, expansion, and net revenue growth
* Develop trusted relationships with technical user, and executive stakeholders


**Drive Renewal \& Retention Excellence**
* Ensure predictable renewals by reinforcing value, outcomes, and ROI ahead of contract milestones.
* Identify and mitigate renewal or contraction risks in partnership with Internal teams.


****Operate Cross\-Functionally with Rigor****
* Act as the central point of ownership across internal teams
* Maintain strong Salesforce hygiene to support forecasting and decision\-making


**Benefits**
 In addition to your total compensation, you will be eligible for following benefits, which will be governed by the Company policy:
   

  

* Medical Insurance: Comprehensive INR 5,00,000 coverage for employee, spouse, up to 2 dependent children, and parents or parents\-in\-law
* Statutory Benefits: Gratuity per the Payment of Gratuity Act, 1972
* Paid Time Off: 25 days of paid leave annually (Annual \& Sick Leave) plus gazetted public holidays and special life\-event leaves
* Remote\-First work environment that allows our people to work from home
* Remote\-First Allowance for home office setup, connectivity, accessories, co\-working spaces, wellbeing to ensure an amazing remote work experience

title: VP Sales and Distribution
description:
**Some Careers Open More Doors Than Others.**
 If you’re looking for a career that will unlock new opportunities, join HSBC and experience the possibilities. Whether you want a career that could take you to the top, or simply take you in an exciting new direction, HSBC offers opportunities, support and rewards that will take you further.
   

  

**Business Descriptor**
 HSBC’s Asset \& Wealth Management is primarily responsible for driving mutual fund sales through distributor networks and client relationships, while ensuring compliance and delivering market insights to advisors and investors.
   

  

 A HSBC Mutual Fund Sales Representative (often titled Sales \& Distribution, Relationship Manager, or Product Specialist in HSBC’s Asset \& Wealth Management) is primarily responsible for driving mutual fund sales through distributor networks
   

  

**Core Responsibilities**
* Distributor \& IFA (Independent Financial Adviser(s)/) channel development: Build and manage relationships with banks, IFAs, and national distributors; expand the IFA network and deepen penetration in the assigned region.
* Sales targets \& assets under management (AUM) growth: Own quarterly/annual sales budgets, focus on AUM growth, and meet/exceed mutual fund sales targets.
* Client/advisor engagement: Present fund strategies, market views, and portfolio solutions to IFAs, relationship managers, and institutional clients; support them in client conversations and portfolio reviews.
* Training \& enablement: Conduct internal/external training sessions, product workshops, and webinars for internal teams and advisors; create sales plans around “focus funds” and campaigns.
* Market intelligence: Gather feedback from the field, share competitor and flow trends, and work with product teams to refine positioning and campaigns.
* Compliance \& documentation: Ensure all sales activities adhere to SEBI (Securities and Exchange Board of India) /AMFI (Association of Mutual Funds in India) guidelines, KYC (Know Your Customer )/AML(Anti\-Money Laundering ) norms, and internal risk/compliance policies; maintain accurate records and reporting.


**Requirements**
 Experience: 5\+ years; prior experience in mutual fund distribution, wealth sales, or private banking is preferred.
   

  

 Certifications: NISM VA certification is mandatory
   

  

 Education: Graduate/postgraduate in finance, business, or related fields.
   

  

 Skills: Strong relationship management, negotiation, presentation skills; comfort with sales pipelines, Excel/CRM reporting, and basic portfolio analytics.
   

  

* Mandatory to successfully complete Anti\-Money Laundering and Sanctions training and post\-course assessment, as required.


**Note**
 As an employee, you are required to perform your duties in a professional capacity exercising independent judgement, discretion and decision\-making authority in planning, organising, directing work, supervising and appraising the work of team members, as applicable; and taking accountability for delivery outcomes. You will represent the organization with relevant internal and external stakeholders. You will allocate and prioritize work, provide direction and feedback, manage team capacity and leave in line with policy as applicable.
   

  

**Eligibility Criteria**

description:
**About The Role**
 CCH Tagetik, the corporate performance management (CPM) platform from Wolters Kluwer, is scaling rapidly in India . Demand from India's largest banks, NBFCs, insurers, manufacturers, and conglomerates is outpacing our current coverage capacity.
   

  

 We are hiring an Account Executive to own a named\-account territory and drive net\-new ARR growth. This is a high\-visibility, quota\-carrying role in a business that has delivered strong year\-on\-year growth and a decisive shift to cloud/SaaS. You will sell a unified platform for financial consolidation, planning, regulatory reporting, and operational transfer pricing to CFOs and finance leadership at India's most sophisticated enterprises.
   

  

**What You Will Do**
* Own a named\-account territory across manufacturing, and large conglomerates, with full responsibility for pipeline generation, deal execution, and bookings attainment
* Sell to the CFO's office — engage CFOs, financial controllers, heads of FP\&A, and CIOs on high\-stakes problems: long close cycles, complex group consolidation, regulatory compliance, and planning transformation
* Run complex, multi\-stakeholder enterprise cycles (6–12 months, six\- and seven\-figure ACV) from qualification through negotiation and close, with disciplined forecasting and CRM hygiene
* Co\-sell with the Big 4 partner ecosystem — build deal\-level alignment with EY, Deloitte, PwC, and Accenture practices, leveraging our strategic Centre of Excellence relationships to source and accelerate opportunities
* Position the unified platform advantage against point solutions and legacy incumbents (Oracle EPM/PBCS, Anaplan, OneStream, SAP BPC), anchoring value in regulatory readiness, finance ownership, and total cost of change
* Expand new product lines, into net\-new and installed\-base accounts
* Orchestrate the extended team — pre\-sales, inside sales, marketing, services, and partner resources — to run coordinated account campaigns
* What We Are Looking For
* 8–12 years of enterprise software sales experience, with at least 4 years selling EPM/CPM, ERP, analytics, or adjacent office\-of\-the\-CFO solutions into large Indian enterprises
* A verifiable track record of quota attainment on net\-new enterprise business, with deal sizes in the ₹1 Cr\+ ACV range
* Fluency in the finance domain — you can hold a credible first meeting with a CFO on consolidation, close, planning, and regulatory reporting without a pre\-sales resource in the room
* Experience co\-selling with Big 4 or large SI partners, and the maturity to manage partner dynamics at deal level
* Strong command of value\-based, executive\-register selling — structured discovery, business case construction, and multi\-threaded stakeholder management
* Bachelor's degree required; MBA or CA/finance background is an advantage
* Based in Mumbai, with willingness to travel across the territory as needed
* Why This Role
* Category momentum: India's regulatory agenda is forcing CFO\-office modernization — you will sell into genuine, board\-level urgency, not discretionary budgets
* Platform differentiation: A single unified platform spanning consolidation, planning, regulatory reporting, ESG, and transfer pricing — a materially stronger story than stitched\-together point tools
* Partner leverage: Committed Big 4 Centre of Excellence investment means real, partner\-sourced pipeline — not cold territory
* Backing of Wolters Kluwer: A €5B\+ global leader in professional information and software, with the brand credibility to open CFO doors
* Growth\-stage economics in an established company: A rapidly scaling India business with leadership visibility, uncapped earning potential, and a clear path to expanded scope
* Wolters Kluwer is an equal opportunity employer. We celebrate diversity and are committed to creating an inclusive environment for all employees.


 Our Interview Practices
   

  

*To maintain a fair and genuine hiring process, we kindly ask that all candidates participate in interviews without the assistance of AI tools or external prompts. Our interview process is designed to assess your individual skills, experiences, and communication style. We value authenticity and want to ensure we’re getting to know you—not a digital assistant. To help maintain this integrity, we ask to remove virtual backgrounds and include in\-person interviews in our hiring process. Please note that use of AI\-generated responses or third\-party support during interviews will be grounds for disqualification from the recruitment process.*
*Applicants may be required to appear onsite at a Wolters Kluwer office as part of the recruitment process.*

description:
**BUSINESS DEVELOPMENT MANAGER – ENTERPRISE** 




  





**ABOUT NEWJAISA TECHNOLOGIES LIMITED** 




 NewJaisa Technologies Limited is India's leading R2v3 and CPCB\-certified refurbished IT hardware company, listed on the NSE and headquartered in Bengaluru. We enable enterprises across India to procure certified, performance\-tested refurbished laptops, desktops, and servers \- delivering up to 50–70% cost savings versus new hardware, without any compromise on quality, reliability, or compliance.
 



 With a rapidly growing enterprise client base spanning BPO, BFSI, Healthcare, Retail, and Education verticals, we are now expanding our North India footprint and are looking for a sharp, networked sales professional to own the Maharastra and North India territory.
 



  





**ROLE OVERVIEW** 




 This is a hunter\-first, relationship\-driven enterprise sales role. As BDM \- Enterprise for North India, you will own the full sales cycle \- from market mapping and cold/warm outreach to pitching, negotiation, and closure.
 



 You will leverage your existing network within target industries to drive qualified pipeline, meet decision\-makers on\-ground, and build NewJaisa's brand presence in the region through client visits and offline events.
 



 This role is ideal for someone who thrives in the field, is commercially sharp, and can independently drive revenue without hand\-holding.
 



  





**KEY RESPONSIBILITIES** 



* Own end\-to\-end enterprise sales for the Maharastra \& North India territory \- from lead identification through to deal closure.
* Proactively map the market to identify high\-potential enterprise accounts across BPO, BFSI, Healthcare, and Retail verticals.
* Leverage existing professional network to generate warm leads and referrals from Day 1\.
* Run outbound prospecting via LinkedIn, industry databases, cold calling, and direct visits to target accounts.
* Identify and engage procurement managers, IT heads, CFOs, and CXOs who influence or own hardware purchase decisions.
* Conduct in\-person meetings, presentations, and product demos to key decision\-makers at enterprise accounts.
* Manage the complete sales lifecycle \- discovery, solution mapping, proposal, negotiation, and closure.
* Develop and maintain strong, long\-term relationships with enterprise accounts to drive repeat business and upsell opportunities.
* Plan and execute offline client events, roundtables, and business networking meets in Maharastra NCR and across North India.
* Represent NewJaisa at industry forums, IT procurement events, and vertical\-specific gatherings.
* Work with the marketing team to drive regional ABM (Account\-Based Marketing) campaigns and BTL activations.
* Maintain accurate and up\-to\-date records of leads, opportunities, and client interactions in the CRM.
* Provide weekly pipeline updates and monthly sales forecasts to reporting management.
* Track competitor activity, pricing trends, and market intelligence and relay inputs to the central team.
* Coordinate with the inside sales, pre\-sales, and operations teams to ensure smooth order processing and post\-sale fulfilment.
* Collaborate with the marketing team on collateral, case studies, and account\-specific materials.
* Share ground\-level market feedback to help refine product positioning and go\-to\-market strategy.



  





**WHAT WE'RE LOOKING FOR** 




**Must\-Have** 




**Experience:** 
 2\-5 years of B2B / enterprise sales.
 



**Communication:** 
 Fluent in English, Marathi and Hindi (spoken \& written) \- non\-negotiable.
 



**Education:** 
 Bachelor's degree in any discipline. Business, Engineering, or related fields preferred.
 



**Location:** 
 Based in Maharastra or willing to relocate immediately.
 



**Travel:** 
 Willing to travel extensively across North India (50%\+ of working time).
 



**Mindset:** 
 Self\-starter \- able to independently generate, qualify, and close leads.
 



**Attitude:** 
 Agile, adaptable, and comfortable in a fast\-paced, target\-driven environment.
 



  





**Good to Have** 



* Prior experience selling IT hardware, managed services, SaaS, or technology solutions to enterprise clients.
* An existing contact network within BPO, BFSI, Healthcare, or Retail organisations in North India \- especially with IT, procurement, or operations decision\-makers.
* Understanding of the IT asset lifecycle, enterprise procurement processes, and bulk hardware buying cycles.
* Experience planning or participating in corporate events, trade shows, or client meets.
* Proficiency with any CRM tool (Zoho, Salesforce, HubSpot, or similar).
* Exposure to sustainability\-led or ESG\-aligned sales pitches (green IT, circular economy).



  





**WHAT'S IN IT FOR YOU** 



* Work with a publicly listed, fast\-growing company in India's sustainable technology sector.
* Full ownership of a high\-potential territory \- Maharastra and North India \- with real scope to grow.
* Competitive fixed CTC \+ attractive performance\-linked incentives (structured for field sales).
* Opportunity to fast\-track into a Senior BDM or Regional Sales Lead role based on performance.
* Join a sharp, entrepreneurial team with a strong culture of ownership and execution.



  





**APPLICATION NOTE** 




 If you have 2–5 years of enterprise sales experience, a contact book in any of our target industries, and the hunger to build something meaningful in North India \- we want to hear from you.
 



  





 NewJaisa Technologies Limited is an equal opportunity employer.

title: Technical Service Manager (TSM) - Maritime, Mumbai
description:
**About Us**
 We are the independent expert in assurance and risk management. Driven by our purpose, to safeguard life, property, and the environment, we empower our customers and their stakeholders with facts and reliable insights so that critical decisions can be made with confidence.
   

  

 As a trusted voice for many of the world’s most successful organizations, we use our knowledge to advance safety and performance, set industry benchmarks, and inspire and invent solutions to tackle global transformations.
   

  

**About Maritime**
 We help enhance the safety, efficiency, and sustainability of our customers in the global shipping industry, covering all vessel types and mobile offshore units. As a partner to industry, we offer services in testing, certification, training, and technical advisory through the energy value chain. That means we’re continually investing heavily into R\&D for new services and solutions while proactively assessing what the industry needs today and tomorrow.
   

  

**About The Role**
 Be the primary liaison for assigned Key Accounts on technical and operational matters which cannot be solved neither by DATE, nor by the Operational Centres or the surveyor network. Help the assigned Key Accounts maintain smooth technical operations and continuous vessel trade by providing personal attention, outstanding competence and added value in identifying, solving and advising the customer on those technical and operational issues in alignment with DNV’s purpose, business objectives and principles.
   

  

 The result is that you maintain and develop a trustful win\-win relationship and contribute to high customer satisfaction and loyalty which build an important foundation for DNV to maintain a high quality fleet, successfully retain existing business and secure new business.
   

  

 Team up with the relevant Key Account Manager (KAM) and work collaboratively with the Account Team and all relevant departments within DNV to ensure that excellent technical customer service levels are delivered.
   

  

 Be an important part of the Key Account Planning and Implementation process to help the KAM prepare and execute a high\-impact Key Account Plan, Account Strategy and Actions that adds value to the customer and to DNV. Provide input to the KAM on the Key Account\`s technical needs and expectations, relevant technology and regulatory developments, suitable strategies and actions related to the Key Account\`s technical issues and technical operations. Help implement the assigned actions according to plan.
   

  

 Develop and strengthen the customer relationship, operating at the Key Account\`s technical department and technical management levels, to achieve preferred supplier status based on lasting personal relationships and the added value delivered.
   

  

 Solve and advise on operational requests, customer technical concerns and technical complaints related to survey and audit performance in close collaboration with relevant technical experts and the KAM to ensure continuous vessel trade. Hand over customer requests to DATE or Operations Centres in case the requests fall into the service scope of those units.
   

  

 Systematically identify any major technical and technical operation challenges and technical concerns related to the DNV interaction with the Key Account and cascade to the KAM and to relevant departments within DNV. Follow\-up with the findings and ensure that related improvement activities are executed under utilization of the relevant DNV organization.
   

  

 Bring in foresight and help spot and resolve potential technical problems before they occur.
   

  

 Consult the customer on technical matters in meetings, presentations and workshops together or in alignment with the KAM and relevant stakeholders within DNV .
   

  

 Train, guide and consult the Key Account on rules and regulations as well as on new tools and new work processes to help them leverage the full value of our solutions and to facilitate customer's planning and implementation into operations.
   

  

 Measure and monitor the Key Account\`s performance on critical technical key performance indicators, address and support improving performance gaps by developing adequate plans and actions in alignment with the KAM and the relevant DNV organization as well as the Key Account.
   

  

 While your focus is on technical issues, remain attentive towards identifying potential business opportunities and hand those over to the KAM.
   

  

 Pro\-actively stay up to date with relevant industry, regulatory and technology trends and best practices as well as with the relevant DNV products, services, processes and tools to remain relevant towards the Key Accounts.
   

  

 Liaise with Indian flag for Flag related matters.
   

  

 Experience working with MOU’s is an added advantage.
   

  

 What we offer
   

  

* Flexible work arrangements for better work\-life balance
* Generous Paid Leaves (Annual, Sick, Compassionate, Local Public, Marriage, Maternity, Paternity, Medical leave)
* Medical benefits ( Insurance and Annual Health Check\-up)
* Pension and Insurance Policies (Group Term Life Insurance, Group Personal Accident Insurance, Travel Insurance)
* Training and Development Assistance (Training Sponsorship, On\-The\-Job Training, Training Programme)
* Additional Benefits (Long Service Awards, Mobile Phone Reimbursement)
* Company bonus/Profit share.


 DNV is an Equal Opportunity Employer and gives consideration for employment to qualified applicants without regard to gender, religion, race, national or ethnic origin, cultural background, social group, disability, sexual orientation, gender identity, marital status, age or political opinion. Diversity is fundamental to our culture and we invite you to be part of this diversity.
   

  

**About You**
* Minimum 5 years of relevant experience in the maritime/offshore industry, with exposure to ship and MOU operations, classification requirements, and customer\-facing roles.
* Driven, goal\-oriented, and results\-focused professional with a proactive approach to achieving business objectives.
* Strong team player with the ability to collaborate effectively across functions and stakeholders.
* Capable of performing efficiently under pressure while maintaining high standards of quality and performance.
* Forward\-thinking, innovative, and solution\-oriented, with strong analytical, decision\-making, and problem\-solving skills.
* Excellent customer engagement and relationship management abilities, with a proven capability to interact effectively at both operational and executive levels.
* Possesses strong knowledge of the maritime industry, offshore operations, and classification requirements.
* Experienced in ship and Mobile Offshore Unit (MOU) operations, enabling effective communication and engagement with a diverse customer base.
* Skilled in working closely with Area Managers, Approval Centre Managers, Production Managers, Business Development Managers, and Key Account Managers (KAMs) to achieve organizational goals.
* Fluent in English, both written and spoken, with excellent communication, presentation, and negotiation skills.
* International exposure and experience working with multicultural teams and stakeholders are considered a strong advantage.
* Self\-motivated and comfortable working autonomously, demonstrating leadership, ownership, and accountability.
* Willing and able to travel as required by the role.


 Security and compliance with statutory requirements in the countries in which we operate is essential for DNV. Background checks will be conducted on all final candidates as part of the offer process, in accordance with applicable country\-specific laws and practices.

 Fairmont Hotels \& Resorts is where the intimate equally coexists with the infinite – an unrivaled portfolio of more than 90 extraordinary hotels where grand moments of life, heartfelt pleasures and personal milestones are celebrated and remembered long after any visit. Since 1907, Fairmont has created magnificent, meaningful and unforgettable hotels, rich with character and deeply connected to the history, culture and community of its destinations – places such as The Plaza in New York City, The Savoy in London, Fairmont San Francisco, Fairmont Banff Springs in Canada, Fairmont Peace Hotel in Shanghai, and Fairmont The Palm in Dubai. **EVENTS \& CULTURAL PROGRAMMING**
* Support delivery of Roswyn's cultural calendar, including on\-the\-ground event management

* Assist with the Artist in Residence programme — scheduling, hospitality coordination, and day\-to\-day support for the resident artist
* Maintain the Cultural Partnerships \& Events Tracker, keeping partner status, next actions, and event details current


**CROSS\-FUNCTIONAL COORDINATION**
* Liaise with Sales, Marketing, and Finance to keep membership collateral, pipeline reporting, and revenue tracking aligned with the Director's direction
* Work with the hotel's IT and front\-office teams on system and process issues affecting member experience
* Support the Director in preparing materials for ownership, GM, and Ennismore\-level updates


 Additional Information
   

  

* 1\-3 years of experience in hospitality operations, membership/loyalty programmes, luxury retail clienteling, or events management
* Genuinely organised — comfortable owning a CRM, a pipeline, and a run\-of\-show simultaneously without letting any of them slip
* Strong written and verbal communication; equally at ease drafting a member welcome letter and briefing a partner on event logistics

* An interest in art, design, hospitality, or cultural programming is a strong plus, given the role's proximity to Roswyn's cultural calendar and partnerships
* Proficiency with standard office and CRM tools; comfort picking up new systems quickly

 Skybound Wealth Management is a global financial advisory company with employees across the UK, USA, Switzerland, Cyprus, Spain and UAE. We provide tailored financial advice to international clients, supported by expert teams across wealth planning, compliance and operations.
 



  





**Role Overview** 




 The Sales Support Consultant is responsible for supporting Skybound’s global advisory and business development network through lead generation, prospect research, and client profiling. Based in the Mumbai office as part of the Group’s exported services function, the role provides direct support to Associates and Advisors across key international offices, including Dubai and London.

The successful candidate will be expected to combine strong research ability, data accuracy, CRM discipline, Excel proficiency, and professional communication to help generate opportunities for the advisory teams.

 Prospecting \& Lead Generation
 



 Identify and build targeted prospect lists using LinkedIn Sales Navigator, online research, professional databases, company websites, industry sources, and other approved tools.

 Client Profiling \& Qualification
 



 Develop clear prospect profiles by assessing relevant background information such as occupation, company, location, financial potential, career milestones, and possible advisory needs.
 



 Qualify leads based on suitability, and relevance to the assigned Associate or Advisor.
 



  





 Associate \& Advisor Support
 



 Work closely with Associates to understand target markets, preferred client profiles, campaign priorities, and appointment\-setting requirements.

 Data Quality

 Campaign \& Market Support
 



 Support targeted business development campaigns by geography, profession, employer, nationality, or client segment.

 Performance Tracking \& Reporting

title: Senior Sales Manager
description:
The Senior Sales Manager (SSM) drives revenue growth by managing and expanding business with mid\-to\-high potential hearing aid dealers, independent audiology practices, and regional retail clinics. This role focuses on increasing share\-of\-wallet within an assigned territory, ensuring high product adoption, and delivering localized sales strategies.
   

  

 The SSM operates with a focused regional revenue target tailored to premium account management, which is structurally distinct from the macro\-level enterprise targets managed by our Business Development Managers (BDMs).
   

  

* Core Role Demarcation (SSM vs. BDM)


**Role**
 To maintain structural clarity across our sales vertical, this position is differentiated from the Business Development Manager (BDM) role across three primary pillars:
   

  

* Portfolio Scope: The SSM manages and nurtures existing mid\-to\-high tier retail dealers. The BDM focuses strictly on untapped corporate chains, hospital networks, and government tenders.
* Revenue Scale: The SSM target is scaled to regional dealer capacity, sitting structurally lower than national or macro\-level BDM revenue targets.
* Sales Cycle: The SSM handles high\-frequency, relationship\-driven monthly sales and restocking cycles. The BDM handles long\-cycle institutional contract acquisitions.
* Key Responsibilities


**Account Management \& Growth**
* Portfolio Ownership: Cultivate and expand a dedicated portfolio of mid\-to\-high potential hearing care professionals (HCPs) and independent dealers.
* Market Share Expansion: Increase product mix and "share of wallet" within accounts currently sourcing from multiple hearing aid manufacturers.
* Relationship Cultivation: Build deep, consultative partnerships with audiologists, clinic owners, and ENT specialists.


**Sales Execution \& Revenue**
* Revenue Generation: Consistently achieve assigned quarterly and annual sales volume and revenue targets for the specific territory.
* Commercial Negotiation: Manage commercial terms, discount structures, and volume rebates within pre\-approved regional parameters.
* Promotional Execution: Design and implement hyper\-local marketing campaigns, dispensing days, and consumer pull\-actions with retail partners.


**Enablement \& Market Intelligence**
* Training Coordination: Partner with internal Audiology Trainers to upskill dealer staff on new software, chip platforms, and fitting rationale.
* Competitor Intelligence: Monitor competitor pricing, product launch cycles, and dealer incentives to proactively protect market share.
* Requirements \& Qualifications


**Experience \& Education**
* Experience: 2–3 years of proven B2B sales experience specifically within the hearing aid industry, medical devices, or optical retail.
* Industry Track Record: Demonstrated success selling to independent audiologists, retail dispensers, or hearing care networks.
* Education: Bachelor’s degree in business, Marketing, or a related field.


**Skills \& Competencies**
* Sales Methodology: Strong relationship builder utilizing a consultative, value\-based selling approach rather than transactional sales.
* Technical Familiarity: Basic understanding of hearing aid fitting concepts and technology platforms.
* Tools \& Planning: Proficiency in territory planning and CRM software usage (e.g., Salesforce, HubSpot).
* Mobility: Willingness to travel up to 50–60% within the assigned territory to maintain high\-frequency, face\-to\-face contact with dealers.


**We are focused on an inclusive recruitment process**
 All applicants will receive equal consideration for employment. As such, we encourage you to submit your CV without a photo to ensure an equal and fair application process.
   

  

 Should you have any special requirements for the interview, please let the Hiring Manager know upon accepting invitation to interview.
   

  

**How to apply?**
 Use the ‘APPLY’ link no later than September 30\. Applications are assessed on a continuous basis, so don’t wait to send yours.
   

  

**On a time crunch?** 
 Feel free to only submit your up\-to\-date CV including a few sentences outlining your motivation for applying – quick and easy.
   

  

 If you would like to know more about the position, please contact communication@gnhearing.com
   

  

**Join us in bringing people closer**
 GN brings people closer through our advanced intelligent hearing, audio, video, and gaming solutions. Inspired by people and motivated by innovation, we deliver technology that enhance the senses of hearing and sight. We enable people with hearing loss overcome real\-life problems, improve communication and collaboration for businesses and provide great experiences for audio and gaming enthusiasts.
   

  

**We hope you will join us on this journey and look forward to receiving your application.**

 Construction is a $13 trillion global industry — and one of the least digitised. Projects routinely overrun budgets and timelines because execution data lives in spreadsheets, WhatsApp groups, and the heads of site engineers. The cost of this opacity runs into millions on every project.
 



 RDash is an AI\-powered Construction Management System that gives construction and infrastructure companies real\-time control, visibility, and predictability over project execution.
 



**Backed by Y Combinator, Stellaris Venture Partners \& Zacua Ventures**

* High\-velocity SMB sales cycles — from first demo to signed contract, typically in 2–6 weeks

* Product demonstrations and consultative discovery with operations and business decision\-makers

* Experience closing software deals of ₹5–50 Lakh ACV with Indian SMB and mid\-market buyers

title: Sr Enterprise Account Exec
description:
**Company Description**
 It all started when engineer Fred Luddy wrote code that automated a tedious task for his coworker, Phyllis. She cried tears of joy. That moment inspired Fred to build a company that could do that for everyone—freeing people from busywork so they could focus on meaningful work. Today, ServiceNow is the AI control tower for business reinvention. Our ServiceNow AI platform brings together any AI, any data, and any workflow— helping 85% of the Fortune 500® work smarter, faster, and better. We're building an AI\-native culture where technology and talent are unstoppable together. And we're just getting started.
   

  

 Join us to put AI to work for people.
   

  

**Job Description**
 You will produce new business sales revenue from a SaaS license model. You will accomplish this through account planning, territory planning, researching prospect customers, using business development strategies and completing field\-based sales activities within a defined set of prospects, territory or vertical.
   

  

**What You Get To Do In This Role**
* Develop relationships with multiple C\-suite personas (e.g., CFO, CIO, COO, CDO) across all product sales
* Oversee client relationship mapping to the account team, orchestrating an account strategy while leading across a broad virtual team (Solutions Consultants, Solutions Specialist, Success resources, Partners and Marketing, etc.)
* Be a trusted advisor to your customers by understanding their business and advising on how ServiceNow can help help their IT roadmap
* Identify the right specialist/ support resources to bring into a deal, at the right time


**Qualifications**
**To be successful in this role you have:**
* 10\+ years of sales experience within software OR solutions sales organization
* Experience establishing trusted relationships with current and prospective clients and other teams
* Experience producing new business, negotiate deals, and maintain healthy C\-Level relationships
* Experience achieving sales targets
* Experience in leveraging or critically thinking about how to integrate AI into work processes, decision\-making, or problem\-solving. This may include using AI\-powered tools, automating workflows, analyzing AI\-driven insights, or exploring AI's potential impact on the function or industry.
* The ability to understand the "bigger picture" and our plans around IT
* Experience promoting a customer success focus in a "win as a team" environment
* Willingness to travel up to 50%


 Additional Information
   

  

**Work Personas**
 We approach our distributed world of work with flexibility and trust. Work personas (flexible, remote, or required in office) are categories that are assigned to ServiceNow employees depending on the nature of their work and their assigned work location. Learn more here. To determine eligibility for a work persona, ServiceNow may confirm the distance between your primary residence and the closest ServiceNow office using a third\-party service.
   

  

**Equal Opportunity Employer**
 ServiceNow is an equal opportunity employer. All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, color, religion, sex, sexual orientation, national origin, age, disability, gender identity, veteran status, or any other category protected by law. In addition, all qualified applicants with arrest or conviction records will be considered for employment in accordance with legal requirements.
   

  

**Accommodations**
 We strive to create an accessible and inclusive experience for all candidates. If you require a reasonable accommodation to complete any part of the application process, or are unable to use this online application and need an alternative method to apply, please contact globaltalentss@servicenow.com for assistance.
   

  

**Export Control Regulations**
 For positions requiring access to controlled technology subject to export control regulations, including the U.S. Export Administration Regulations (EAR), ServiceNow may be required to obtain export control approval from government authorities for certain individuals. All employment is contingent upon ServiceNow obtaining any export license or other approval that may be required by relevant export control authorities.

title: Sales Account Executive
description:
About Content Whale
 



 Welcome to Content Whale, where we redefine the content industry. Content Whale is a
 



 leading content marketing and digital growth company helping businesses, startups, agencies,
 



 and authors grow through strategic content and marketing solutions. Our expertise includes
 



 Content Writing, SEO, AI Search Optimization (AEO \& GEO), LinkedIn Branding, and
 



 Book Writing \& Publishing Services. We work with clients across industries to deliver
 



 impactful solutions that improve their digital presence and business growth.
 



  





 Who are we looking for?
 



 Content Whale is looking for an Account Manager – Sales to manage client relationships,
 



 understand business requirements, coordinate with internal teams, and ensure successful
 



 project delivery. The ideal candidate will act as the bridge between clients and internal teams,
 



 ensuring smooth communication, timely execution, client satisfaction, and opportunities for
 



 account growth.
 



  





 What will you do?
 



 As an Account Manager – Sales, you’ll be the main point of contact for client accounts,
 



 managing relationships, coordinating projects, and ensuring clients receive the best
 



 experience throughout their journey. Your key responsibilities include (but are not limited to):
 



  





 Key Responsibilities
 


* Manage client accounts and maintain strong long\-term relationships.
* Understand client goals, requirements, briefs, and project timelines.
* Coordinate with internal teams including Content, SEO, Design, Web, and Email



 Marketing.
 


* Track project progress and ensure timely delivery of deliverables.
* Conduct client calls, meetings, and regular updates.
* Prepare proposals, presentations, and account\-related documents.
* Handle client concerns, feedback, and escalations effectively.
* Identify upselling and cross\-selling opportunities within existing accounts.
* Support client renewals and account growth initiatives.
* Ensure smooth communication between clients and internal teams.
* Maintain high levels of client satisfaction and engagement.



  





 What do we expect from you?
 



 1\. Bachelor's degree in Business, Marketing, Communications, or a related field.
 



 2\. 2–5 years of experience in Account Management, Client Servicing, Sales, or Business
 



 Development.
 



 3\. Strong communication, presentation, and relationship\-building skills.
 



 4\. Experience managing multiple client accounts and projects.
 



 5\. Ability to coordinate with cross\-functional teams.
 



 6\. Problem\-solving mindset with strong attention to detail.
 



 7\. Experience in digital marketing, content, SEO, or agency environments is preferred.
 



  





 What’s in it for you?
 


* Competitive Salary \+ Performance Incentives
* Exposure to Digital Marketing, SEO, Content, and Branding Projects
* Employee Recognition Programs
* Sponsored Lunch
* Paid Leaves \& Company Holidays



  





 Join us and become a key player in reshaping the content marketing space. We’re not just a
 



 team we’re a content revolution.

title: Corporate Sales Lead
description:
**Job Title** 
 : Corporate Sales Lead
 



**Location:** 
 Mumbai

 Rotational, based on business requirements

 Mandatory Sales Eligibility
 



 Candidates must have a
 **demonstrated and verifiable corporate/B2B sales track record** 
 of:
 


* Minimum
 **₹20 lakh or more business achievement per month**
* Minimum
 **₹2 crore or more business achievement annually**
* Proven experience in independently acquiring and closing corporate accounts
* Consistent achievement of sales and revenue targets



**Note:** 
 Previous sales performance and business achievements may be validated during the recruitment process.
 



  





 Experience \& Qualifications
 


* Relevant experience in
 **Corporate Sales, B2B Sales, or Enterprise Sales**
* Experience in SaaS, HR Tech, HRMS, Fintech, Payroll, Employee Benefits, Enterprise Software, or related corporate solutions will be preferred.
* Graduate degree is mandatory.
* MBA / PGDM in Sales or Marketing will be an added advantage.

 Key Skills
 


* Corporate Client Acquisition
* B2B \& Enterprise Sales
* Business Development
* Solution Selling
* Revenue Generation
* Commercial Negotiation
* Agreement Closure
* Corporate Relationship Management
* Cross\-Selling \& Upselling
* Sales Pipeline Management
* Presentation \& Communication Skills
* CXO\-Level Stakeholder Management



  





 Key Performance Indicators (KPIs)
 



 The candidate's performance will be evaluated based on:
 


* Monthly, quarterly, and annual revenue achievement
* Number of new corporate clients acquired
* Number and value of agreements closed
* Qualified sales pipeline generated
* Lead\-to\-client conversion ratio
* Average deal size
* Cross\-sell and upsell revenue
* Account retention and expansion

* Relevant experience

 .

 .

title: Business Development Manager
description:
Role: Business Development Manager
 



 Exp: 5\+ Years
 



 Location: Mumbai / Pune
 



 We are looking for a driven and experienced Cloud Sales Business Development Manager to join our team. The ideal candidate will have a deep understanding of cloud technologies and services, along with a proven track record of driving sales in the cloud computing industry. As a Cloud Sales BDM, you will be responsible for identifying new business opportunities, building strong client relationships, and driving revenue growth through the sale of cloud solutions.
 



**Key Responsibilities:** 



1. Proactively identify and qualify new business opportunities in the cloud computing market.
2. Conduct market research to understand customer needs and preferences.
3. Collaborate with marketing and product teams to develop targeted lead generation campaigns.
4. Create and implement effective sales strategies to achieve revenue targets.
5. Build and maintain a robust sales pipeline, tracking progress and performance.
6. Present cloud solutions to prospective clients, highlighting the value proposition and benefits.
7. Cultivate strong, long\-term relationships with key clients and stakeholders.
8. Understand client requirements and propose customized cloud solutions to meet their business objectives.
9. Act as a trusted advisor, providing guidance and support throughout the sales process.
10. Work closely with technical teams to understand product capabilities and limitations.
11. Collaborate on solution design and proposal development to address client needs effectively.
12. Provide feedback from clients to inform product development and enhancements.
13. Lead contract negotiations, ensuring terms are favorable and aligned with business objectives.
14. Close sales deals in a timely manner, meeting or exceeding revenue targets.
15. Ensure smooth handover to implementation and support teams post\-sale.



**Qualifications:** 



* Bachelor’s degree in Business Administration, Sales, Marketing, or a related field. Master’s degree preferred.
* Proven track record of success in cloud sales or business development roles.
* In\-depth knowledge of cloud technologies, platforms, and services (e.g., IaaS, PaaS, SaaS, public, private, hybrid clouds).
* Strong understanding of sales principles and techniques, with excellent negotiation skills.
* Ability to build and maintain relationships with clients and partners at all levels.
* Excellent communication and presentation skills.
* Results\-oriented with a focus on driving revenue growth.

title: Business Growth Specialist - Talent Management
description:
**Position Overview:** 




  





 We are looking for a dynamic, commercially driven Business Growth Specialist to join our Artist Management team. The role will be responsible for identifying and developing new business opportunities, building strong relationships with brands, agencies, corporates and event organisers, and creating revenue opportunities for the artists represented by the company.
 



  





 The ideal candidate should have a strong understanding of the entertainment, artist management, events, brand activation and corporate engagement ecosystem, along with excellent networking, pitching and negotiation skills.
 



  





**Key Responsibilities:** 




  





**1\. Business Development \& Revenue Growth** 



* Identify and develop new business opportunities for artist bookings, performances, brand associations, endorsements and collaborations.
* Build and maintain a strong pipeline of prospective clients, brands, agencies and corporate accounts.
* Generate leads through networking, market research, industry events, referrals and existing relationships.
* Drive business from lead generation through pitching, negotiation, closure and handover.
* Achieve agreed business development and revenue targets.



  





**2\. Artist \& Brand Partnerships** 



* Understand the company's artist portfolio and identify suitable commercial opportunities for each artist.
* Develop customised proposals for brand collaborations, corporate events, endorsements, appearances, performances and digital campaigns.
* Identify opportunities where artists can be integrated into brand campaigns and marketing initiatives.
* Work closely with the Artist Management team to ensure opportunities are commercially viable and aligned with the artist's positioning.



  





**3\. Client Acquisition \& Relationship Management** 



* Develop long\-term relationships with brand managers, marketing heads, event agencies, advertising agencies, corporate clients, media houses and entertainment stakeholders.
* Maintain regular engagement with existing clients to generate repeat business, upselling and cross\-selling opportunities.
* Understand client requirements and recommend appropriate artists, formats and commercial solutions.
* Ensure a high level of client servicing throughout the business development cycle.



  





**4\. Pitching \& Negotiation** 



* Prepare and present business proposals, artist profiles, commercial decks and partnership ideas.
* Lead commercial discussions and negotiate fees, deliverables, timelines and contractual terms in coordination with the relevant internal teams.
* Ensure commercial proposals are aligned with company revenue objectives and artist expectations.
* Track negotiations and follow up consistently to convert opportunities into confirmed business.



  





**5\. Market Intelligence** 



* Keep abreast of entertainment trends, emerging artists, brand marketing strategies, competitor activities and industry developments.
* Identify emerging categories, brands and markets that can generate new revenue opportunities.
* Maintain a database of prospective clients, agencies, brands and industry contacts.
* Provide regular market insights and business development reports to management.



  





**6\. Internal Coordination** 



* Coordinate with Artist Management, Operations, Finance, Legal, Marketing and other internal teams to ensure smooth execution of confirmed opportunities.
* Ensure all commercial commitments are clearly communicated and documented.
* Support the team in developing new business verticals and artist monetisation opportunities.



  





**Qualification \& Experience** 



* Graduate degree in Business Management, Marketing, Mass Communication, Events, Media, Entertainment or a related field.
* 3–7 years of experience in Business Development, Sales, Artist Management, Events, Entertainment, Brand Partnerships, Media or related industries.
* Experience in selling artist performances, entertainment solutions, brand collaborations, event solutions or celebrity associations will be an added advantage.
* Strong existing network among brands, advertising/event agencies, corporates and marketing professionals will be preferred.



  





**Preferred Candidate Profile** 




  





**The ideal candidate is someone who:** 



* Enjoys meeting people, networking and creating business opportunities.
* Can independently identify prospects and convert them into revenue.
* Has a strong understanding of how brands use artists, celebrities and entertainment for marketing and engagement.
* Is comfortable working with targets and commercial negotiations.
* Can balance a sales mindset with creative thinking.
* Has the confidence and maturity to interact with senior brand and agency stakeholders.
* Is passionate about the entertainment and artist management industry.

title: Sr. Business Development Manager
description:
**Company Description** 




 D2P \& Co. is a boutique partner firm dedicated to helping F\&B brands build solid, resilient businesses. We work with both well\-established brands and new startups, offering personalized guidance and support. Our unique "External Co\-founder" approach means we develop a close, collaborative relationship with our clients, sharing in their challenges and successes. We focus on execution\-oriented strategies to drive growth, allowing us to deliver high\-quality results by limiting the number of clients we take on each year.
 



  





**Role Description** 





 D2P \& Co. is looking for a Business Development Executive to join our growing team and help us work with some of the most exciting brands, founders, and businesses in the industry.
 




  






 What will you do?
 





 🔹 Identify and reach out to potential F\&B \& FMCG clients
 





 🔹 Generate and qualify leads through outbound and inbound channels
 





 🔹 Connect with founders and decision\-makers and pitch D2P’s consulting services
 





 🔹 Schedule and conduct business development meetings
 





 🔹 Build and manage a strong sales pipeline
 





 🔹 Understand client challenges and identify relevant D2P solutions
 





 🔹 Prepare proposals and take opportunities from lead → meeting → pitch → conversion
 





 🔹 Maintain strong relationships with prospects and existing clients
 





 🔹 Track sales activities, conversions, and monthly targets
 




  






 Who are we looking for?
 





 ✨ 1–3 years of experience in B2B sales / business development
 





 ✨ Experience or strong exposure to F\&B / FMCG is preferred
 





 ✨ Excellent communication, pitching, negotiation, and relationship\-building skills
 





 ✨ Someone who is comfortable speaking to founders and senior decision\-makers
 





 ✨ Strong ownership and a target\-driven mindset
 





 ✨ Someone who enjoys networking, prospecting, and converting opportunities
 





 ✨ A self\-starter who can work independently in a fast\-growing environment
 




  






 What’s in it for you?
 





 💰 ₹30,000–₹45,000/month, depending on experience
 





 📈 Performance\-based incentives \& commissions
 





 🚀 Direct exposure to founders and leading F\&B/FMCG businesses
 





 🤝 Opportunities to attend industry events and build a strong industry network
 





 🌱 Significant opportunities for career growth and ownership
 




  






 Location: Mumbai \| Work from Office
 




  





**Qualifications** 



* Prefer candidates with Food Tech degree plus B2B sales experience
* Experience in business development, market research, and strategic partnerships
* Skills in client relationship management and contract negotiations
* Proficiency in proposal development, negotiations and client on\-boarding
* Strong analytical and problem\-solving abilities
* Excellent communication and interpersonal skills
* Ability to work independently and as part of a team
* Experience in the F\&B industry is a must
* Bachelor's degree in Business, Marketing, or a related field



  






 If you’re someone who believes sales is about understanding businesses, solving problems, and building relationships \- not just making a pitch, we’d love to hear from you.

 hiring@d2pandco.com

title: Inside Sales Executive
description:
**Company Description** 
 BookEinstein is an edtech startup based in Mumbai, focused on empowering students through language and skill development. Since 2020, the company has offered online classes and partnered with leading schools to support learners in Creative Writing, Public Speaking, and Vocabulary Building. BookEinstein aims to remove language barriers so that children can express themselves confidently and develop essential lifelong skills. In addition, the company operates a curated children’s library and book service, offering high\-quality imported books and guided reading programs. This combination of education and curated content creates a dynamic environment for team members passionate about learning and student success.
 



**Role Description** 
 This is a full\-time, on\-site Inside Sales Executive role based in the Mumbai Metropolitan Region. The Inside Sales Executive will manage inbound and outbound calls, engage with prospective and existing customers, and explain BookEinstein’s products and services clearly and effectively. Day\-to\-day responsibilities include qualifying leads, following up on inquiries from schools and parents, scheduling demos or consultations, and maintaining accurate records in the sales CRM. The role involves collaborating with the marketing and operations teams to convert leads into enrollments, meet sales targets, and provide responsive support to customers. The Inside Sales Executive is expected to maintain a professional, learner\-focused approach while representing the brand in all interactions.
 



**Qualifications** 



* Strong Inside Sales and Sales skills, with a track record of meeting or exceeding targets.
* Experience in Lead Generation, including identifying prospects and nurturing them through the sales funnel.
* Excellent Communication and Customer Service abilities, with a client\-centric and empathetic approach.
* Comfort using CRM tools, spreadsheets, and basic office software to manage data and follow\-ups.
* Prior experience in edtech, education services, or similar domains is an advantage.
* Ability to work on\-site in the Mumbai Metropolitan Region and manage flexible schedules as needed.
* Bachelor’s degree in any discipline; formal training in sales or marketing is a plus.



  





  





 Work days : Mon Fri : 9\-6pm and Alt sat 9\-6pm
 



 CTC: 3 \- 4 lac per annum

* Commercial Negotiation \& Closing

**Ideal Candidate Profile** 




  





 We are looking for an action\-oriented sales professional who thrives on autonomy and field activity.
 



 The ideal candidate will:
 


* Have deep market fluency in engineering polymers, compounds, or specialty additives.
* Be commercially confident and skilled at navigating pricing negotiations with Indian business owners.
* Take absolute accountability for revenue outcomes rather than just meeting activity metrics.
* Demonstrate high integrity, transparent communication, and a willingness to share market insights with internal teams.
* Be excited by the prospect of building a new business unit from scratch rather than inheriting existing accounts.



  





**What Success Looks Like** 




  





 The successful candidate will:
 


* Rapidly establish a qualified opportunity pipeline and achieve early revenue traction (\~₹1 Cr/month target post\-ramp).
* Convert initial sample trials and technical evaluations into repeatable commercial supply contracts.
* Build long\-term strategic relationships with key promoters and manufacturing leaders in the territory.
* Lay the foundation for regional sales expansion, opening up opportunities for future team leadership.

 Help launch and scale a brand\-new commercial vertical within a venture\-backed tech\-enabled platform.

 Direct path from individual contributor to regional or national commercial leadership as the business unit scales.
